descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di rendiconti finanziari, analisi dei dati e trasformando le informazioni finanziarie in insight convincenti? Ti piace guidare transazioni commerciali ad alto impatto e modellare il futuro della rendicontazione finanziaria attraverso il miglioramento continuo e l'innovazione? Se è così, questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità perfetta per voi!
Informazioni sul ruolo
Unisciti al nostro team di reporting delle entità legali e gioca un ruolo chiave nel reporting legale, nella trasformazione delle finanze e nell'impegno degli stakeholder, influenzando direttamente il processo decisionale strategico tra le entità giuridiche globali di Swiss Re.
Responsabilità chiave

• Lead reporting legale e regolamentare per un portafoglio di enti legali (ad esempio servizi, immobili, investimenti, finanziamenti e holding)

• Leva l'analisi dei dati e l'intelligenza aziendale per spiegare le prestazioni finanziarie e trasformare i dati complessi in insight attuabili per la gestione

• Gestione attiva delle posizioni chiave di bilancio e di dichiarazione di reddito, sostenendo le decisioni di capitale, liquidità e dividendo

• Collabora con gli stakeholder senior per preparare pacchetti di report concisi e basati sui dati, tra cui presentare i risultati alla leadership di finanza senior e ai consigli di amministrazione

• Miglioramento dell'azionamento nei processi legali di finanza e transazioni commerciali complesse, con un focus sulle entità non tecniche del Gruppo Swiss Re

• Contribuire a finanziare l'innovazione attraverso soluzioni di standardizzazione, automazione e report scalabili, come gli strumenti Palantir Foundry e AI-enabled, per costruire operazioni più efficienti, conformi e basate sui dati

• Agire come un contatto chiave per le entità assegnate, legandosi con i partner interni a livello globale e gli stakeholder esterni, compresi i revisori legali

• Garantire il rispetto delle politiche interne e dei quadri di controllo, migliorando continuamente i controlli, la governance e la qualità dei dati
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il nostro team di Rapporti non tecnici di Bratislava è responsabile del reporting finanziario end-to-end per enti non tecnici a livello globale, con un focus sui principali hub di Swiss Re, tra cui Svizzera, Lussemburgo, Regno Unito, Stati Uniti e Sud-Est asiatico.

Su di te
Sei un professionista finanziario proattivo, curioso e analiticamente consapevole che porta sia rigore che un forte spirito collaborativo e di team-oriented a tutto ciò che fai. Energizzato da complessi argomenti finanziari, si ha una comprovata capacità di trasformare i dati in narrazioni chiare e attuabili. Ti piace lavorare a stretto contatto con gli altri attraverso culture e funzioni, prendere la proprietà, e sono sempre alla ricerca di modi più intelligenti di lavorare.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Laurea universitaria e 3+ anni di esperienza lavorativa in Finanza, Contabilità, Audit, Data Analytics, Business Analytics o un campo correlato

• Esperienza comprovata nella preparazione, nella segnalazione, nell'analisi o nell'audit dei rendiconti finanziari completi e delle divulgazioni in ambito globale o locale (ad esempio IFRS, US GAAP, Slovakia GAAP)

• Forti competenze di interpretazione analitica e dei dati , con la capacità di fornire un output di alta qualità combinato con un giudizio aziendale sano

• Eccellente capacità organizzative e di gestione delle parti interessate , con forte attenzione ai dettagli e la capacità di comunicare efficacemente a livello di gestione senior

• Solida comprensione dei processi finanziari, dei controlli e dei principi di governance dei dati

• La competenza professionale in inglese è richiesta

Altre qualifiche (vantageous):

• qualifica ACCA o equivalente (o lavorando alla qualificazione)

• Esperienza pratica con l'automazione, l'analisi basata sull'intelligenza artificiale, o iniziative e soluzioni di finanza digitale, come Palantir Foundry, Power BI, o strumenti simili

• Esposizione a progetti di miglioramento o di trasformazione finanziaria

• Competenza in una lingua europea aggiuntiva, in particolare in tedesco
Informazioni sull'insalata
Per la Slovacchia, la gamma di stipendio base per questa posizione è compresa tra 2.100 e 3.400 EUR al mese per un ruolo a tempo pieno.
Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• I requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo

• Il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze e esperienza
Nella situazione in cui non soddisfa tutti i requisiti, o si superano in modo significativo questi, lo stipendio offerto può essere inferiore o superiore alla gamma pubblicizzata. Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per ulteriori ricompense e benefici, tra cui un attraente bonus annuale basato sulle prestazioni.
La nostra azienda segue un modello di lavoro ibrido, con un'aspettativa di essere presente in ufficio almeno il 50% del tempo di lavoro.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für Finanzberichte, Datenanalysen und die Umwandlung von Finanzinformationen in überzeugende Erkenntnisse? Haben Sie Spaß daran, einflussreiche Geschäftstransaktionen voranzutreiben und die Zukunft der Finanzberichterstattung durch kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Innovation zu gestalten? Wenn ja, könnte dies die perfekte Gelegenheit für Sie sein!
Über die Rolle
Schließen Sie sich unserem Reporting-Team für juristische Personen an und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der gesetzlichen Berichterstattung, der Finanztransformation und dem Engagement von Stakeholdern - und beeinflussen Sie direkt die strategischen Entscheidungen in den globalen juristischen Einheiten von Swiss Re.
Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten

• Leitende gesetzliche und aufsichtsrechtliche Berichterstattung für ein Portfolio von juristischen Personen (z. B. Dienstleistungs-, Immobilien-, Investment-, Finanzierungs- und Holdingunternehmen)

• Nutzen Sie Datenanalysen und Business Intelligence, um die finanzielle Leistung zu erklären, und verwandeln Sie komplexe Daten in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für das Management

• Aktives Management wichtiger Positionen in Bilanz und Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung und Unterstützung von Kapital-, Liquiditäts- und Dividendenentscheidungen

• Arbeiten Sie mit hochrangigen Stakeholdern zusammen, um prägnante, datengesteuerte Berichtspakete vorzubereiten, einschließlich der Präsentation von Ergebnissen für leitende Finanzleiter und Board of Directors

• Weiterentwicklung von juristischen Personenfinanzierungsprozessen und komplexen Geschäftstransaktionen mit Schwerpunkt auf nichttechnischen Einheiten der Swiss Re Group

• Beitrag zur Finanzierung von Innovationen durch Standardisierung, Automatisierung und skalierbare Reporting-Lösungen wie Palantir Foundry und KI-fähige Tools, um effizientere, konforme und datengesteuerte Abläufe zu schaffen

• Als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für zugewiesene Unternehmen fungieren und mit internen Partnern weltweit und externen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Abschlussprüfern, zusammenarbeiten

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und Kontrollrahmen, kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Kontrollen, Governance und Datenqualität
Über das Team
Unser in Bratislava ansässiges Non-Technical Carriers Reporting-Team ist für die End-to-End-Finanzberichterstattung für nicht-technische Einheiten weltweit verantwortlich, mit Schwerpunkt auf wichtigen Swiss Re-Hubs wie der Schweiz, Luxemburg, Großbritannien, den USA und Südostasien.

Über dich
Sie sind ein proaktiver, neugieriger und analytisch denkender Finanzprofi, der sowohl Strenge als auch einen starken teamorientierten, kooperativen Geist in alles, was Sie tun, einbringt. Angekurbelt durch komplexe Finanzthemen, haben Sie eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Daten in klare, umsetzbare Narrative umzuwandeln. Sie arbeiten gerne eng mit anderen über Kulturen und Funktionen hinweg zusammen, übernehmen Verantwortung und sind immer auf der Suche nach intelligenteren Arbeitsweisen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Universitätsabschluss und 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Audit, Data Analytics, Business Analytics oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Erstellung, Berichterstattung, Analyse oder Prüfung von vollständigen Abschlüssen und Angaben nach globalen oder lokalen Rahmenbedingungen (z. B. IFRS, US-GAAP, Slowakische GAAP)

• Starke analytische und Dateninterpretationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse in Kombination mit einem soliden Geschäftsurteil zu liefern

• Hervorragende organisatorische und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit starker Liebe zum Detail und die Fähigkeit, effektiv auf der Führungsebene zu kommunizieren

• Solides Verständnis von Finanzprozessen, Kontrollen und Data Governance-Prinzipien

• Professionelle Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen (vorteilhaft):

• ACCA-Qualifikation oder gleichwertig (oder auf Qualifikation hinarbeiten)

• Praktische Erfahrung mit Automatisierung, KI-gestützten Analysen oder digitalen Finanzinitiativen und -lösungen wie Palantir Foundry, Power BI oder ähnlichen Tools

• Exposition gegenüber Prozessverbesserungen oder Finanzierung von Transformationsprojekten

• Kenntnisse in einer zusätzlichen europäischen Sprache, insbesondere Deutsch
Gehaltsangaben
Für die Slowakei liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen 2.100 EUR und 3.400 EUR pro Monat für eine Vollzeitstelle.
Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Verantwortlichkeiten der Rolle

• Eigenes Profil des Bewerbers einschließlich Ausbildung / Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung
Wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen oder diese deutlich übertreffen, kann das angebotene Gehalt unter oder über dem angegebenen Bereich liegen. Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt haben Sie möglicherweise Anspruch auf zusätzliche Belohnungen und Vorteile, einschließlich eines attraktiven leistungsbezogenen Jahresbonus.
Unser Unternehmen folgt einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell, mit der Erwartung, mindestens 50% der Arbeitszeit im Büro zu sein.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous passionné par les états financiers, l'analyse des données et la transformation de l'information financière en renseignements convaincants? Aimez-vous conduire des transactions commerciales à fort impact et façonner l'avenir de l'information financière par l'amélioration continue et l'innovation? Si oui, cela pourrait être l'occasion parfaite pour vous!
À propos du rôle
Rejoignez notre équipe de reporting sur les entités juridiques et jouez un rôle clé dans le reporting statutaire, la transformation financière et l'engagement des parties prenantes.
Principales responsabilités

• Diriger les rapports législatifs et réglementaires pour un portefeuille d'entités juridiques (p. ex. services, biens immobiliers, investissements, financement et entités détenantes)

• Tirer parti de l'analyse des données et de l'intelligence d'affaires pour expliquer le rendement financier et transformer des données complexes en idées pratiques pour la gestion

• Gérer activement les positions clés du bilan et des états des résultats, à l'appui des décisions relatives au capital, à la liquidité et aux dividendes

• Collaborer avec les principaux intervenants pour préparer des trousses de rapports concises et axées sur les données, y compris présenter les résultats aux cadres supérieurs des finances et aux conseils d'administration

• Favoriser l'amélioration des processus de financement des entités juridiques et des transactions commerciales complexes, en mettant l'accent sur les entités non techniques de Swiss Re Group

• Contribuer au financement de l'innovation par des solutions de normalisation, d'automatisation et de reporting évolutives, telles que Palantir Foundry et les outils compatibles avec l'IA, afin de construire des opérations plus efficaces, conformes et axées sur les données

• Agir en tant que contact clé pour les entités désignées, assurer la liaison avec les partenaires internes au niveau mondial et les parties prenantes externes, y compris les contrôleurs légaux des comptes

• Assurer le respect des politiques internes et des cadres de contrôle, améliorer continuellement les contrôles, la gouvernance et la qualité des données
À propos de l'équipe
Notre équipe de rapports sur les transporteurs non techniques basée à Bratislava est responsable de l'information financière de bout en bout pour les entités non techniques à l'échelle mondiale, en mettant l'accent sur les principaux hubs Swiss Re dont la Suisse, le Luxembourg, le Royaume-Uni, les États-Unis et l'Asie du Sud-Est.

Sur toi
Vous êtes un professionnel de la finance proactif, curieux et analytique qui apporte à la fois la rigueur et un solide esprit de collaboration axé sur l'équipe. Poussé par des sujets financiers complexes, vous avez une capacité éprouvée de transformer les données en récits clairs et concrets. Vous aimez travailler en étroite collaboration avec d'autres à travers les cultures et les fonctions, prendre possession, et sont toujours à la recherche de méthodes de travail plus intelligentes.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Diplôme universitaire et plus de 3 ans d'expérience en finance, comptabilité, audit, analyse des données, analyse des affaires ou un domaine connexe

• Expérience éprouvée en matière d'élaboration, de présentation de rapports, d'analyse ou d'audit d'états financiers complets et de divulgations dans le cadre mondial ou local (par exemple, IFRS, GAAP des États-Unis, GAAP slovaque)

• Forte capacité d'analyse et d'interprétation des données , avec la capacité de produire une production de haute qualité combinée à une bonne appréciation des affaires

• Excellentes compétences en matière d'organisation et de gestion des parties prenantes , avec une grande attention aux détails et la capacité de communiquer efficacement au niveau des cadres supérieurs

• Une bonne compréhension des processus financiers, des contrôles et des principes de gouvernance des données

• Compétence professionnelle en anglais est nécessaire

Qualifications supplémentaires (avantages) :

• Qualification ACCA ou équivalent (ou travail vers la qualification)

• Expérience pratique des initiatives et des solutions d'automatisation, d'analyse assistée par l'IA ou de financement numérique, telles que Palantir Foundry, Power BI ou des outils similaires

• Exposition à des projets d'amélioration des procédés ou de transformation du financement

• Compétence dans une langue européenne supplémentaire , en particulier l'allemand
Renseignements sur les salaires
Pour la Slovaquie, l'échelle salariale de base pour ce poste se situe entre 2 100 et 3 400 euros par mois pour un poste à temps plein.
Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• Exigences, portée, complexité et responsabilités du rôle

• Profil du candidat, y compris les études/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience
Si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les exigences, ou si vous les dépassez de façon significative, le salaire offert peut être inférieur ou supérieur à la fourchette annoncée. En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à des récompenses et des avantages supplémentaires, y compris une prime annuelle axée sur le rendement attrayante.
Notre entreprise suit un modèle de travail hybride, avec une attente d'être présent dans le bureau au moins 50% du temps de travail.
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

jobs.title: Regulatory Operations Compliance Associate
jobs.description:
Locations:
Windsor, CT, US |
Kansas City, MO, US

Are you a detail-driven compliance professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-evolving regulatory environment? Do you love digging into the details, managing complex projects, and making a real impact across a global organization? If so, Swiss Re's Regulatory Operations team has an exciting opportunity for you!

About the Role
 As a Compliance Associate on the Regulatory Operations team, you will play a vital role in supporting Swiss Re's North America product offerings and policy issuance. From the development and preparation of product filings through to implementation, you will be at the heart of ensuring regulatory compliance across multiple product lines. This is a role where no two days are the same — and where your contributions genuinely matter.
 Key Responsibilities

• Support filing processes for rates, rules, and forms, assisting Regulatory Operations teammates throughout the full product filing life cycle

• Independently review and analyze bureau circulars (e.g., ISO, AAIS) to assess product and filing impact, communicate changes, and assist in completing required filing processes

• Manage referrals received via the forms analyst mailbox across all product lines, including formatting specifications and determination of appropriate filing action

• Maintain accuracy and integrity of Swiss Re's internal tracking system to ensure current, regulatory-compliant product filing information is always up to date

• Own and actively manage projects , taking initiative and participating in cross-functional projects as assigned

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Products, Underwriting, Legal, and other functional areas to ensure alignment and timely execution

• Provide competitor product and filing intelligence to business units upon request, supporting informed decision-making

About the Team

You'll be joining the Regulatory Operations Product Services team — a collaborative, skilled, and supportive group that provides regulatory compliance support to multiple Corporate Solutions businesses across the globe. Our team brings together a diverse set of expertise and works hand-in-hand with departments across the organization to meet state regulatory requirements and implement product and regulatory changes effectively.
 What makes us unique? No two days are alike. We thrive in an ever-changing product and regulatory landscape, and we embrace that complexity as an opportunity to grow. We're a team that looks out for one another — we collaborate, train, and mentor new colleagues, and we're always pursuing ways to improve how we work. If you're looking for a team culture built on trust, curiosity, and continuous learning, you've found it.

About You
 You are a self-starter with sharp critical thinking skills and a natural ability to anticipate challenges before they arise. You bring a proactive mindset, rolling up your sleeves and diving in with minimal supervision. Equally comfortable working independently or collaboratively in a global matrix environment, you communicate with confidence and clarity across all levels — from internal stakeholders to state regulatory authorities. You are organized, deadline-driven, and skilled at juggling multiple priorities without missing a beat.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 2–5 years of experience in insurance rate and form filing, policy issuance system implementation, or other insurance regulatory-related work

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word , including creation and formatting of tables and application of document styles to support regulatory filings and correspondence

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel , including creation of formulas and use of data formatting tools (e.g., filters, conditional formatting) for tracking and reporting purposes

• Proficiency with regulatory filing platforms including SERFF, iFile, NILS, and ISOnet, as well as Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint)

• Knowledge and understanding of Insurance Company operations and the broader regulatory environment, including familiarity with Bureau Circulars (e.g., ISO, AAIS)
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with SharePoint , including document libraries, version control, and collaboration features in support of operational or regulatory documentation

• College degree or equivalent professional work experience in a related field

• Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills , with the ability to artfully propose responses to regulatory objections and insurance department inquiries

• Excellent written and oral communication skills , with the ability to convey complex regulatory information clearly and concisely

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail

• Comfort and experience working in a global matrix organization , interacting effectively with stakeholders at all levels

The position location is flexible to our Kansas City, MO or Windsor, CT offices. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework, relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $52,000 to $78,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role, will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sei un professionista del rispetto dei dettagli che prospera in un ambiente normativo veloce e in continua evoluzione? Ti piace scavare nei dettagli, gestire progetti complessi e fare un impatto reale su un'organizzazione globale? Se è così, il team di Swiss Re's Regulatory Operations ha un'opportunità entusiasmante per voi!

Informazioni sul ruolo
In qualità di Compliance Associate del team delle Operazioni Regolatorie, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel sostenere le offerte di prodotti e l'emissione di policy di Swiss Re's North America. Dallo sviluppo e dalla preparazione dei file di prodotto fino all'implementazione, sarete al centro di garantire la conformità normativa su più linee di prodotto. Questo è un ruolo in cui non ci sono due giorni uguali — e dove i vostri contributi realmente importano.
Principali responsabilità

• Supporta i processi di archiviazione per i tassi, le regole e le forme, aiutando i compagni di squadra delle operazioni regolamentari durante tutto il ciclo di vita di archiviazione del prodotto completo

• Indipendentemente rivedere e analizzare le circolari dell'ufficio (ad esempio, ISO, AAIS) per valutare l'impatto del prodotto e del deposito, comunicare le modifiche e assistere al completamento dei processi di archiviazione richiesti

• Gestire i rinvii ricevuti tramite la casella di posta analista dei moduli in tutte le linee di prodotto, comprese le specifiche di formattazione e la determinazione dell'azione di archiviazione appropriata

• Mantenere l'accuratezza e l'integrità del sistema di monitoraggio interno di Swiss Re per garantire che le informazioni di archiviazione dei prodotti conformi alle normative siano sempre aggiornate

• Gestire progetti propri e attivamente, prendendo iniziative e partecipando a progetti interfunzionali assegnati

• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni di Prodotti, Sottoscrittura, Legale e altre aree funzionali per garantire l'allineamento e l'esecuzione tempestiva

• Fornire il prodotto concorrente e il deposito di intelligenza alle unità aziendali su richiesta, sostenendo il processo decisionale informato

Informazioni sulla squadra

Ti unirai al team dei Servizi dei Prodotti delle Operazioni Regolatorie – un gruppo collaborativo, qualificato e di supporto che fornisce il supporto di conformità alle normative a più aziende di Corporate Solutions in tutto il mondo. Il nostro team riunisce una serie diversificata di competenze e lavora a stretto contatto con i dipartimenti di tutta l'organizzazione per soddisfare i requisiti normativi di stato e implementare i cambiamenti di prodotto e normativi in modo efficace.
Cosa ci rende unici? Non ci sono due giorni uguali. Noi prosperiamo in un paesaggio sempre in continuo cambiamento di prodotto e normativo, e abbracciamo questa complessità come un'opportunità per crescere. Siamo una squadra che si guarda l'un l'altro — collaboriamo, formiamo e mentore nuovi colleghi, e stiamo sempre perseguendo modi per migliorare come lavoriamo. Se stai cercando una cultura di squadra costruita sulla fiducia, la curiosità e l'apprendimento continuo, l'hai trovata.

A proposito di te
Sei un auto-starter con acute capacità di pensiero critico e una capacità naturale di anticipare le sfide prima che si presentano. Si porta una mentalità proattiva, rotolare le maniche e immergersi con una supervisione minima. Allo stesso modo confortevole lavorare in modo indipendente o collaborativo in un ambiente di matrice globale, si comunica con fiducia e chiarezza su tutti i livelli - da stakeholder interni a autorità di regolamentazione statali. Siete organizzati, guidati dal termine e qualificati a discutere più priorità senza perdere un battito.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• 2-5 anni di esperienza nell'assicurazione e nel deposito dei moduli, nell'attuazione del sistema di emissione delle politiche, o in altri lavori relativi alla regolamentazione delle assicurazioni

• Proficienza avanzata in Microsoft Word , compresa la creazione e la formattazione di tabelle e l'applicazione di stili di documento per supportare i processi normativi e la corrispondenza

• Proficienza avanzata in Microsoft Excel , compresa la creazione di formule e l'uso di strumenti di formattazione dei dati (ad esempio, filtri, formattazione condizionale) per scopi di tracciamento e reporting

• Proficienza con piattaforme di archiviazione regolamentari tra cui SERFF, iFile, NILS e ISOnet, nonché applicazioni Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook e SharePoint)

• Conoscenza e comprensione delle operazioni di Assicurazione e dell'ambiente normativo più ampio, compresa la familiarità con i Circoli di Bureau (ad esempio, ISO, AAIS)
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Esperienza con SharePoint , incluse librerie di documenti, controllo delle versioni e funzionalità di collaborazione a supporto della documentazione operativa o regolamentare

• Grado universitario o equivalente esperienza lavorativa professionale in un campo correlato

• Forte negoziazione e capacità di risoluzione dei problemi, con la capacità di proporre abilmente risposte alle obiezioni di regolamentazione e alle richieste dei servizi assicurativi

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale, con la capacità di trasmettere con chiarezza e concisamente informazioni normative complesse

• Capacità dimostrata di gestire più progetti e scadenze contemporaneamente con un elevato grado di precisione e attenzione ai dettagli

• Comfort ed esperienza che lavorano in un'organizzazione globale di matrice, interagire efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli

La posizione è flessibile per i nostri uffici Kansas City, MO o Windsor, CT. La nostra azienda utilizza un modello di lavoro ibrido che richiede almeno tre giorni in ufficio ogni settimana, con la possibilità di lavorare in loco a tempo pieno se preferito. Questa posizione non è idonea per il telelavoro a tempo pieno, l'assistenza di trasferimento o la sponsorizzazione del visto.

L'intervallo di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione è $52,000 a $78,000. Lo stipendio specifico offerto per questo, o qualsiasi dato ruolo, terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, la posizione del lavoro, la portata del ruolo, le qualifiche, la complessità/specializzazione/scarsità di talento, esperienza, istruzione e bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.
Informazioni su Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative alle grandi e medie multinazionali dalle nostre circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro una pace aggiuntiva della mente.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un luogo di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico al lavoro e alla loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto di ritorno alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Le decisioni sull'occupazione si basano esclusivamente sulle qualifiche di un individuo per la posizione in essere.

Durante il processo di reclutamento, su richiesta sono disponibili sistemazioni ragionevoli per disabili. Se contattato per un'intervista, si prega di informare il Recruiter/HR Professional dell'alloggio necessario.

Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Are you a detail-driven compliance professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-evolving regulatory environment? Do you love digging into the details, managing complex projects, and making a real impact across a global organization? If so, Swiss Re's Regulatory Operations team has an exciting opportunity for you!

About the Role
As a Compliance Associate on the Regulatory Operations team, you will play a vital role in supporting Swiss Re's North America product offerings and policy issuance. From the development and preparation of product filings through to implementation, you will be at the heart of ensuring regulatory compliance across multiple product lines. This is a role where no two days are the same — and where your contributions genuinely matter.
Key Responsibilities

• Support filing processes for rates, rules, and forms, assisting Regulatory Operations teammates throughout the full product filing life cycle

• Independently review and analyze bureau circulars (e.g., ISO, AAIS) to assess product and filing impact, communicate changes, and assist in completing required filing processes

• Manage referrals received via the forms analyst mailbox across all product lines, including formatting specifications and determination of appropriate filing action

• Maintain accuracy and integrity of Swiss Re's internal tracking system to ensure current, regulatory-compliant product filing information is always up to date

• Own and actively manage projects , taking initiative and participating in cross-functional projects as assigned

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Products, Underwriting, Legal, and other functional areas to ensure alignment and timely execution

• Provide competitor product and filing intelligence to business units upon request, supporting informed decision-making

About the Team

You'll be joining the Regulatory Operations Product Services team — a collaborative, skilled, and supportive group that provides regulatory compliance support to multiple Corporate Solutions businesses across the globe. Our team brings together a diverse set of expertise and works hand-in-hand with departments across the organization to meet state regulatory requirements and implement product and regulatory changes effectively.
What makes us unique? No two days are alike. We thrive in an ever-changing product and regulatory landscape, and we embrace that complexity as an opportunity to grow. We're a team that looks out for one another — we collaborate, train, and mentor new colleagues, and we're always pursuing ways to improve how we work. If you're looking for a team culture built on trust, curiosity, and continuous learning, you've found it.

About You
You are a self-starter with sharp critical thinking skills and a natural ability to anticipate challenges before they arise. You bring a proactive mindset, rolling up your sleeves and diving in with minimal supervision. Equally comfortable working independently or collaboratively in a global matrix environment, you communicate with confidence and clarity across all levels — from internal stakeholders to state regulatory authorities. You are organized, deadline-driven, and skilled at juggling multiple priorities without missing a beat.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 2–5 years of experience in insurance rate and form filing, policy issuance system implementation, or other insurance regulatory-related work

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word , including creation and formatting of tables and application of document styles to support regulatory filings and correspondence

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel , including creation of formulas and use of data formatting tools (e.g., filters, conditional formatting) for tracking and reporting purposes

• Proficiency with regulatory filing platforms including SERFF, iFile, NILS, and ISOnet, as well as Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint)

• Knowledge and understanding of Insurance Company operations and the broader regulatory environment, including familiarity with Bureau Circulars (e.g., ISO, AAIS)
These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with SharePoint , including document libraries, version control, and collaboration features in support of operational or regulatory documentation

• College degree or equivalent professional work experience in a related field

• Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills , with the ability to artfully propose responses to regulatory objections and insurance department inquiries

• Excellent written and oral communication skills , with the ability to convey complex regulatory information clearly and concisely

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail

• Comfort and experience working in a global matrix organization , interacting effectively with stakeholders at all levels

The position location is flexible to our Kansas City, MO or Windsor, CT offices. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework, relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $52,000 to $78,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role, will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sind Sie ein detailorientierter Compliance-Experte, der in einem schnelllebigen, sich ständig weiterentwickelnden regulatorischen Umfeld lebt? Lieben Sie es, sich mit den Details zu beschäftigen, komplexe Projekte zu verwalten und eine echte Wirkung in einer globalen Organisation zu erzielen? Wenn ja, hat das Regulatory Operations Team von Swiss Re eine spannende Gelegenheit für Sie!

Über die Rolle
Als Compliance Associate im Regulatory Operations Team spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung des nordamerikanischen Produktangebots und der Politikausgabe von Swiss Re. Von der Entwicklung und Vorbereitung von Produktanmeldungen bis hin zur Implementierung stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften über mehrere Produktlinien hinweg. Dies ist eine Rolle, in der keine zwei Tage gleich sind - und in der Ihre Beiträge wirklich wichtig sind.
Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Unterstützen Sie die Einreichungsprozesse für Tarife, Regeln und Formulare und unterstützen Sie Ihre Teamkollegen beim Regulatory Operations während des gesamten Lebenszyklus der Produktanmeldung.

• Überprüfen und analysieren Sie unabhängig Bürorundschreiben (z. B. ISO, AAIS), um die Auswirkungen von Produkten und Einreichungen zu bewerten, Änderungen zu kommunizieren und den Abschluss der erforderlichen Einreichungsprozesse zu unterstützen

• Verwalten Sie Empfehlungen, die über die Mailbox des Formularanalysten über alle Produktlinien erhalten werden, einschließlich Formatierungsspezifikationen und Festlegung geeigneter Einreichungsmaßnahmen

• Aufrechterhaltung der Genauigkeit und Integrität des internen Tracking-Systems von Swiss Re, um sicherzustellen, dass aktuelle, behördlich konforme Produktablageinformationen immer auf dem neuesten Stand sind

• Eigenes und aktives Verwalten von Projekten, Initiative ergreifen und an zugewiesenen funktionsübergreifenden Projekten teilnehmen

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern in den Bereichen Products, Underwriting, Legal und anderen Funktionsbereichen, um eine Abstimmung und zeitnahe Ausführung zu gewährleisten

• Bereitstellung von Konkurrenzprodukten und Einreichung von Informationen an Geschäftseinheiten auf Anfrage, Unterstützung der fundierten Entscheidungsfindung

Über das Team

Sie treten dem Regulatory Operations Product Services-Team bei - einer kollaborativen, qualifizierten und unterstützenden Gruppe, die mehrere Unternehmen von Corporate Solutions weltweit bei der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften unterstützt. Unser Team bringt ein vielfältiges Know-how zusammen und arbeitet Hand in Hand mit Abteilungen in der gesamten Organisation, um die staatlichen regulatorischen Anforderungen zu erfüllen und Produkt- und Regulierungsänderungen effektiv umzusetzen.
Was macht uns einzigartig? Keine zwei Tage sind gleich. Wir gedeihen in einer sich ständig verändernden Produkt- und Regulierungslandschaft und wir nehmen diese Komplexität als Chance zum Wachstum wahr. Wir sind ein Team, das aufeinander aufpasst - wir arbeiten zusammen, trainieren und betreuen neue Kollegen, und wir verfolgen immer Wege, unsere Arbeitsweise zu verbessern. Wenn Sie nach einer Teamkultur suchen, die auf Vertrauen, Neugier und kontinuierlichem Lernen basiert, haben Sie sie gefunden.

Über dich
Sie sind ein Selbststarter mit scharfen kritischen Denkfähigkeiten und einer natürlichen Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen zu antizipieren, bevor sie auftreten. Sie bringen eine proaktive Denkweise, krempeln die Ärmel hoch und tauchen mit minimaler Aufsicht ein. Ebenso komfortabel arbeiten unabhängig oder gemeinsam in einer globalen Matrix-Umgebung, kommunizieren Sie mit Vertrauen und Klarheit über alle Ebenen - von internen Stakeholdern zu staatlichen Regulierungsbehörden. Sie sind organisiert, termingesteuert und geschickt darin, mehrere Prioritäten zu jonglieren, ohne einen Beat zu verpassen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• 2-5 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Versicherungstarif und Formulareinreichung, Implementierung von Versicherungssystemen oder andere versicherungsrechtliche Tätigkeiten

• Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Word, einschließlich Erstellung und Formatierung von Tabellen und Anwendung von Dokumentstilen zur Unterstützung von behördlichen Einreichungen und Korrespondenz

• Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel, einschließlich der Erstellung von Formeln und der Verwendung von Datenformatierungstools (z. B. Filter, bedingte Formatierung) für Tracking- und Berichtszwecke

• Kenntnisse mit regulatorischen Einreichungsplattformen wie SERFF, iFile, NILS und ISOnet sowie Microsoft Office-Anwendungen (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook und SharePoint)

• Kenntnis und Verständnis der Geschäftstätigkeit von Versicherungsgesellschaften und des breiteren regulatorischen Umfelds, einschließlich der Vertrautheit mit Bureau Circulars (z. B. ISO, AAIS)
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Erfahrung mit SharePoint, einschließlich Dokumentbibliotheken, Versionskontrolle und Collaboration-Funktionen zur Unterstützung der operativen oder regulatorischen Dokumentation

• College-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung in einem verwandten Bereich

• Starke Verhandlungs- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, kunstvoll Antworten auf regulatorische Einwände und Anfragen der Versicherungsabteilung vorzuschlagen

• Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe regulatorische Informationen klar und prägnant zu vermitteln

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte und Termine gleichzeitig mit einem hohen Maß an Genauigkeit und Liebe zum Detail zu verwalten

• Komfort und Erfahrung in einer globalen Matrixorganisation, die effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen interagiert

Die Position Lage ist flexibel zu unseren Kansas City, MO oder Windsor, CT Büros. Unser Unternehmen verwendet ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das jede Woche mindestens drei Tage im Büro benötigt, mit der Option, bei Bedarf Vollzeit vor Ort zu arbeiten. Diese Position ist nicht für Vollzeit-Telearbeit, Umzugshilfe oder Visa-Sponsoring geeignet.

Die geschätzte Basisgehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt 52.000 bis 78.000 US-Dollar. Das spezifische Gehalt, das dafür oder eine bestimmte Rolle angeboten wird, berücksichtigt eine Reihe von Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Arbeitsplatz, den Umfang der Rolle, die Qualifikationen, die Komplexität / Spezialisierung / Knappheit von Talenten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Arbeitgeberbudget. Bei Swiss Re verfolgen wir einen „Gesamtvergütungsansatz, wenn wir Entschädigungsentscheidungen treffen. Dies bedeutet, dass wir alle Komponenten der Entschädigung in ihrer Gesamtheit (wie Grundlohn, kurz- und langfristige Anreize und angebotene Vorteile) bei der Festlegung der individuellen Entschädigung berücksichtigen.
Über Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen der versicherungsbasierten Risikoübertragung. Wir antizipieren und managen Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions ist der gewerbliche Versicherungszweig der Swiss Re Gruppe. Wir bieten innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittlere multinationale Konzerne an unseren rund 50 Standorten weltweit. Wir helfen Kunden, ihre Risikoexposition zu mindern, während unser branchenführender Schadenservice ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit bietet.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions umfasst einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, Ethnie, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Schweizer Re ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Es ist unsere Praxis, ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Alter, Schwangerschaft, sexuelle Orientierungen, Familienstand, Militärstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale zu rekrutieren, einzustellen und zu fördern. Entscheidungen über die Beschäftigung basieren ausschließlich auf den Qualifikationen einer Person für die zu besetzende Stelle.

Während des Rekrutierungsprozesses sind angemessene Unterkünfte für Behinderungen auf Anfrage verfügbar. Wenn Sie für ein Interview kontaktiert werden, informieren Sie bitte den Recruiter / HR Professional über die erforderliche Unterkunft.

Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

Êtes-vous un professionnel de la conformité axé sur les détails qui prospère dans un environnement réglementaire en constante évolution? Aimez-vous creuser dans les détails, gérer des projets complexes, et faire un impact réel dans une organisation mondiale? Si c'est le cas, l'équipe des opérations réglementaires de Swiss Re a une opportunité passionnante pour vous!

À propos du rôle
En tant qu'associé de conformité au sein de l'équipe des Opérations réglementaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour soutenir les offres de produits et la politique de Swiss Re en Amérique du Nord. Du développement et de la préparation des dépôts de produits jusqu'à la mise en oeuvre, vous serez au cœur de la conformité réglementaire à travers plusieurs gammes de produits. C'est un rôle où deux jours ne sont pas identiques — et où vos contributions comptent vraiment.
Principales responsabilités

• Appuyer les processus de classement des tarifs, des règles et des formulaires, aider les coéquipiers des Opérations réglementaires tout au long du cycle de vie du classement des produits

• Examiner et analyser indépendamment les circulaires du Bureau (p. ex. ISO, AAIS) afin d'évaluer l'incidence du produit et du dépôt, de communiquer les changements et d'aider à remplir les processus de dépôt requis.

• Gérer les renvois reçus par l'intermédiaire de la boîte aux lettres de l'analyste des formulaires dans toutes les gammes de produits, y compris les spécifications de formatage et la détermination des mesures de dépôt appropriées

• Maintenir l'exactitude et l'intégrité du système de suivi interne de Swiss Re afin de garantir que les informations actuelles et conformes à la réglementation sont toujours à jour.

• Posséder et gérer activement des projets , prendre des initiatives et participer à des projets transfonctionnels tels que assignés

• Collaborer avec les intervenants internes dans les domaines des produits, de la souscription, du droit et d'autres domaines fonctionnels pour assurer l'alignement et l'exécution en temps opportun

• Fournir, sur demande, des renseignements sur les produits concurrents et le dépôt de renseignements aux unités opérationnelles, en appuyant la prise de décisions éclairées

À propos de l'équipe

Vous vous joindrez à l'équipe des Services des produits d'opérations réglementaires, un groupe de collaboration, de compétence et de soutien qui offre un soutien en matière de conformité réglementaire à plusieurs entreprises de Solutions d'entreprise partout dans le monde. Notre équipe réunit un ensemble diversifié d'expertises et travaille main dans la main avec les ministères de l'ensemble de l'organisation afin de répondre aux exigences réglementaires de l'État et de mettre en oeuvre efficacement des changements de produits et de règlements.
Qu'est-ce qui nous rend uniques ? Deux jours se ressemblent. Nous prospérons dans un paysage de produits et de réglementation en constante évolution, et nous acceptons cette complexité comme une occasion de grandir. Nous sommes une équipe qui veille les uns sur les autres — nous collaborons, formons et mentorons de nouveaux collègues, et nous cherchons toujours des façons d'améliorer notre façon de travailler. Si vous recherchez une culture d'équipe fondée sur la confiance, la curiosité et l'apprentissage continu, vous l'avez trouvé.

À propos de toi
Vous êtes un auto-démarrage avec des compétences de pensée critique aiguë et une capacité naturelle d'anticiper les défis avant qu'ils surgissent. Vous apportez un état d'esprit proactif, roulez vos manches et plongez dans avec une supervision minimale. Tout aussi à l'aise de travailler de façon indépendante ou en collaboration dans un environnement matriciel mondial, vous communiquez avec confiance et clarté à tous les niveaux, des intervenants internes aux autorités réglementaires des États. Vous êtes organisé, déterminé par la date limite, et habile à jongler avec plusieurs priorités sans manquer un rythme.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans le classement des taux et des formulaires d'assurance, la mise en oeuvre du système d'émission de polices ou d'autres travaux liés à la réglementation de l'assurance

• Compétence avancée en Microsoft Word , y compris la création et le formatage de tableaux et l'application de styles de documents pour soutenir les dépôts réglementaires et la correspondance

• Compétences avancées en Microsoft Excel , y compris la création de formules et l'utilisation d'outils de formatage des données (p. ex. filtres, formatage conditionnel) à des fins de suivi et de rapport

• Compétence avec les plates-formes de dépôt réglementaires, notamment SERFF, iFile, NILS et ISOnet, ainsi que les applications Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook et SharePoint)

• Connaissance et compréhension des activités des compagnies d'assurance et de l'environnement réglementaire plus large, y compris la connaissance des circulaires du Bureau (p. ex. ISO, AAIS)
Ceux-ci sont supplémentaires agréables à avoir:

• Expérience avec SharePoint , y compris les bibliothèques de documents, le contrôle des versions et les fonctions de collaboration à l'appui de la documentation opérationnelle ou réglementaire

• Diplôme collégial ou expérience professionnelle équivalente dans un domaine connexe

• Forte capacité de négociation et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de proposer avec art des réponses aux objections réglementaires et aux demandes de renseignements des services d'assurance

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, avec la capacité de transmettre de l'information réglementaire complexe de façon claire et concise

• Capacité démontrée de gérer plusieurs projets et délais simultanément avec un degré élevé de précision et d'attention aux détails

• Confort et expérience dans une organisation matricielle mondiale , interaction efficace avec les parties prenantes à tous les niveaux

L'emplacement du poste est flexible pour nos bureaux de Kansas City, MO ou Windsor, CT. Notre entreprise utilise un modèle de travail hybride nécessitant au moins trois jours au bureau chaque semaine, avec la possibilité de travailler sur place à temps plein si vous le souhaitez. Ce poste n'est pas admissible au télétravail à temps plein, à l'aide à la réinstallation ou au parrainage de visa.

L'échelle salariale de base estimative pour ce poste est de 52 000 $ à 78 000 $. Le salaire spécifique offert pour ce poste, ou tout autre rôle donné, tiendra compte d'un certain nombre de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le lieu de travail, l'étendue du rôle, les qualifications, la complexité, la spécialisation ou l'absence de talents, l'expérience, les études et le budget de l'employeur. Chez Swiss Re, nous adoptons une «approche de la rémunération totale» pour prendre des décisions en matière de rémunération. Cela signifie que nous considérons toutes les composantes de la rémunération dans leur ensemble (comme la rémunération de base, les incitatifs à court et à long terme et les avantages offerts) dans l'établissement de la rémunération individuelle.
À propos de Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance. Nous anticipons et gérons les risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions est la branche assurance commerciale du Groupe Swiss Re. About the role

 We seek a colleague who is passionate about providing a holistic client management approach with a focus on Casualty Underwriting.
 The Underwriter will play a critical role in shaping Swiss Re's casualty and specialty lines portfolio in one of the world's fastest-growing insurance markets. You will combine deep casualty underwriting expertise with strategic client engagement to drive profitable growth and portfolio resilience.
 This role will also provide opportunity to contribute to portfolio management and lead client management for assigned clients.
 Key responsibilities may include
 Underwriting Responsibilities

• End-to-end underwriting analysis of core Casualty business including risk selection, pricing, contracts review and structuring;

• Evaluation of treaties, decisive actions within your assigned treaties to meet standards and guidelines

• Lead or support deep-dive pricing and underwriting projects, often involving cross-regional teams and shared expertise.
 Client Engagement & Market Insight

• Own and develop relationships with designated insurers and brokers, acting as the primary Swiss Re underwriting representative and trusted advisor for casualty-related reinsurance solutions.

• Grow the core business by developing opportunities in the portfolio in collaboration with relevant specialists and driving toward the principle of "right service right client"

• Anticipate and understanding competitor products as well as industry, economic and market trends

• Maintain and share industry and product know-how, helping the team stay ahead of market trends and emerging developments.

• Lead renewal negotiations and identify opportunities for portfolio expansion through data-driven underwriting insights.
 Strategic & Technical Contributions

• Supporting the P&C UW Head in portfolio steering, transformational underwriting initiatives and underwriting excellence activities to achieve best-in-class treaty business

• Monitor the performance of current accounts and portfolios, identifying opportunities for improvement and providing recommendations.

• Serve as the Casualty subject matter expert for the India team, providing technical leadership, mentoring and thought leadership on emerging casualty trends and market developments.
 About the team
 Our vision is to be integral to the long-term success of our clients. We aspire to be a market leading player in leveraging our global knowledge and local insights, focused on high performance, teamwork, and shared success.
 Come join a team of underwriters that are smart, dedicated and thrive on building the best portfolio in the market! We believe in teamwork, supporting one another and an exciting journey to success.
 About You
 You have strong interpersonal and teamwork skills, and pride yourself on your analytical and organizational skills. You have exceptional communication and client management skills that help you build and develop relationships with clients and brokers

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in insurance/reinsurance Casualty underwriting, portfolio and/or client management

• Experience in casualty underwriting, liability lines, motor liability, personal accident or specialty casualty portfolios.

• Strong quantitative/analytical skills, underwriting judgement and experience with risk selection/evaluation as well as a flair for wording and costing issues

• Understanding of the end-to-end (re)insurance value chain and relevant market knowledge (e.g. trends, competitors, capital markets context)

• Ability to combine data-driven insights with sound underwriting judgment.

• Proven client-facing and negotiation skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset (sense of urgency, cost consciousness and personal risk taking), committed to sustainable performance and continuous improvement

• Organizational/project management skills, ability to manage peak period workload

• Proactive learner who engages in emerging topics and contributes team-wide expertise

• Ability to work independently as well as to collaborate in a team environment

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Are you a highly motivated individual looking for an exciting opportunity to join our Commercial Property underwriting team in Chicago, Illinois -- Houston, Texas -- or Dallas, Texas? If you are looking for a prominent role where you can utilize your expertise and market knowledge in PROPERTY UNDERWRITING, we want to hear from you!

About the Role :
 Our Property Team is looking for a property underwriter with recognized experience and visibility in the Commercial Property insurance market and a successful track record in underwriting both global and domestic large, enterprise-sized corporations.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Manage a portfolio of accounts including fronted global property programs

• Analyze and underwrite exposures including Natural Catastrophe hazards

• Assess technical insurability regarding exposures and coverages on new offer and renewal submissions

• Prepare quotations, structure programs, and offer proposals in accordance with guidelines

• Use Swiss Re tools and systems for the development of terms and conditions

• Enter and maintain risk information into the various information systems and administer the accounts

• Establish and maintain a book of business as well as marketing and originating prospects

• Coach less experienced underwriters when necessary

• Lead internal (technical/organizational) and/or external (market/client development) projects

• Represent Swiss Re in meetings with clients, brokers, and other Swiss Re Group entities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers, clients and team members

• Technical analysis of manmade and Nat Cat property exposures as well as policy terms and pricing metrics

• Structuring capacity deployment and negotiating key terms that align with our underwriting strategy
 About the Team :
 We are a diverse and inclusive team that works well in a collaborative environment while fostering and developing independent thought. Our team works with brokers situated in the Central Region of the United States. North American Retail Property is a foundational line of business for SwissRe Corporate Solutions that is at the core of our strong brand. Risk transfer solutions offered through this channel vary from ground up quota share, shared and layered, and single carrier placements. This team also works with our alternative risk transfer group to structure innovative and unique solutions for our clients and brokers.
 About You :
 You are a strong communicator, able to build partnerships with external customers and internal co-workers. You are an initiative-taker, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, team-focused environment, and deliver on tight deadlines. You are a strong negotiator, results oriented, and take responsibility for your decisions. We expect you to have the following business experience and skills:

• Minimum of 4-10 years' experience as an underwriter (of medium to large corporate accounts)

• Experience in the structuring and fronting of global programs (preferred - not a must have)

• Experience working with Captives also a plus

• Knowledge of complex shared and layered program structures as well as 100% Single Carrier business

• Skills working across diverse occupancies including heavy manufacturing preferred

• In depth knowledge of insurance and commercial property underwriting in the central region

• Proficiency in the use of underwriting tools, applications, and guidelines

• Strong broker and client network in the local region

• Solid experience and understanding of Nat Cat and man-made risk management and loss prevention

• Negotiating skills and the ability to handle multiple deals in parallel
 Some travel within the region, including air travel, for client/broker meetings will be required. The role could be located in our Chicago, IL -- Houston TX -- or Dallas TX offices. Swiss Re has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office three days per week. The estimated base salary range for the Senior Underwriter level is $156,000 to $234,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account many factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity, specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
