jobs.description:
Valuation Actuary
 Are you an actuarial professional with a passion for Life & Health reinsurance and a drive to make a real impact in one of Asia's most dynamic markets? Join Swiss Re's Actuarial Reserving team in Tokyo and play a pivotal role in shaping the financial future of our Japan L&H portfolio.

About the Role
 As a Valuation Actuary at Swiss Re Japan, you will be at the heart of our Life & Health valuation activities, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of policy liabilities across multiple reporting frameworks. This is a role where technical excellence meets business acumen — you'll collaborate across functions, engage with regulators, and contribute meaningfully to the management of a sophisticated in-force portfolio in one of the world's most important insurance markets.
 Key Responsibilities

• Perform quarterly reserving and reporting processes for L&H business in Japan, ensuring outputs are timely, accurate, and reflective of evolving business needs

• Ensure in-force data quality and proper determination of policy liabilities across IFRS, JGAAP, Singapore Statutory, and Swiss Statutory frameworks

• Monitor and communicate the performance of Japan and assigned L&H business portfolios to key stakeholders

• Track and interpret JFSA regulatory requirements , with a particular focus on economic solvency and actuarial standards, ensuring Swiss Re remains ahead of regulatory developments

• Support cross-functional engagement with internal teams including Portfolio Management, Technical Accounting, Risk Management, and Finance to drive effective in-force portfolio management

• Facilitate the actuarial feedback loop from valuation to pricing by liaising closely with Client Markets and Pricing teams across Asia

• Collaborate with external clients and regulators to support transparent and effective management of L&H in-force portfolios

• Contribute to a strong team culture , proactively fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing within the Actuarial Reserving team

About the Team
 Reporting to the Head of Reporting & Analysis Japan within the Life & Health Valuation Actuarial Asia function, you will be a key contributor to the Actuarial Reserving team dedicated to the Japan market. This team sits within the broader L&H Finance division at Swiss Re, which is responsible for managing in-force business across the region.
 The Valuation Actuarial team in Asia is a trusted partner to Swiss Re's L&H business, delivering high-quality financial information and expert advice on past performance and expected future profitability. The team works in close collaboration with business origination functions — including Client Markets and Pricing — as well as other units within the L&H Finance division, creating a rich, interdependent network of expertise.
 This is a team that values intellectual curiosity, solutions-oriented thinking, and a collaborative spirit. You will be encouraged to proactively engage with cross-functional partners and to help drive the delivery of Swiss Re's overall in-force management mandate in Japan.

About You
 We are looking for a technically strong and commercially minded actuarial professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You bring a solutions-oriented mindset, the ability to communicate complex actuarial concepts clearly to diverse audiences, and a genuine enthusiasm for the Life & Health reinsurance space. You are comfortable navigating regulatory landscapes and building strong relationships across functions and cultures.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• At least 3 years of L&H valuation or pricing experience in reinsurance, primary insurance, or insurance consultancy

• Good progress in actuarial examinations (e.g., towards fellowship with a recognized actuarial body)

• Working-level understanding of at least one of the following reporting frameworks: IFRS, JGAAP, or Singapore Statutory

• Strong technical knowledge and proficiency in actuarial modelling systems , with the ability to analyze and interpret large volumes of data

• Native-level Japanese language skills and basic English communication ability
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in corporate actuarial functions within a reinsurance or insurance environment

• Familiarity with multiple reporting frameworks (IFRS, JGAAP, Singapore Statutory, and/or Swiss Statutory)

• Demonstrated ability to balance rigorous technical requirements with a business-oriented mindset

• Experience liaising with regulators , particularly the JFSA, or working on economic solvency-related projects

• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills , with a track record of effective cross-functional collaboration

• Proficiency in data tools and programming languages used in actuarial analysis (e.g., Prophet, R, Python, or similar)

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Attuario di valutazione
Sei un professionista attuariale con una passione per la riassicurazione vita e salute e un'iniziativa per fare un impatto reale in uno dei mercati più dinamici dell'Asia? Partecipa al team Actuarial Reserving di Swiss Re a Tokyo e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione del futuro finanziario del nostro portafoglio L&H Giappone.

Informazioni sul ruolo
In qualità di Valuation Actuary presso Swiss Re Japan, sarai al centro delle nostre attività di valutazione Life & Health, assicurando l'integrità e l'accuratezza delle passività politiche in più ambiti di reporting. Questo è un ruolo in cui l'eccellenza tecnica incontra l'acumen aziendale - collaborerai attraverso le funzioni, ti impegni con i regolatori e contribuirai in modo significativo alla gestione di un sofisticato portafoglio in-force in uno dei mercati assicurativi più importanti del mondo.
Principali responsabilità

• Eseguire processi trimestrali di conservazione e reporting per L&H business in Giappone, assicurando che i risultati siano tempestivi, accurati e riflessivi delle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione

• Assicurare la qualità dei dati in vigore e la corretta determinazione delle passività politiche attraverso IFRS, JGAAP, Singapore Statutory e Swiss Statutory frameworks

• Monitorare e comunicare le prestazioni del Giappone e assegnare portafogli aziendali L&H a stakeholder chiave

• Tracciare e interpretare i requisiti normativi JFSA, con particolare attenzione alla solvibilità economica e agli standard attuariali, assicurando che Swiss Re rimanga davanti agli sviluppi normativi

• Supporta l'impegno cross-funzionale con i team interni tra cui Portfolio Management, Technical Accounting, Risk Management e Finance per guidare una gestione efficace del portafoglio

• Facilitare il loop di feedback attuariale dalla valutazione ai prezzi, legandosi a stretto contatto con i Mercati del cliente e i team di prezzi in tutta l'Asia

• Collabora con clienti esterni e regolatori per supportare una gestione trasparente ed efficace dei portafogli L&H in-force

• Contribuire a una forte cultura del team, promuovendo proattivamente la collaborazione e la condivisione delle conoscenze all'interno del team Actuarial Reserving

Informazioni sulla squadra
Segnalando al capo di Reporting & Analysis Japan all'interno della funzione Life & Health Valuation Actuarial Asia, sarai un contributore chiave al team di riserva Actuarial dedicato al mercato giapponese. Questa squadra si trova all'interno della più ampia divisione L&H Finance di Swiss Re, che è responsabile della gestione delle attività di forza in tutta la regione.
Il team di Valuation Actuarial in Asia è un partner affidabile per il business L&H di Swiss Re, fornendo informazioni finanziarie di alta qualità e consigli esperti sulle prestazioni passate e sulla redditività futura prevista. Il team lavora in stretta collaborazione con le funzioni di origine aziendale, tra cui Client Markets and Pricing, così come altre unità della divisione L&H Finance, creando una ricca e interdipendente rete di competenze.
Questo è un team che valorizza la curiosità intellettuale, il pensiero orientato alle soluzioni e uno spirito collaborativo. Sarete incoraggiati a impegnarsi proattivamente con partner interfunzionali e ad aiutare a guidare la consegna del mandato generale di gestione delle forze in-force di Swiss Re in Giappone.

A proposito di te
Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista attuariale tecnicamente forte e commercialmente pensato che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce. Porti una mentalità orientata alle soluzioni, la capacità di comunicare concetti attuariali complessi chiaramente a diversi pubblico, e un autentico entusiasmo per lo spazio Life & Health di riassicurazione. Sei comodo navigare paesaggi normativi e costruire relazioni forti tra funzioni e culture.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Almeno 3 anni di valutazione L&H o esperienza di prezzo in riassicurazione, assicurazione primaria o consulenza assicurativa

• Buoni progressi negli esami attuariali (ad esempio, verso la comunione con un organismo attuariale riconosciuto)

• Comprensione a livello di lavoro di almeno uno dei seguenti quadri di rendicontazione: IFRS, JGAAP o Singapore Statutory

• Forte conoscenza tecnica e competenza nei sistemi di modellazione attuariale , con la capacità di analizzare e interpretare grandi volumi di dati

• competenze linguistiche giapponesi di livello nativo e capacità di comunicazione inglese di base
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Esperienza nelle funzioni attuariali aziendali all'interno di un ambiente di assicurazione

• Familiarità con più rapporti (IFRS, JGAAP, Singapore Statutory e/o Swiss Statutory)

• Capacità dimostrata di bilanciare rigorosi requisiti tecnici con una mentalità orientata al business

• Sperimentare l'esperienza con i regolatori, in particolare il JFSA, o lavorare su progetti legati alla solvibilità economica

• Forte capacità di gestione interpersonale e degli stakeholder, con un track record di collaborazione interfunzionale efficace

• La competenza negli strumenti di dati e nei linguaggi di programmazione utilizzati nell'analisi attuariale (ad esempio, Profeta, R, Python o simili)

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Bewertungsaktuar
Sind Sie ein versicherungsmathematischer Fachmann mit einer Leidenschaft für Life & Health Rückversicherung und dem Antrieb, in einem der dynamischsten Märkte Asiens wirklich etwas zu bewirken? Treten Sie dem Actuarial Re Reservierungsteam in Tokio bei und spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung der finanziellen Zukunft unseres L&H-Portfolios in Japan.

Über die Rolle
Als Valuation Actuary bei Swiss Re Japan stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt unserer Life & Health-Bewertungsaktivitäten und gewährleisten die Integrität und Genauigkeit der Versicherungsverpflichtungen über mehrere Berichtsrahmen hinweg. Dies ist eine Rolle, in der technische Exzellenz auf Geschäftssinn trifft - Sie arbeiten funktionsübergreifend zusammen, engagieren sich mit Regulierungsbehörden und tragen sinnvoll zum Management eines ausgereiften Portfolios in einem der wichtigsten Versicherungsmärkte der Welt bei.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Durchführung von vierteljährlichen Reservierungs- und Berichtsprozessen für das L&H-Geschäft in Japan, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ergebnisse zeitnah, korrekt und den sich ändernden Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen

• Gewährleistung der Qualität der geltenden Daten und der ordnungsgemäßen Bestimmung der Versicherungspolicen über IFRS, JGAAP, Singapur und die Schweiz

• Überwachung und Kommunikation der Performance von Japan und zugewiesenen L&H-Geschäftsportfolios an wichtige Stakeholder

• Verfolgen und interpretieren Sie die aufsichtsrechtlichen Anforderungen der JFSA, mit besonderem Fokus auf wirtschaftliche Solvenz und versicherungsmathematische Standards, um sicherzustellen, dass Swiss Re den regulatorischen Entwicklungen voraus ist

• Unterstützung des funktionsübergreifenden Engagements mit internen Teams, einschließlich Portfoliomanagement, technisches Rechnungswesen, Risikomanagement und Finanzen, um ein effektives In-Force-Portfoliomanagement zu fördern

• Erleichterung der versicherungsmathematischen Feedbackschleife von der Bewertung bis zur Preisgestaltung durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kundenmärkten und Preisteams in ganz Asien

• Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kunden und Aufsichtsbehörden zur Unterstützung eines transparenten und effektiven Managements von L&H-Inforce-Portfolios

• Tragen Sie zu einer starken Teamkultur bei und fördern Sie proaktiv die Zusammenarbeit und den Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Actuarial Reserving Teams

Über das Team
Wenn Sie dem Head of Reporting & Analysis Japan im Rahmen der Funktion Life & Health Valuation Actuarial Asia berichten, werden Sie ein wichtiger Beitrag zum Actuarial Reserving-Team leisten, das sich dem japanischen Markt widmet. Dieses Team sitzt in der breiteren L&H Finance Division von Swiss Re, die für das Management des In-force-Geschäfts in der gesamten Region verantwortlich ist.
Das Valuation Actuarial-Team in Asien ist ein zuverlässiger Partner des L&H-Geschäfts von Swiss Re und liefert qualitativ hochwertige Finanzinformationen und fachkundige Beratung zu früheren Leistungen und erwarteter zukünftiger Rentabilität. Das Team arbeitet in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Business Origination-Funktionen – einschließlich Client Markets und Pricing – sowie anderen Einheiten innerhalb der L&H Finance-Division und schafft ein reichhaltiges, voneinander abhängiges Netzwerk von Fachwissen.
Dies ist ein Team, das intellektuelle Neugier, lösungsorientiertes Denken und einen kooperativen Geist schätzt. Sie werden ermutigt, proaktiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zusammenzuarbeiten und die Umsetzung des gesamten Inforce-Management-Mandats von Swiss Re in Japan voranzutreiben.

Über dich
Wir suchen einen technisch starken und kaufmännischen Versicherungsmathematiker, der in einer kollaborativen, schnelllebigen Umgebung lebt. Sie bringen eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise, die Fähigkeit, komplexe versicherungsmathematische Konzepte klar an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen zu kommunizieren, und eine echte Begeisterung für den Life & Health Rückversicherungsbereich mit. Sie navigieren bequem durch regulatorische Landschaften und bauen starke Beziehungen über Funktionen und Kulturen hinweg auf.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Mindestens 3 Jahre L&H Bewertungs- oder Preiserfahrung in der Rückversicherung, Erstversicherung oder Versicherungsberatung

• Gute Fortschritte bei versicherungsmathematischen Prüfungen (z. B. in Richtung Gemeinschaft mit einem anerkannten versicherungsmathematischen Körper)

• Verständnis auf Arbeitsebene für mindestens einen der folgenden Berichtsrahmen: IFRS, JGAAP oder Singapur

• Starkes technisches Wissen und Kenntnisse in versicherungsmathematischen Modellierungssystemen mit der Fähigkeit, große Datenmengen zu analysieren und zu interpretieren

• Muttersprachliche japanische Sprachkenntnisse und grundlegende englische Kommunikationsfähigkeit
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Erfahrung in versicherungsmathematischen Funktionen von Unternehmen in einem Rückversicherungs- oder Versicherungsumfeld

• Vertrautheit mit mehreren Berichtsrahmen (IFRS, JGAAP, Singapore Statutory und/oder Swiss Actory)

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, strenge technische Anforderungen mit einer geschäftsorientierten Denkweise in Einklang zu bringen

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Regulierungsbehörden, insbesondere der JFSA, oder in der Arbeit an Projekten im Zusammenhang mit wirtschaftlicher Solvenz

• Starke zwischenmenschliche und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz der effektiven funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit

• Kenntnisse in Datenwerkzeugen und Programmiersprachen, die in der versicherungsmathematischen Analyse verwendet werden (z. B. Prophet, R, Python oder ähnliches)

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

Actuaire de valorisation
Êtes-vous un professionnel actuariel avec une passion pour la réassurance Life & Health et un effort pour faire un impact réel sur l'un des marchés les plus dynamiques d'Asie? Rejoignez l'équipe de Swiss Re Actuarial Reserving à Tokyo et jouez un rôle central dans l'élaboration de l'avenir financier de notre portefeuille de L&H au Japon.

À propos du rôle
En tant qu'actuaire d'évaluation chez Swiss Re Japan, vous serez au cœur de nos activités d'évaluation Life & Health, assurant l'intégrité et l'exactitude des engagements stratégiques dans plusieurs cadres de déclaration. Il s'agit d'un rôle où l'excellence technique rencontre le sens des affaires, où vous collaborerez à l'ensemble des fonctions, collaborerez avec les organismes de réglementation et contribuerez de façon significative à la gestion d'un portefeuille en vigueur sophistiqué sur l'un des marchés d'assurance les plus importants au monde.
Principales responsabilités

• Effectuer des processus trimestriels de réservation et de rapport pour les activités de L&H au Japon, en veillant à ce que les extrants soient opportuns, exacts et adaptés à l'évolution des besoins opérationnels.

• Assurer la qualité des données en vigueur et la bonne détermination des engagements de politique générale dans les cadres IFRS, JGAAP, Singapour et Suisse

• Surveiller et communiquer les résultats du Japon et les portefeuilles d'activités de L&H attribués aux principaux intervenants

• Suivre et interpréter les exigences réglementaires des JFSA , en mettant l'accent sur la solvabilité économique et les normes actuarielles , en veillant à ce que Swiss Re reste en avance sur les évolutions réglementaires

• Appuyer l'engagement interfonctionnel avec les équipes internes, y compris la gestion du portefeuille, la comptabilité technique, la gestion des risques et les finances, afin de favoriser une gestion efficace du portefeuille en vigueur

• Faciliter la boucle de rétroaction actuarielle de l'évaluation à l'établissement des prix en assurant une liaison étroite avec les équipes des marchés clients et des prix dans toute l'Asie

• Collaborer avec les clients externes et les organismes de réglementation afin d'appuyer la gestion transparente et efficace des portefeuilles en vigueur en L-H

• Contribuer à une solide culture d'équipe , favorisant proactivement la collaboration et le partage des connaissances au sein de l'équipe de réserve actuarielle

À propos de l'équipe
Rendre compte au responsable de Reporting & Analysis Japan dans le cadre de la fonction Life & Health Valuement Actuarial Asia, vous serez un contributeur clé de l'équipe Actuarial Reserving dédiée au marché japonais. Cette équipe fait partie de la division des finances de L&H à Swiss Re, qui est responsable de la gestion des affaires en vigueur dans toute la région.
L'équipe d'Evaluation Actuarial en Asie est un partenaire de confiance de l'activité L&H de Swiss Re, fournissant des informations financières de haute qualité et des conseils d'experts sur les performances passées et la rentabilité future attendue. L'équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec les fonctions d'origine des entreprises, y compris les marchés clients et la tarification, ainsi qu'avec d'autres unités de la division des finances de L&H, créant ainsi un riche réseau interdépendant d'expertise.
C'est une équipe qui valorise la curiosité intellectuelle, la pensée axée sur les solutions et un esprit de collaboration. Vous serez encouragé à vous engager activement avec des partenaires interfonctionnels et à contribuer à la réalisation de l'ensemble du mandat de gestion en vigueur de Swiss Re au Japon.

À propos de toi
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel de l'actuariat techniquement fort et commercialisé qui prospère dans un environnement collaboratif et rapide. Vous apportez un état d'esprit axé sur les solutions, la capacité de communiquer clairement des concepts actuariels complexes à divers publics et un véritable enthousiasme pour l'espace de réassurance Life & Health. Vous êtes à l'aise de naviguer dans des paysages réglementaires et d'établir de solides relations entre les fonctions et les cultures.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en matière d'évaluation ou de tarification en réassurance, en assurance primaire ou en conseil en assurance

• Bons progrès dans les examens actuariels (par exemple, vers des bourses d ' études avec un organisme actuariel reconnu)

• Compréhension au niveau opérationnel d'au moins un des cadres d'information suivants: IFRS, JGAAP ou Singapour Statutaire

• Fortes connaissances techniques et compétences dans les systèmes de modélisation actuarielle , avec la capacité d'analyser et d'interpréter de grands volumes de données

• Compétences en langue japonaise et capacité de communication de base en anglais
Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Expérience des fonctions actuarielles des entreprises dans un environnement de réassurance ou d'assurance

• Familiarisation avec plusieurs cadres de déclaration (IFRS, JGAAP, Singapour Statutaire et/ou Suisse Statutaire)

• Capacité démontrée d'équilibrer des exigences techniques rigoureuses avec un état d'esprit orienté vers l'entreprise

• Expérience de la liaison avec les régulateurs , en particulier l'EFCJ , ou travail sur des projets liés à la solvabilité économique

• Fortes compétences en gestion des relations interpersonnelles et des parties prenantes , avec une expérience de collaboration interfonctionnelle efficace

• Connaissance des outils de données et des langages de programmation utilisés dans l'analyse actuarielle (p. ex. Prophète, R, Python, ou similaire)

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Nous couvrons à la fois Propriété & Casualty et Vie & Santé. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

About the role
 The Azure Application Hosting team at Swiss Re is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a focus on Kubernetes and Azure Cloud. In this role, you'll engage in Infrastructure as Code, automation, and application hosting using Kubernetes. Your main responsibility will be to manage and improve our shared application hosting platform for various types of applications in the Azure cloud.
 A significant part of your role involves the further engineering of the platform, but also ensuring the stability and operability of the platform. This includes automating operational processes as much as possible. You will also participate in an on-call rotation, approximately once every two months, to handle high-priority incidents, with the frequency expected to decrease as our team grows .
 Your work will include managing a managed PaaS platform, covering aspects like fully automated secret management, storage, and identity management for application teams. You'll also be involved in migrating new applications to the public cloud and optimizing existing setups.
 The team is based in Zürich, Switzerland, and Madrid, Spain. We're looking for someone who is ready to contribute to our team's efforts and support Swiss Re's cloud initiatives.
 About you
 Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of requirements. If you however meet some of the criteria below and are genuinely curious about the world of public cloud and application hosting, we will be happy to meet you.
 To be successful in the role, you need to have these technical skills and knowledge:

• Experience in Kubernetes and generally application hosting

• Experience in public cloud, mainly Azure

• Knowledge of interacting with API and CLI interfaces

• Knowledge of programming language Golang and Bash/Powershell

• Passion for learning and innovating
 If you also have the following experience and interests, it is a huge plus:

• Background in software engineering or application design

• Knowledge of and/or interest in pulumi for IaC

• Knowledge of and/or interest in platform and application security

• Experience in corporate/enterprise technical landscapes
 If you join us, you will be able to participate in a variety of interesting initiatives.
 For example you will:
 Build infrastructure and a platform that allow Swiss Re units to:

• help improve the life of farmers in Brazil with image recognition based on satellite data.

• build models to predict life expectancy or predict the CO2 footprint of companies.

• support many other exciting projects in a collaborative environment with colleagues from Swiss Re's international offices.
 You will work in a team building new cutting-edge solutions cloud infrastructure solutions, with 5 mentors to support your learning.
 We are a diverse team and our passion to learn is what connects us. We are looking for a person who loves to learn and we will support you in this journey! We reserve time for studying and attending conferences, and we organize our own upskilling sessions as well. In addition to projects for our clients, we also work on innovation projects which allow us to learn new methodologies and gain fresh experience.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,800 and EUR 4,600 per month (for a full-time role).
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience. In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements.
 Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Informazioni sul ruolo
Il team Azure Application Hosting di Swiss Re sta cercando un Cloud Engineer con un focus su Kubernetes e Azure Cloud. In questo ruolo, vi impegnate in Infrastructure come Codice, automazione e applicazioni hosting utilizzando Kubernetes. La vostra responsabilità principale sarà di gestire e migliorare la nostra piattaforma di hosting di applicazioni condivise per vari tipi di applicazioni nel cloud Azure.
Una parte significativa del vostro ruolo coinvolge l'ulteriore ingegneria della piattaforma, ma anche garantire la stabilità e l'operabilità della piattaforma. Questo include automatizzare i processi operativi il più possibile. Parteciperai anche a una rotazione on-call, approssimativamente una volta ogni due mesi, per gestire incidenti ad alta priorità, con la frequenza prevista per diminuire come il nostro team cresce.
Il vostro lavoro includerà la gestione di una piattaforma PaaS gestita, coprendo aspetti come la gestione segreta completamente automatizzata, lo storage e la gestione dell'identità per i team di applicazioni. Sarete anche coinvolti nella migrazione di nuove applicazioni al cloud pubblico e nell'ottimizzazione delle impostazioni esistenti.
La squadra ha sede a Zurigo, Svizzera e Madrid, Spagna. Stiamo cercando qualcuno pronto a contribuire agli sforzi del nostro team e a sostenere le iniziative cloud di Swiss Re.
Su di te
Nessuno è perfetto e soddisfa il 100% dei requisiti. Se tuttavia soddisfate alcuni dei criteri qui sotto e siete veramente curiosi del mondo del cloud pubblico e dell'hosting delle applicazioni, saremo lieti di incontrarvi.
Per avere successo nel ruolo, è necessario avere queste competenze tecniche e conoscenze:

• Esperienza in Kubernetes e generalmente hosting di applicazioni

• Esperienza nel cloud pubblico, principalmente Azure

• Conoscenza dell'interazione con le interfacce API e CLI

• Conoscenza del linguaggio di programmazione Golang e Bash/Powershell

• Passione per l'apprendimento e l'innovazione
Se avete anche la seguente esperienza e interessi, è un grande vantaggio:

• Background in ingegneria del software o progettazione delle applicazioni

• Conoscenza e/o interesse di pulumi per IaC

• Conoscenza e/o interesse per la sicurezza della piattaforma e delle applicazioni

• Esperienza nei paesaggi tecnici aziendali/imprese
Se vi unirete a noi, sarete in grado di partecipare a una varietà di iniziative interessanti.
Per esempio:
Costruisci infrastrutture e una piattaforma che permettono alle unità Swiss Re di:

• contribuire a migliorare la vita degli agricoltori in Brasile con il riconoscimento delle immagini basato sui dati satellitari.

• costruire modelli per prevedere l'aspettativa di vita o prevedere l'impronta di CO2 delle aziende.

• supporta molti altri progetti entusiasmanti in un ambiente collaborativo con colleghi degli uffici internazionali di Swiss Re.
Potrai lavorare in un team che costruisce nuove soluzioni all'avanguardia soluzioni infrastruttura cloud, con 5 mentori per supportare il tuo apprendimento.
Siamo una squadra diversa e la nostra passione per imparare è ciò che ci collega. Stiamo cercando una persona che ama imparare e vi supporteremo in questo viaggio! Ci riserviamo il tempo per studiare e partecipare a conferenze, e organizziamo le nostre sessioni di upskilling pure. Oltre ai progetti per i nostri clienti, lavoriamo anche su progetti di innovazione che ci permettono di imparare nuove metodologie e di acquisire nuove esperienze.
Per la Slovacchia la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra 2.800 euro e 4.600 euro al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno).
Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:
• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,
• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza. Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati.
Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione. L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

About the role
The Azure Application Hosting team at Swiss Re is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a focus on Kubernetes and Azure Cloud. In this role, you'll engage in Infrastructure as Code, automation, and application hosting using Kubernetes. Your main responsibility will be to manage and improve our shared application hosting platform for various types of applications in the Azure cloud.
A significant part of your role involves the further engineering of the platform, but also ensuring the stability and operability of the platform. This includes automating operational processes as much as possible. You will also participate in an on-call rotation, approximately once every two months, to handle high-priority incidents, with the frequency expected to decrease as our team grows .
Your work will include managing a managed PaaS platform, covering aspects like fully automated secret management, storage, and identity management for application teams. You'll also be involved in migrating new applications to the public cloud and optimizing existing setups.
The team is based in Zürich, Switzerland, and Madrid, Spain. We're looking for someone who is ready to contribute to our team's efforts and support Swiss Re's cloud initiatives.
About you
Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of requirements. If you however meet some of the criteria below and are genuinely curious about the world of public cloud and application hosting, we will be happy to meet you.
To be successful in the role, you need to have these technical skills and knowledge:

• Experience in Kubernetes and generally application hosting

• Experience in public cloud, mainly Azure

• Knowledge of interacting with API and CLI interfaces

• Knowledge of programming language Golang and Bash/Powershell

• Passion for learning and innovating
If you also have the following experience and interests, it is a huge plus:

• Background in software engineering or application design

• Knowledge of and/or interest in pulumi for IaC

• Knowledge of and/or interest in platform and application security

• Experience in corporate/enterprise technical landscapes
If you join us, you will be able to participate in a variety of interesting initiatives.
For example you will:
Build infrastructure and a platform that allow Swiss Re units to:

• help improve the life of farmers in Brazil with image recognition based on satellite data.

• build models to predict life expectancy or predict the CO2 footprint of companies.

• support many other exciting projects in a collaborative environment with colleagues from Swiss Re's international offices.
You will work in a team building new cutting-edge solutions cloud infrastructure solutions, with 5 mentors to support your learning.
We are a diverse team and our passion to learn is what connects us. We are looking for a person who loves to learn and we will support you in this journey! We reserve time for studying and attending conferences, and we organize our own upskilling sessions as well. In addition to projects for our clients, we also work on innovation projects which allow us to learn new methodologies and gain fresh experience.
For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,800 and EUR 4,600 per month (for a full-time role).
The specific salary offered considers:
• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience. In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements.
Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Über die Rolle
Das Azure Application Hosting Team von Swiss Re sucht einen Cloud Engineer mit Fokus auf Kubernetes und Azure Cloud. In dieser Rolle beschäftigen Sie sich mit Infrastructure as Code, Automatisierung und Application Hosting mit Kubernetes. Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, unsere Shared Application Hosting-Plattform für verschiedene Arten von Anwendungen in der Azure-Cloud zu verwalten und zu verbessern.
Ein wesentlicher Teil Ihrer Rolle beinhaltet das weitere Engineering der Plattform, aber auch die Gewährleistung der Stabilität und Funktionsfähigkeit der Plattform. Dazu gehört auch die größtmögliche Automatisierung von Betriebsprozessen. Sie werden auch an einer On-Call-Rotation teilnehmen, ungefähr einmal alle zwei Monate, um Vorfälle mit hoher Priorität zu behandeln, wobei erwartet wird, dass die Häufigkeit sinkt, wenn unser Team wächst.
Ihre Arbeit umfasst die Verwaltung einer verwalteten PaaS-Plattform und umfasst Aspekte wie vollautomatisches Geheimmanagement, Speicher- und Identitätsmanagement für Anwendungsteams. Sie sind auch an der Migration neuer Anwendungen in die Public Cloud und der Optimierung bestehender Setups beteiligt.
Das Team hat seinen Sitz in Zürich, Schweiz, und Madrid, Spanien. Wir suchen jemanden, der bereit ist, zu den Bemühungen unseres Teams beizutragen und die Cloud-Initiativen von Swiss Re zu unterstützen.
Über dich
Niemand ist perfekt und erfüllt 100% der Anforderungen. Wenn Sie jedoch einige der unten aufgeführten Kriterien erfüllen und wirklich neugierig auf die Welt des Public Cloud- und Application-Hosting sind, werden wir Sie gerne treffen.
Um in der Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, müssen Sie über diese technischen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse verfügen:

• Erfahrung in Kubernetes und generell Application Hosting

• Erfahrung in Public Cloud, hauptsächlich Azure

• Kenntnisse der Interaktion mit API- und CLI-Schnittstellen

• Kenntnisse der Programmiersprache Golang und Bash/Powershell

• Leidenschaft für Lernen und Innovation
Wenn Sie auch die folgenden Erfahrungen und Interessen haben, ist es ein großes Plus:

• Hintergrund in Software Engineering oder Application Design

• Wissen und / oder Interesse an Pulumi für IaC

• Kenntnis und/oder Interesse an Plattform- und Anwendungssicherheit

• Erfahrung in technischen Unternehmens-/Unternehmenslandschaften
Wenn Sie sich uns anschließen, können Sie an einer Vielzahl interessanter Initiativen teilnehmen.
Zum Beispiel:
Aufbau einer Infrastruktur und einer Plattform, die es Swiss Re Einheiten ermöglicht:

• helfen, das Leben der Landwirte in Brasilien mit der Bilderkennung auf der Grundlage von Satellitendaten zu verbessern.

• Modelle erstellen, um die Lebenserwartung oder den CO2-Fußabdruck von Unternehmen vorherzusagen.

• viele weitere spannende Projekte in einem kollaborativen Umfeld mit Kollegen aus den internationalen Niederlassungen von Swiss Re unterstützen.
Sie werden in einem Team arbeiten, das neue innovative Cloud-Infrastrukturlösungen mit 5 Mentoren entwickelt, um Ihr Lernen zu unterstützen.
Wir sind ein vielfältiges Team und unsere Leidenschaft zu lernen verbindet uns. Wir suchen eine Person, die gerne lernt und wir werden Sie auf dieser Reise unterstützen! Wir reservieren Zeit für das Studium und die Teilnahme an Konferenzen und organisieren auch unsere eigenen Weiterbildungssitzungen. Neben Projekten für unsere Kunden arbeiten wir auch an Innovationsprojekten, die es uns ermöglichen, neue Methoden zu erlernen und neue Erfahrungen zu sammeln.
Für die Slowakei liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen 2.800 EUR und 4.600 EUR pro Monat (für eine Vollzeitstelle).
Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:
• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Zuständigkeiten der Rolle,
• das Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung. Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive leistungsbasierte variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen würdigt.
Darüber hinaus genießen Sie eine Vielzahl von globalen und standortspezifischen Vorteilen. Die Berechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re Police und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Sur le rôle
L'équipe d'hébergement d'applications Azure de Swiss Re cherche un ingénieur Cloud mettant l'accent sur Kubernetes et Azure Cloud. Dans ce rôle, vous vous engagerez dans Infrastructure comme Code, automatisation et hébergement d'applications à l'aide de Kubernetes. Votre responsabilité principale sera de gérer et d'améliorer notre plateforme d'hébergement d'applications partagées pour différents types d'applications dans le cloud Azure.
Une partie importante de votre rôle implique la poursuite de l'ingénierie de la plate-forme, mais aussi assurer la stabilité et l'opérabilité de la plate-forme. Cela inclut l'automatisation des processus opérationnels autant que possible. Vous participerez également à une rotation sur appel, environ une fois tous les deux mois, pour gérer les incidents hautement prioritaires, avec la fréquence prévue pour diminuer à mesure que notre équipe augmente.
Votre travail comprendra la gestion d'une plateforme PaaS gérée, couvrant des aspects tels que la gestion secrète entièrement automatisée, le stockage et la gestion d'identité pour les équipes d'application. Vous serez également impliqué dans la migration de nouvelles applications vers le cloud public et l'optimisation des configurations existantes.
L'équipe est basée à Zurich, Suisse, et Madrid, Espagne. Nous recherchons une personne prête à contribuer aux efforts de notre équipe et à soutenir les initiatives cloud de Swiss Re.
Sur toi
Personne n'est parfait et répond à 100% des exigences. Si toutefois vous répondez à certains des critères ci-dessous et êtes vraiment curieux du monde du cloud public et de l'hébergement d'applications, nous serons heureux de vous rencontrer.
Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez posséder ces compétences et connaissances techniques :

• Expérience en Kubernetes et hébergement d'applications en général

• Expérience dans le cloud public, principalement Azure

• Connaissance de l'interaction avec les interfaces API et CLI

• Connaissance du langage de programmation Golang et Bach/Powershell

• Passion d'apprentissage et d'innovation
Si vous avez également l'expérience et les intérêts suivants, c'est un plus énorme:

• Contexte de l'ingénierie logicielle ou de la conception d'applications

• Connaissance et/ou intérêt pour les pulumi pour IaC

• Connaissance et/ou intérêt pour la sécurité des plateformes et des applications

• Expérience dans les paysages techniques des entreprises
Si vous vous joignez à nous, vous pourrez participer à diverses initiatives intéressantes.
Par exemple, vous devez :
Construisez une infrastructure et une plateforme qui permettent aux unités Swiss Re de:

• contribuer à améliorer la vie des agriculteurs brésiliens grâce à la reconnaissance d'images basées sur des données satellitaires.

• construire des modèles pour prédire l'espérance de vie ou l'empreinte CO2 des entreprises.

• soutenir de nombreux autres projets passionnants dans un environnement collaboratif avec des collègues des bureaux internationaux de Swiss Re.
Vous travaillerez dans une équipe de construction de nouvelles solutions d'infrastructure cloud de pointe, avec 5 mentors pour soutenir votre apprentissage.
Nous sommes une équipe diversifiée et notre passion pour apprendre est ce qui nous relie. Nous cherchons une personne qui aime apprendre et nous vous accompagnerons dans ce voyage! Nous réservons du temps pour étudier et assister aux conférences, et nous organisons nos propres séances de perfectionnement. En plus des projets pour nos clients, nous travaillons également sur des projets d'innovation qui nous permettent d'apprendre de nouvelles méthodologies et d'acquérir une nouvelle expérience.
Pour la Slovaquie, l'échelle des salaires de base pour ce poste se situe entre 2 800 et 4 600 euros par mois (pour un rôle à temps plein).

• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle,
• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience. En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations.
De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété d'avantages globaux et spécifiques à l'emplacement. L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.

Are you a seasoned claims professional with a passion for technical excellence and a drive to make a real difference in the Life & Health reinsurance space? If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and want to be at the heart of a dynamic team shaping the future of claims management across Asia Pacific, this could be the role for you.
 About the Role
 This is an exciting opportunity to join Swiss Re's Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit in Hong Kong as a Claims Specialist, where your technical expertise will directly influence the quality and integrity of claims decisions across the HKTW portfolio. You'll be a key contributor to a team that values precision, fairness, and continuous improvement — working at the intersection of client service, governance, and claims innovation.
 Reporting to the Head of L&H Underwriting, Claims & HNW for Hong Kong & Taiwan, you will play an instrumental role in delivering a meaningful, best-in-class claims service while sharing expertise with clients and internal stakeholders across the region.
 Key Responsibilities

• Maintain governance guidelines and quality control for a robust operation of HKTW L&H Claims and ensuring adherence to relevant frameworks and standards

• Manage and assess claims with technical rigor, delivering fair, accurate, and timely decisions that align with policy terms, conditions, and pricing assumptions

• Support Claims Reviews and Audits within the internal framework, providing actionable recommendations to improve both technical decision-making and operational efficiency to enhance clients' claims standards

• Support client engagement through visits and training sessions, enhancing the quality and effectiveness of claims management

• Support the development of training materials and programs tailored to client requirements and emerging industry topics

• Provide technical input on emerging issues and actively support process enhancement initiatives

• Maintain accountability for individual claim quality, accuracy, turnaround times, and a high standard of customer service
 About the Team
 The Underwriting and Claims team is part of Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit Hong Kong & Taiwan. The team is responsible for delivering disciplined, high-quality risk selection for HNW business while supporting sound management of the in-force portfolio. Working closely with cross-functional teams across L&H, the team applies deep underwriting expertise and portfolio insights to support strong new business margins, sustainable client solutions, and informed portfolio decisions — all while championing operational excellence, risk governance, and continuous improvement across the HNW underwriting value chain.
 About You
 You are a technically strong, detail-oriented claims professional who brings both depth of expertise and a collaborative spirit to everything you do. You are comfortable navigating complexity, engaging with clients, and contributing to a team culture that values curiosity, integrity, and continuous learning. You know how to balance the detail with the bigger picture — and you're not afraid to challenge the status quo when it leads to better outcomes.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• University degree or equivalent qualification in insurance, business, financial services, law, or a medical discipline

• 5+ years of experience in critical illness, disability, death and medical claims within an insurance or reinsurance environment, with demonstrated technical proficiency in assessing complex claims.

• Strong knowledge of Life & Health insurance/reinsurance, including technical claims assessment, underwriting principles, and product knowledge

• Proven analytical capability, including experience handling and interpreting large volumes of data to inform decisions and identify trends

• Excellent communication skills in English and Cantonese, with the ability to present, influence, and engage effectively with both

• internal stakeholders and external clients; proficiency in Mandarin will be considered an asset

• Experience working in cross-functional teams, with the ability to build strong relationships across diverse groups

• Curiosity and courage to challenge existing approaches, bringing fresh thinking that enhances business outcomes

• Ability to step back from details to see the bigger picture.

We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Informazioni sul ruolo
Si tratta di un'opportunità entusiasmante per unire la Swiss Re's Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit di Hong Kong come Specialist, dove la vostra esperienza tecnica influenzerà direttamente la qualità e l'integrità delle decisioni di reclamo attraverso il portafoglio HKTW. Sarete un contributore chiave a un team che valorizza precisione, correttezza e miglioramento continuo — lavorando all'intersezione del servizio client, la governance e rivendica l'innovazione.
Segnalando al capo di L&H Underwriting, Claims & HNW per Hong Kong & Taiwan, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella fornitura di un servizio di rivendicazioni significativo e migliore in classe, condividendo le competenze con i clienti e gli stakeholder interni in tutta la regione.
Principali responsabilità

• Mantenere le linee guida di governance e il controllo di qualità per un funzionamento robusto di HKTW L&H Claims e garantire l'adesione a quadri e standard pertinenti

• Gestire e valutare i reclami con rigore tecnico, fornendo decisioni corrette, accurate e tempestive che si allineano con termini politici, condizioni e presupposti tariffari

• Support Claims Recensioni e Audit all'interno del quadro interno, fornendo raccomandazioni attuabili per migliorare sia il processo decisionale tecnico che l'efficienza operativa per migliorare gli standard di richiesta dei clienti

• Sostenere l'impegno dei clienti attraverso visite e sessioni di formazione, migliorando la qualità e l'efficacia della gestione dei crediti

• Sostenere lo sviluppo di materiali e programmi di formazione su misura per le esigenze del cliente e gli argomenti del settore emergente

• Fornire input tecnici sulle questioni emergenti e sostenere attivamente iniziative di miglioramento del processo

• Mantenere la responsabilità per la qualità del reclamo individuale, l'accuratezza, i tempi di svolta e un elevato standard di servizio al cliente
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team Underwriting e Claims fa parte della Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit Hong Kong & Taiwan. A proposito di te
Sei un professionista di rivendicazioni tecnicamente forte e orientato al dettaglio che porta sia la profondità di competenza e uno spirito collaborativo a tutto ciò che fai. Sei comodo navigare nella complessità, impegnarsi con i clienti, e contribuire a una cultura di squadra che valori la curiosità, l'integrità e l'apprendimento continuo. Sai come bilanciare il dettaglio con il quadro più grande — e non hai paura di sfidare lo status quo quando porta a risultati migliori.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Laurea universitaria o qualifica equivalente in assicurazione, affari, servizi finanziari, legge o una disciplina medica

• 5+ anni di esperienza in malattie critiche, disabilità, morte e reclami medici all'interno di un ambiente di assicurazione o di riassicurazione, con comprovata competenza tecnica nella valutazione di crediti complessi.

• Forte conoscenza dell'assicurazione vita e salute / assicurazione, compresa la valutazione dei reclami tecnici, principi di scrittura e la conoscenza del prodotto

• Prove capacità analitiche, tra cui la gestione delle esperienze e l'interpretazione di grandi volumi di dati per informare le decisioni e identificare le tendenze

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e cantonese, con la capacità di presentare, influenzare e impegnarsi efficacemente con entrambi

• stakeholders interni e clienti esterni; la competenza in mandarino sarà considerata un bene

• Esperienza di lavoro in team interfunzionali, con la capacità di costruire forti relazioni tra gruppi diversi

• Curiosità e coraggio per sfidare gli approcci esistenti, portando il pensiero fresco che migliora i risultati aziendali

• Capacità di tornare dai dettagli per vedere l'immagine più grande.
La gamma di stipendio base per questa posizione sarà condivisa con voi durante il processo di intervista
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Are you a seasoned claims professional with a passion for technical excellence and a drive to make a real difference in the Life & Health reinsurance space? If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and want to be at the heart of a dynamic team shaping the future of claims management across Asia Pacific, this could be the role for you.
About the Role
This is an exciting opportunity to join Swiss Re's Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit in Hong Kong as a Claims Specialist, where your technical expertise will directly influence the quality and integrity of claims decisions across the HKTW portfolio. You'll be a key contributor to a team that values precision, fairness, and continuous improvement — working at the intersection of client service, governance, and claims innovation.
Reporting to the Head of L&H Underwriting, Claims & HNW for Hong Kong & Taiwan, you will play an instrumental role in delivering a meaningful, best-in-class claims service while sharing expertise with clients and internal stakeholders across the region.
Key Responsibilities

• Maintain governance guidelines and quality control for a robust operation of HKTW L&H Claims and ensuring adherence to relevant frameworks and standards

• Manage and assess claims with technical rigor, delivering fair, accurate, and timely decisions that align with policy terms, conditions, and pricing assumptions

• Support Claims Reviews and Audits within the internal framework, providing actionable recommendations to improve both technical decision-making and operational efficiency to enhance clients' claims standards

• Support client engagement through visits and training sessions, enhancing the quality and effectiveness of claims management

• Support the development of training materials and programs tailored to client requirements and emerging industry topics

• Provide technical input on emerging issues and actively support process enhancement initiatives

• Maintain accountability for individual claim quality, accuracy, turnaround times, and a high standard of customer service
About the Team
The Underwriting and Claims team is part of Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit Hong Kong & Taiwan. The team is responsible for delivering disciplined, high-quality risk selection for HNW business while supporting sound management of the in-force portfolio. Working closely with cross-functional teams across L&H, the team applies deep underwriting expertise and portfolio insights to support strong new business margins, sustainable client solutions, and informed portfolio decisions — all while championing operational excellence, risk governance, and continuous improvement across the HNW underwriting value chain.
About You
You are a technically strong, detail-oriented claims professional who brings both depth of expertise and a collaborative spirit to everything you do. You are comfortable navigating complexity, engaging with clients, and contributing to a team culture that values curiosity, integrity, and continuous learning. You know how to balance the detail with the bigger picture — and you're not afraid to challenge the status quo when it leads to better outcomes.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• University degree or equivalent qualification in insurance, business, financial services, law, or a medical discipline

• 5+ years of experience in critical illness, disability, death and medical claims within an insurance or reinsurance environment, with demonstrated technical proficiency in assessing complex claims.

• Strong knowledge of Life & Health insurance/reinsurance, including technical claims assessment, underwriting principles, and product knowledge

• Proven analytical capability, including experience handling and interpreting large volumes of data to inform decisions and identify trends

• Excellent communication skills in English and Cantonese, with the ability to present, influence, and engage effectively with both

• internal stakeholders and external clients; proficiency in Mandarin will be considered an asset

• Experience working in cross-functional teams, with the ability to build strong relationships across diverse groups

• Curiosity and courage to challenge existing approaches, bringing fresh thinking that enhances business outcomes

• Ability to step back from details to see the bigger picture.
The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit, als Claims Specialist in die Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit von Swiss Re in Hongkong einzusteigen, wo Ihre technische Expertise die Qualität und Integrität von Schadensentscheidungen im gesamten HKTW-Portfolio direkt beeinflussen wird. • Bewahren Sie die Rechenschaftspflicht für die Qualität, Genauigkeit, Bearbeitungszeiten und einen hohen Kundenservice-Standard auf
Über das Team
Das Underwriting and Claims Team ist Teil der Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit Hong Kong & Taiwan. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams in L & H wendet das Team umfassende Underwriting-Know-how und Portfolio-Insights an, um starke neue Geschäftsmargen, nachhaltige Kundenlösungen und fundierte Portfolioentscheidungen zu unterstützen - und sich gleichzeitig für operative Exzellenz, Risiko-Governance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in der gesamten versicherungstechnischen Wertschöpfungskette von HNW einzusetzen.

Sie sind ein technisch starker, detailorientierter Claim-Profi, der sowohl fundiertes Fachwissen als auch einen kooperativen Geist in alles, was Sie tun, einbringt. Sie navigieren gerne mit Komplexität, engagieren sich für Kunden und tragen zu einer Teamkultur bei, die Neugier, Integrität und kontinuierliches Lernen schätzt. Sie wissen, wie Sie das Detail mit dem größeren Bild in Einklang bringen können - und Sie haben keine Angst, den Status Quo in Frage zu stellen, wenn er zu besseren Ergebnissen führt.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Universitätsabschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation in Versicherung, Geschäft, Finanzdienstleistungen, Recht oder einer medizinischen Disziplin

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in kritischen Krankheit, Invalidität, Tod und medizinischen Ansprüchen in einem Versicherungs- oder Rückversicherungsumfeld mit nachgewiesener technischer Kompetenz bei der Bewertung komplexer Ansprüche.

• Starke Kenntnisse der Lebens- und Krankenversicherung / -rückversicherung, einschließlich technischer Schadensbewertung, Zeichnungsgrundsätze und Produktkenntnisse

• Nachgewiesene analytische Fähigkeiten, einschließlich Erfahrung im Umgang mit und der Interpretation großer Datenmengen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen und Trends zu identifizieren

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Kantonesisch, mit der Fähigkeit, beides zu präsentieren, zu beeinflussen und effektiv zu engagieren

• interne Stakeholder und externe Kunden; Kenntnisse in Mandarin gelten als Vermögenswert

• Erfahrung in funktionsübergreifenden Teams mit der Fähigkeit, starke Beziehungen zwischen verschiedenen Gruppen aufzubauen

• Neugier und Mut, bestehende Ansätze in Frage zu stellen und neues Denken zu bringen, das die Geschäftsergebnisse verbessert

• Fähigkeit, von Details zurückzutreten, um das größere Bild zu sehen.
Die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position wird während des Interviewprozesses mit Ihnen geteilt
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Are you a seasoned HNW underwriting expert ready to make a real impact in one of Asia's most dynamic insurance markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of technical excellence, client partnership, and strategic thinking? If so, this is the role for you — a rare opportunity to bring your expertise to a global reinsurance leader and help shape the future of High Net Worth underwriting across Hong Kong and Taiwan.
About the Role
As a Senior HNW Underwriter within Swiss Re's Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit for Hong Kong & Taiwan, you will be at the heart of delivering disciplined, high-quality risk selection for complex HNW business. You'll work alongside a high-performance team and cross-functional partners across APAC ex China, translating market insights and in-force experience into consistent underwriting standards that drive profitable growth. This is a role where your technical depth, collaborative mindset, and appetite for innovation will be valued every single day.
Key Responsibilities

• Deliver core HNW underwriting services to clients by assessing medical, financial, and risk data to provide accurate, competitive, and well-governed risk selection decisions

• Support Swiss Re's market presence through participation in industry committees, delivery of presentations, and active engagement with the broader HNW insurance community

• Conduct underwriting reviews and audits within the internal framework, providing recommendations on both technical underwriting decisions and operational efficiency to enhance client underwriting standards

• Support Market Unit portfolio monitoring through data deep dives and trend analysis, identifying portfolios that require further review and coordinating with specialist resources across the wider team

• Contribute to product development and quote activities as the HNW underwriting subject matter expert, participating in cross-functional initiatives to develop sustainable client solutions

• Engage and influence stakeholders across Swiss Re, including cross-functional teams, UW and Claims Offices, and Medical Officers, to gather insights on HNW underwriting trends, contract wording, and emerging innovations

• Drive thought leadership by researching new and developing innovations, contributing to industry presentations, and sharing company initiatives via social media and industry committees

• Lead and contribute to ad-hoc and ongoing Global and Asia Market Unit Claims & Underwriting projects as agreed with the Line Manager
About the Team
The Underwriting and Claims team is part of Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit Hong Kong & Taiwan. The team is responsible for delivering disciplined, high-quality risk selection for HNW business while supporting sound management of the in-force portfolio. Working closely with cross-functional partners across L&H, the team applies deep underwriting expertise and portfolio insights to support strong new business margins, sustainable client solutions, and informed portfolio decisions — all while championing operational excellence, risk governance, and continuous improvement across the HNW underwriting value chain.
About You
You are a technically strong and commercially minded HNW underwriting professional who brings a blend of deep expertise, collaborative energy, and a genuine curiosity for innovation. You're comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and have the confidence to challenge the status quo when it leads to better outcomes. You can zoom out from the detail to see the bigger picture, and you communicate with clarity and impact — whether with clients, internal stakeholders, or industry peers.
We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements:

• University degree or equivalent qualification in insurance, business, financial services, law, or a medical discipline; ACII or LOMA qualification is highly preferred

• 7+ years of HNW underwriting experience in insurance or reinsurance, with a strong track record of complex risk assessment and disciplined decision-making

• Deep knowledge of the Life & Health insurance/reinsurance industry, including HNW underwriting principles, distribution models, and product knowledge

• Asia Regional and/or International HNW market exposure is preferred.

• Proven ability to work in cross-functional teams, with strong collaboration, influencing, and stakeholder engagement skills across diverse and geographically dispersed groups

• Familiarity with underwriting review and audit processes, including the ability to provide constructive feedback to clients on underwriting standards and operational efficiency

• Courage to challenge the status quo and explore new ideas that improve business outcomes and client value

• Strong communication and presentation skills with experience engaging senior internal and external stakeholders

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with proficiency in Cantonese preferred and Mandarin considered a strong asset
The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
