Unisciti al nostro team di prodotti ed essere il ponte tra business e tecnologia in questo ruolo emozionante! Sei appassionato di trasformare i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni digitali d'impatto? Unisciti al nostro team dinamico di Città del Messico dove sarai al centro di sviluppare e mantenere i nostri sofisticati prodotti assicurativi commerciali interni, guidando un impatto reale sul business attraverso funzionalità innovative!
Informazioni sul ruolo
In questo ruolo fondamentale, colmare il divario tra le esigenze aziendali e l'implementazione tecnica, assicurando ai nostri prodotti assicurativi un valore eccezionale. Collaborerai con team interfunzionali per tradurre requisiti complessi in specifiche chiare che guidano il nostro processo di sviluppo.

Principali responsabilità

• Analizzare e chiarire i requisiti aziendali e tradurli in specifiche funzionali e tecniche, tra cui architettura aziendale, mappe di processo, wireframe e modelli di dati

• Assicurare una specifica completa delle Storie degli utenti con tutti i dati e le analisi di sfondo richiesti disponibili per l'intero team

• Progettare e definire casi di test correlati e supportare il Titolare del Prodotto nella creazione di criteri di accettazione efficaci

• Collaborare interfunzionalmente con Platform Product Owners, Technology Leads, Business Process Managers, Business Architecture e l'Ufficio dati per mantenere la coerenza end-to-end di sistema, processo e architettura delle informazioni

• Anticipare e analizzare le esigenze del cliente per sviluppare soluzioni efficaci di problem solving

• Organizzare e priorizzare il Product Backlog basato sulla guida del Product Owner

• Supporto di produzione per una o più applicazioni aziendali, indirizzando le richieste degli utenti direttamente o triagendo casi più complessi al team di sviluppo

• Creare e mantenere la documentazione completa del progetto sul Wiki aziendale
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il nostro team è responsabile della costruzione di prodotti e soluzioni per l'unità aziendale di Corporate Solutions. Lavoriamo in un ambiente collaborativo e innovativo dove le vostre idee avranno un impatto reale. Collaboriamo a stretto contatto con colleghi di tutto il mondo, promuovendo un'atmosfera diversificata e inclusiva in cui diverse prospettive aiutano a modellare prodotti assicurativi eccezionali. Come parte del nostro team, contribuirai a progetti significativi, sviluppando le tue competenze in una cultura solidale e orientata alla crescita.
A proposito di te
Sei un risolutore di problemi orientato ai dettagli che prospera in ambienti collaborativi. Hai eccellenti capacità analitiche e puoi tradurre efficacemente tra domini aziendali e tecnici. Siete proattivi, orientati al cliente e impegnati a fornire soluzioni di alta qualità che guidano il valore aziendale.
Abbiamo bisogno che porti i seguenti deve avere:

• 5+ anni di esperienza come Ingegnere di Requisiti o in ruoli simili

• Eccellente capacità di gestione, comunicazione e presentazione degli stakeholder

• Forte comprensione delle metodologie Agile e dell'esperienza di lavoro in team di prodotti interfunzionali

• Proficienza in strumenti come Jira o simili piattaforme di gestione Agile come Azure DevOps

• Proficiente in Visio o altri strumenti di mappatura di processo, con buona conoscenza di BPMN
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Esperienza con prodotti e processi di assicurazione commerciale

• Conoscenza delle norme e dei regolamenti del settore assicurativo

• Esperienza con la modellazione dei dati e concetti di database

• Familiarità con i principi di progettazione API

• Sfondo nello sviluppo del software o nell'implementazione tecnica
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Application Engineer III

Ready to engineer the future of reinsurance? Let's build it together.

At Swiss Re, we don't just write code — we build solutions that help the world become more resilient. As an Application Engineer III based in Hyderabad, India, you'll be at the heart of a global technology team, crafting high-quality applications and services that power one of the world's leading reinsurance businesses. If you thrive at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and meaningful business impact, this is your opportunity.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, high-impact engineering role where design thinking meets cloud-native development. You'll bring together software engineering expertise, DevOps know-how, and a sharp understanding of business domains to design, build, and roll out applications and APIs that matter. Working in an agile environment, you'll collaborate with global teams and outsourcing partners across all phases of the software development lifecycle — from concept to production.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and deliver high-quality applications, components, and APIs with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability

• Drive the cloud journey by acquiring and maintaining deep knowledge of our application landscape, software architectures, and cloud-native patterns

• Shape application architecture in collaboration with cloud solution architects across all lines of business — designing systems that are robust, extensible, and future-ready

• Leverage modern cloud environments by identifying and exploiting the advantages of platforms such as Azure, Swisscom, or Ali Cloud

• Stay ahead of the curve by tracking technology trends and evaluating promising solutions that align with business and technical requirements

• Communicate and champion ideas — present architectural concepts and engineering solutions to wider teams with clarity, compelling storytelling, and well-reasoned arguments

• Prototype and validate new technologies and approaches, then share insights and learnings across teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement

• Contribute to technical research and feasibility studies for proposed tooling, software upgrades, and architectural decisions

• Collaborate across borders — partner effectively with global teams and outsourcing partners throughout all phases of delivery

About the Team

We are the global Reinsurance Technology team — a passionate group of technologists responsible for the technical architecture and engineering of IT shared services and components for Swiss Re's Reinsurance business unit. Our team members bring a rare combination of deep technical expertise and genuine curiosity about the reinsurance business. We believe great technology is built through collaboration, and we work closely with application teams and colleagues across the globe to share knowledge, challenge assumptions, and engineer solutions that make a real difference.

About You

You are a curious, driven, and collaborative technologist who loves solving complex problems with elegant solutions. You bring strong engineering fundamentals and a cloud-native mindset, and you're equally comfortable diving into the details as you are thinking at an architectural level. You communicate ideas with confidence, embrace agile ways of working, and bring creative thinking to every challenge. Whether you're mentoring peers, prototyping a new solution, or presenting to stakeholders, you make an impact.

We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements:

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering with strong fundamentals in design patterns, data structures, and software architecture

• Full-stack development proficiency with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, and JavaScript/TypeScript with Angular or React frameworks (minimum 3 years in Angular or React)

• Cloud platform expertise in Azure with a solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and software patterns

• REST API design and implementation skills, including proficiency with OpenAPI, Swagger, and microservices architecture

• DevOps and SDLC proficiency across a modern DevOps platform — Azure DevOps preferred, with Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent experience also welcomed

• Knowledge of modern AuthN/AuthZ practices and standards, particularly OAuth and OpenID Connect

• Experience with security-by-design principles and their application in cloud environments

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills — able to operate at both abstract and detailed levels, ensuring solutions are pragmatic and realistic

• Ability to evaluate and communicate technology choices through prototyping, feasibility studies, and clear documentation

These Are Additional Nice to Haves:

• An understanding of insurance or reinsurance business concepts — a genuine plus that will help you connect technology decisions to business outcomes

• Experience working with globally distributed teams and outsourcing partners across different time zones and cultures

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, insurance, and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks — from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime — covering both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. By combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is made possible by the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture that encourages fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought, or other characteristics.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

Pronti a progettare il futuro della riassicurazione? Costruiremo insieme.

A Swiss Re, non scriviamo semplicemente il codice: costruiamo soluzioni che aiutano il mondo a diventare più resistenti. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Application Engineer III

Ready to engineer the future of reinsurance? Let's build it together.

At Swiss Re, we don't just write code — we build solutions that help the world become more resilient. As an Application Engineer III based in Hyderabad, India, you'll be at the heart of a global technology team, crafting high-quality applications and services that power one of the world's leading reinsurance businesses. If you thrive at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and meaningful business impact, this is your opportunity.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, high-impact engineering role where design thinking meets cloud-native development. You'll bring together software engineering expertise, DevOps know-how, and a sharp understanding of business domains to design, build, and roll out applications and APIs that matter. Working in an agile environment, you'll collaborate with global teams and outsourcing partners across all phases of the software development lifecycle — from concept to production.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and deliver high-quality applications, components, and APIs with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability

• Drive the cloud journey by acquiring and maintaining deep knowledge of our application landscape, software architectures, and cloud-native patterns

• Shape application architecture in collaboration with cloud solution architects across all lines of business — designing systems that are robust, extensible, and future-ready

• Leverage modern cloud environments by identifying and exploiting the advantages of platforms such as Azure, Swisscom, or Ali Cloud

• Stay ahead of the curve by tracking technology trends and evaluating promising solutions that align with business and technical requirements

• Communicate and champion ideas — present architectural concepts and engineering solutions to wider teams with clarity, compelling storytelling, and well-reasoned arguments

• Prototype and validate new technologies and approaches, then share insights and learnings across teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement

• Contribute to technical research and feasibility studies for proposed tooling, software upgrades, and architectural decisions

• Collaborate across borders — partner effectively with global teams and outsourcing partners throughout all phases of delivery

About the Team

We are the global Reinsurance Technology team — a passionate group of technologists responsible for the technical architecture and engineering of IT shared services and components for Swiss Re's Reinsurance business unit. Our team members bring a rare combination of deep technical expertise and genuine curiosity about the reinsurance business. We believe great technology is built through collaboration, and we work closely with application teams and colleagues across the globe to share knowledge, challenge assumptions, and engineer solutions that make a real difference.

About You

You are a curious, driven, and collaborative technologist who loves solving complex problems with elegant solutions. You bring strong engineering fundamentals and a cloud-native mindset, and you're equally comfortable diving into the details as you are thinking at an architectural level. You communicate ideas with confidence, embrace agile ways of working, and bring creative thinking to every challenge. Whether you're mentoring peers, prototyping a new solution, or presenting to stakeholders, you make an impact.

We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements:

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering with strong fundamentals in design patterns, data structures, and software architecture

• Full-stack development proficiency with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, and JavaScript/TypeScript with Angular or React frameworks (minimum 3 years in Angular or React)

• Cloud platform expertise in Azure with a solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and software patterns

• REST API design and implementation skills, including proficiency with OpenAPI, Swagger, and microservices architecture

• DevOps and SDLC proficiency across a modern DevOps platform — Azure DevOps preferred, with Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent experience also welcomed

• Knowledge of modern AuthN/AuthZ practices and standards, particularly OAuth and OpenID Connect

• Experience with security-by-design principles and their application in cloud environments

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills — able to operate at both abstract and detailed levels, ensuring solutions are pragmatic and realistic

• Ability to evaluate and communicate technology choices through prototyping, feasibility studies, and clear documentation

These Are Additional Nice to Haves:

• An understanding of insurance or reinsurance business concepts — a genuine plus that will help you connect technology decisions to business outcomes

• Experience working with globally distributed teams and outsourcing partners across different time zones and cultures

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, insurance, and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks — from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime — covering both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. By combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is made possible by the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture that encourages fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought, or other characteristics.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

Application Engineer III

Bereit, die Zukunft der Rückversicherung zu gestalten? Lasst es uns zusammen bauen.

Bei Swiss Re schreiben wir nicht nur Code – wir entwickeln Lösungen, die der Welt helfen, widerstandsfähiger zu werden. Als Application Engineer III mit Sitz in Hyderabad, Indien, stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt eines globalen Technologieteams, das qualitativ hochwertige Anwendungen und Dienstleistungen für eines der weltweit führenden Rückversicherungsunternehmen entwickelt. Wenn Sie an der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und sinnvollen Geschäftsauswirkungen gedeihen, ist dies Ihre Chance.

Über die Rolle

Dies ist eine praktische, einflussreiche Engineering-Rolle, bei der Design Thinking auf Cloud-native Entwicklung trifft. Sie bringen Software-Engineering-Know-how, DevOps-Know-how und ein scharfes Verständnis von Geschäftsdomänen zusammen, um Anwendungen und APIs zu entwerfen, zu erstellen und auszurollen, die wichtig sind. In einer agilen Umgebung arbeiten Sie mit globalen Teams und Outsourcing-Partnern in allen Phasen des Softwareentwicklungslebenszyklus zusammen – vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Gestalten Sie die Anwendungsarchitektur in Zusammenarbeit mit Cloud-Lösungsarchitekten in allen Geschäftsbereichen - und entwerfen Sie Systeme, die robust, erweiterbar und zukunftsfähig sind

• Nutzen Sie moderne Cloud-Umgebungen, indem Sie die Vorteile von Plattformen wie Azure, Swisscom oder Ali Cloud erkennen und nutzen

• Bleiben Sie der Zeit voraus, indem Sie Technologietrends verfolgen und vielversprechende Lösungen bewerten, die sich an den geschäftlichen und technischen Anforderungen orientieren

• Ideen kommunizieren und verfechten - präsentieren Sie architektonische Konzepte und technische Lösungen für breitere Teams mit Klarheit, überzeugendem Storytelling und gut begründeten Argumenten

• Prototyp und Validierung neuer Technologien und Ansätze, anschließender Austausch von Erkenntnissen und Erkenntnissen über Teams hinweg, um eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung zu fördern

• Beitrag zur technischen Forschung und Machbarkeitsstudien für vorgeschlagene Werkzeuge, Software-Upgrades und architektonische Entscheidungen

• Über Grenzen hinweg zusammenarbeiten – effektiv mit globalen Teams und Outsourcing-Partnern in allen Phasen der Lieferung zusammenarbeiten

Über das Team

Wir sind das globale Rückversicherungs-Technologie-Team - eine leidenschaftliche Gruppe von Technologen, die für die technische Architektur und das Engineering von IT-Sharing-Services und -Komponenten für den Geschäftsbereich Rückversicherung von Swiss Re verantwortlich sind. Unsere Teammitglieder bringen eine seltene Kombination aus fundiertem technischem Know-how und echter Neugier auf das Rückversicherungsgeschäft mit. Wir glauben, dass großartige Technologie durch Zusammenarbeit entsteht, und wir arbeiten eng mit Anwendungsteams und Kollegen auf der ganzen Welt zusammen, um Wissen auszutauschen, Annahmen in Frage zu stellen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die einen echten Unterschied machen.

Über dich

Sie sind ein neugieriger, motivierter und kollaborativer Technologe, der es liebt, komplexe Probleme mit eleganten Lösungen zu lösen. Sie bringen starke technische Grundlagen und eine Cloud-native Denkweise mit, und Sie sind ebenso bequem, in die Details einzutauchen, wie Sie auf architektonischer Ebene denken. Du kommunizierst Ideen mit Zuversicht, umarmst agile Arbeitsweisen und bringst kreatives Denken in jede Herausforderung. Egal, ob Sie Peers betreuen, Prototypen für eine neue Lösung erstellen oder Interessengruppen präsentieren, Sie wirken.

Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Software Engineering mit starken Grundlagen in Designmustern, Datenstrukturen und Softwarearchitektur

• Kenntnisse in der Full-Stack-Entwicklung mit praktischer Erfahrung in Java, Spring Boot und JavaScript / TypeScript mit Angular- oder React-Frameworks (mindestens 3 Jahre in Angular oder React)

• Cloud-Plattform-Expertise in Azure mit einem soliden Verständnis von Cloud-nativen Architekturen und Softwaremustern

• REST API Design- und Implementierungsfähigkeiten, einschließlich Kenntnisse in der OpenAPI-, Swagger- und Microservice-Architektur

• DevOps und SDLC-Kompetenzen auf einer modernen DevOps-Plattform - Azure DevOps bevorzugt, mit Jenkins, GitLab oder vergleichbarer Erfahrung ebenfalls willkommen

• Kenntnisse moderner AuthN/AuthZ Praktiken und Standards, insbesondere OAuth und OpenID Connect

• Erfahrung mit Security-by-Design-Prinzipien und deren Anwendung in Cloud-Umgebungen

• Starke analytische und strukturierte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten - in der Lage, sowohl auf abstrakter als auch auf detaillierter Ebene zu arbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass Lösungen pragmatisch und realistisch sind

Ingénieur d'application III

Prêt à concevoir l'avenir de la réassurance? Construisons-le ensemble.

Chez Swiss Re, nous ne nous contentons pas d'écrire du code, nous construisons des solutions qui aident le monde à devenir plus résilient. En tant qu'ingénieur d'application III basé à Hyderabad, en Inde, vous serez au cœur d'une équipe technologique mondiale, créant des applications et des services de haute qualité qui alimentent l'une des principales entreprises de réassurance au monde. Si vous prospèrez à l'intersection d'une technologie de pointe et d'un impact commercial significatif, c'est votre occasion.

À propos du rôle

Il s'agit d'un rôle pratique d'ingénierie à impact élevé où la pensée de conception rencontre le développement cloud-natif. Vous rassemblerez l'expertise en génie logiciel, le savoir-faire de DevOps et une bonne compréhension des domaines d'affaires pour concevoir, construire et déployer des applications et des API qui comptent. En travaillant dans un environnement agile, vous collaborerez avec des équipes mondiales et des partenaires d'externalisation pour toutes les phases du cycle de développement des logiciels, du concept à la production.

Principales responsabilités

• Concevoir et fournir des applications, des composants et des API de haute qualité en mettant l'accent sur la performance, l'évolutivité et la maintenance

• Conduire le voyage en nuage en acquérant et en maintenant une connaissance approfondie de notre paysage d'applications, des architectures logicielles et des modèles cloud-natifs

• Architecture d'application de forme en collaboration avec les architectes de solutions cloud dans tous les secteurs d'activité — conception de systèmes robustes, extensibles et prêts à l'avenir

• Tirer parti des environnements cloud modernes en identifiant et en exploitant les avantages des plateformes comme Azure, Swisscom ou Ali Cloud

• Restez en avance sur la courbe en suivant les tendances technologiques et en évaluant des solutions prometteuses qui s'harmonisent avec les exigences opérationnelles et techniques

• Communiquer et défendre des idées — présenter des concepts architecturaux et des solutions d'ingénierie à des équipes plus larges avec clarté, connotation convaincante et arguments bien motivés

• Prototyper et valider les nouvelles technologies et approches, puis partager les connaissances et les apprentissages entre les équipes pour favoriser une culture d'amélioration continue

• Contribuer à la recherche technique et aux études de faisabilité pour l'outillage proposé, la mise à niveau des logiciels et les décisions architecturales

• Collaborer efficacement avec les équipes mondiales et les partenaires sous-traitants à toutes les étapes de la prestation.

À propos de l'équipe

Nous sommes l'équipe mondiale de la technologie de réassurance, un groupe passionné de technologues responsables de l'architecture technique et de l'ingénierie des services et composants partagés IT pour l'unité d'activité Reassurance de Swiss Re. Les membres de notre équipe apportent une rare combinaison d'expertise technique profonde et d'une véritable curiosité dans le domaine de la réassurance. Nous croyons que la grande technologie est construite grâce à la collaboration, et nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec des équipes d'application et des collègues du monde entier pour partager des connaissances, des hypothèses de défi et des solutions d'ingénieur qui font une réelle différence.

À propos de toi

Vous êtes un technologue curieux, motivé et collaboratif qui aime résoudre des problèmes complexes avec des solutions élégantes. Vous apportez de solides fondamentaux d'ingénierie et un état d'esprit cloud-native, et vous êtes tout aussi à l'aise de plonger dans les détails que vous pensez à un niveau architectural. Vous communiquez des idées avec confiance, vous adoptez des méthodes de travail agiles et vous apportez une pensée créative à chaque défi. Que vous soyez des pairs mentors, qu'il s'agisse de prototyper une nouvelle solution ou de présenter aux intervenants, vous avez un impact.

Nous recherchons des candidats qui satisfont à ces exigences :

• 10+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle avec de solides fondamentaux dans les modèles de conception, les structures de données et l'architecture logicielle

• Compétence de développement complète avec expérience pratique en Java, Spring Boot et JavaScript/TypeScript avec cadres angulaires ou réact (minimum 3 ans en angulaire ou réact)

• Expertise en plateforme Cloud à Azure avec une solide compréhension des architectures cloud-natives et des modèles logiciels

• Capacités de conception et de mise en œuvre de l'API REST, y compris compétences en architecture OpenAPI, Swagger et microservices

• DevOps et la compétence SDLC sur une plate-forme DevOps moderne — Azure DevOps préféré, avec Jenkins, GitLab, ou expérience équivalente également accueilli

• Connaissance des pratiques et normes modernes d'AuthN/AuthZ, en particulier OAuth et OpenID Connect

• Expérience des principes de sécurité par conception et de leur application dans les environnements cloud

• Fortes compétences analytiques et structurées en résolution de problèmes, capables de fonctionner à la fois à des niveaux abstraits et détaillés, garantissant des solutions pragmatiques et réalistes

• Capacité d'évaluer et de communiquer les choix technologiques par prototypage, études de faisabilité et documentation claire

Ils sont plus agréables à avoir:

• Une compréhension des concepts d'entreprise d'assurance ou de réassurance — un véritable plus qui vous aidera à connecter les décisions technologiques aux résultats de l'entreprise

• Expérience de travail avec des équipes réparties au niveau mondial et des partenaires sous-traitants dans différents fuseaux horaires et cultures

À propos de Swiss Re

Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques - des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité - couvrant à la fois la propriété et les pertes et la vie et la santé. En combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. jobs.title: Senior Auditor (P&C Actuary)
jobs.description:
Are you a qualified or nearly qualified Property & Casualty actuary looking to leverage your technical expertise in a role with broad organizational impact? Join our Group Internal Audit team where you'll help protect Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability through independent risk assessment and insightful recommendations. This role offers exceptional visibility across the business and the opportunity to influence topics of organizational significance.
 About the Role:
 As a Senior Auditor specializing in Property & Casualty actuarial topics, you'll lead audits across the (re)insurance value chain, focusing on reserving, pricing, and risk management. You'll evaluate control effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and engage with senior stakeholders to drive meaningful improvements and risk management practices. Coach and support team members while building effective stakeholder relationships. Contribute to a strong, forward-looking risk culture at Swiss Re.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and deliver a portfolio of audits across the Property & Casualty (re)insurance value chain, owning engagements end-to-end and ensuring timely, high-quality, risk-focused outcomes.

• Evaluate the effectiveness of governance, controls, and risk management practices across actuarial topics, including reserving and pricing.

• Identify and assess key and emerging risks within the P&C actuarial domain.

• Engage and challenge senior stakeholders, fostering transparent and constructive discussions that support effective risk management and decision-making.

• Coach and support team members while building effective stakeholder relationships.

• Contribute to a strong, forward-looking risk culture at Swiss Re.
 About the Team
 Group Internal Audit (GIA) provides independent and objective assurance to support the Board of Directors and Group Executive Committee in protecting Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability. GIA's vision is to advance Swiss Re's resilience by delivering risk-responsive assurance and providing innovative insights that strengthen the control environment and support the achievement of business objectives.

About You

jobs.description:
Are you a detail-driven finance professional with a passion for investments and a knack for turning complex data into meaningful insights? Join Swiss Re's Global Investment Reporting team and play a pivotal role in shaping the financial story behind one of the world's leading reinsurance companies!

About the Role
 As an Investment Accountant within the Global Investment Reporting (GIR) team, you will be at the heart of our investment accounting and reporting operations. You'll work alongside a talented, international group of professionals to ensure the accurate delivery of financial information across multiple legal entities and accounting valuations. This is a role that rewards curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence — with plenty of opportunity to grow, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.
 Key Responsibilities

• Drive sub-ledger accuracy: Execute sub-ledger accounting tasks and reporting deliverables for various accounting valuations and legal entities

• Master the data landscape: Develop a thorough understanding of data flows, system architectures, and system interactions that impact accounting transactions, ensuring accurate processing throughout the accounting and reporting life cycle

• Collaborate across borders: Liaise with data providers and business analysts — both locally and internationally — to proactively communicate and resolve issues uncovered during the closing cycle

• Partner with key stakeholders: Facilitate strong collaboration with Group Functions including Asset Management, Tax, Risk, Treasury, and Group Finance to ensure reporting meets the needs of all stakeholders

• Uphold control standards: Understand and apply the control framework to meet all internal and external audit requirements

• Ensure data integrity: Perform reconciliation, substantiation and resolution of data quality errors across all investment products

• Contribute to team growth: Actively participate in team initiatives and projects, bringing energy and efficiency to every task

About the Team
 Global Investment Reporting (GIR) is part of Group Finance and has ownership of sub-ledger accounting for investments, including all valuations and related reporting deliverables. We are a highly skilled, energetic, and engaged team, fostering a collaborative environment where every team member learns and grows — both individually and collectively!
 As part of the GIR Team in the Americas region, you will bring a solid understanding of investment products and play a meaningful role in delivering accounting, reporting, and analyses across all relevant valuations within Swiss Re. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe that great ideas can come from anywhere.

About You
 You are proactive, forward-thinking, and committed to delivering high-quality results. A true team player with a strong sense of personal accountability, you bring a global, project-oriented mindset and the ability to work productively in ambiguous situations — always focused on driving positive outcomes. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are eager to embrace new technologies and evolving challenges.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• University Degree: University degree with an emphasis in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related discipline

• Relevant work experience: Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience, including at least 1 year in the area of investment accounting, investment reporting or investment operations

• Accounting or Reporting knowledge: firm understanding of multi-valuation accounting concepts including US GAAP, US Regulatory (Statutory), IFRS, and Tax Reporting
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Advanced Excel skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to manage and analyze large data sets efficiently

• Data analytics tools: Experience with Power BI, Power Query, or similar data analytics platforms is a strong plus

• Communication skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels

• Tech curiosity: A high level of interest in learning and adopting innovative technologies and tools to enhance analytical capabilities

• Detail orientation: Exceptional attention to detail with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving discrepancies

This role will be located in our Kansas City, MO office. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework, relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $52,000 to $78,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short- and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei un professionista della finanza con una passione per gli investimenti e un impedimento per trasformare i dati complessi in insight significativi? Unisciti al team di Swiss Re's Global Investment Reporting e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione della storia finanziaria dietro una delle principali aziende di riassicurazione del mondo!

Informazioni sul ruolo
Come Contabile per gli Investimenti all'interno del team Global Investment Reporting (GIR), sarete al centro delle nostre operazioni di contabilità e reporting di investimento. Potrai lavorare insieme a un gruppo di professionisti di talento e internazionale per garantire la consegna accurata delle informazioni finanziarie attraverso più enti legali e valutazioni contabili. Questo è un ruolo che premia la curiosità, la collaborazione e l'impegno per l'eccellenza - con un sacco di opportunità per crescere, affrontare nuove sfide, e fare un impatto reale.
Principali responsabilità

• Precisione dell'azionamento sotto-ledger: Esegui i compiti contabili sotto-ledger e rendicontazione consegnabili per varie valutazioni contabili e entità legali

• Padroneggiare il panorama dei dati: Sviluppare una comprensione approfondita dei flussi di dati, delle architetture di sistema e delle interazioni di sistema che influiscono sulle transazioni contabili, garantendo un trattamento accurato durante il ciclo di vita contabile e di reportistica

• Collaborare attraverso i confini: Liaise con i fornitori di dati e gli analisti di business, sia a livello locale che internazionale, per comunicare e risolvere proattivamente i problemi scoperti durante il ciclo di chiusura

• Partner con i principali stakeholder: Facilitare una forte collaborazione con Funzioni di Gruppo, tra cui Asset Management, Tax, Risk, Treasury e Group Finance per garantire la reportistica soddisfa le esigenze di tutti gli stakeholder

• Norme di controllo: comprendere e applicare il quadro di controllo per soddisfare tutti i requisiti di audit interni ed esterni

• Assicurare l'integrità dei dati: Eseguire la riconciliazione, la convalida e la risoluzione di errori di qualità dei dati in tutti i prodotti di investimento

• Contribuisci alla crescita del team: partecipa attivamente alle iniziative e ai progetti del team, portando energia ed efficienza ad ogni compito

Informazioni sulla squadra
Global Investment Reporting (GIR) fa parte delle Finanze di Gruppo e ha la proprietà della contabilità di sotto-collocata per gli investimenti, comprese tutte le valutazioni e i relativi resoconti. Siamo un team altamente qualificato, energico e impegnato, che promuove un ambiente collaborativo in cui ogni membro del team impara e cresce, sia individualmente che collettivamente!
Nell'ambito del GIR Team in Americas, avrai una solida comprensione dei prodotti di investimento e un ruolo significativo nel fornire contabilità, reportistica e analisi su tutte le valutazioni rilevanti all'interno della Swiss Re.

A proposito di te
Siete proattivi, in avanti e impegnati a fornire risultati di alta qualità. Un vero giocatore di squadra con un forte senso di responsabilità personale, si porta una mentalità globale, orientata al progetto e la capacità di lavorare produttivo in situazioni ambigue — sempre concentrati sulla guida di risultati positivi. Si prospera in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale e sono desiderosi di abbracciare nuove tecnologie e sfide in evoluzione.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Laurea universitaria: laurea con enfasi in Finanza, Contabilità, Economia o disciplina relativa

• Esperienza di lavoro rilevante: minimo 1-3 anni di esperienza rilevante, compreso almeno 1 anno nel settore della contabilità degli investimenti, della rendicontazione degli investimenti o delle operazioni di investimento

• Conoscenze di contabilità o di reporting: comprensione costante dei concetti di contabilità multivalutazione, tra cui US GAAP, US Regulatory (Statutory), IFRS e Tax Reporting
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Competenze avanzate di Excel: Forte competenza in Microsoft Excel, con la capacità di gestire e analizzare i grandi set di dati in modo efficiente

• Strumenti di analisi dei dati: Esperienza con Power BI, Power Query o piattaforme di analisi dati simili è un forte plus

• Capacità di comunicazione: Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli

• Curiosità tecnologica: un alto livello di interesse per l'apprendimento e l'adozione di tecnologie e strumenti innovativi per migliorare le capacità analitiche

• Orientamento dettagli: Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli con un approccio proattivo per identificare e risolvere discrepanze

Questo ruolo sarà situato nella nostra Kansas City, ufficio MO. La nostra azienda utilizza un modello di lavoro ibrido che richiede almeno tre giorni in ufficio ogni settimana, con la possibilità di lavorare in loco a tempo pieno se preferito. Questa posizione non è idonea per il telelavoro a tempo pieno, l'assistenza di trasferimento o la sponsorizzazione del visto.

L'intervallo di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione è $52,000 a $78,000. Lo stipendio specifico offerto per questo, o qualsiasi dato ruolo terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, la posizione del lavoro, la portata del ruolo, le qualifiche, la complessità/specializzazione/scarsità del talento, l'esperienza, l'istruzione e il bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Le decisioni sull'occupazione si basano esclusivamente sulle qualifiche di un individuo per la posizione in essere.

Durante il processo di reclutamento, su richiesta sono disponibili sistemazioni ragionevoli per disabili. Se contattato per un colloquio, si prega di informare il Recruiter/HR Professional dell'alloggio necessario.

Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Sind Sie ein detailorientierter Finanzprofi mit einer Leidenschaft für Investitionen und einem Talent, komplexe Daten in sinnvolle Erkenntnisse zu verwandeln? Treten Sie dem Global Investment Reporting Team von Swiss Re bei und spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung der Finanzgeschichte hinter einem der weltweit führenden Rückversicherungsunternehmen!

Über die Rolle
Als Investment Accountant im Global Investment Reporting (GIR) Team stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt unserer Anlagebuchhaltung und -berichterstattung. Sie arbeiten mit einer talentierten, internationalen Gruppe von Fachleuten zusammen, um die genaue Lieferung von Finanzinformationen über mehrere juristische Personen und Buchhaltungsbewertungen sicherzustellen. Dies ist eine Rolle, die Neugier, Zusammenarbeit und das Engagement für Exzellenz belohnt - mit vielen Möglichkeiten, zu wachsen, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen und echte Auswirkungen zu erzielen.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Drive Sub-Ledger Genauigkeit: Ausführung von Sub-Ledger-Buchhaltungsaufgaben und Berichtsergebnissen für verschiedene Buchhaltungsbewertungen und juristische Personen

• Beherrschen Sie die Datenlandschaft: Entwickeln Sie ein gründliches Verständnis der Datenflüsse, Systemarchitekturen und Systeminteraktionen, die sich auf Buchhaltungstransaktionen auswirken, und gewährleisten Sie eine genaue Verarbeitung während des gesamten Buchhaltungs- und Berichtslebenszyklus

• Zusammenarbeit über Grenzen hinweg: Zusammenarbeit mit Datenanbietern und Business Analysten – sowohl lokal als auch international – um proaktiv zu kommunizieren und Probleme zu lösen, die während des Abschlusszyklus aufgedeckt wurden

• Partnerschaft mit wichtigen Stakeholdern: Ermöglichen Sie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gruppenfunktionen wie Asset Management, Tax, Risk, Treasury und Group Finance, um sicherzustellen, dass die Berichterstattung den Bedürfnissen aller Stakeholder entspricht

• Uphold-Kontrollstandards: Verstehen und Anwenden des Kontrollrahmens zur Erfüllung aller internen und externen Auditanforderungen

• Datenintegrität sicherstellen: Abgleich, Nachweis und Behebung von Datenqualitätsfehlern bei allen Anlageprodukten

• Beitrag zum Teamwachstum: Aktiv an Teaminitiativen und -projekten teilnehmen und Energie und Effizienz in jede Aufgabe bringen

Über das Team
Global Investment Reporting (GIR) ist Teil von Group Finance und ist Eigentümer der Teilbuchhaltung für Investitionen, einschließlich aller Bewertungen und der damit verbundenen Berichtsergebnisse. Wir sind ein hochqualifiziertes, energisches und engagiertes Team, das eine kollaborative Umgebung fördert, in der jedes Teammitglied lernt und wächst - sowohl individuell als auch kollektiv!
Als Teil des GIR-Teams in der Region Amerika bringen Sie ein solides Verständnis für Anlageprodukte mit und spielen eine bedeutende Rolle bei der Bereitstellung von Buchhaltung, Berichterstattung und Analysen über alle relevanten Bewertungen innerhalb von Swiss Re. Wir feiern verschiedene Perspektiven und glauben, dass großartige Ideen von überall her kommen können.

Über dich
Sie sind proaktiv, vorausschauend und verpflichtet, qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern. Als echter Teamplayer mit einem starken Gefühl der persönlichen Verantwortlichkeit bringen Sie eine globale, projektorientierte Denkweise und die Fähigkeit mit, in mehrdeutigen Situationen produktiv zu arbeiten - immer darauf ausgerichtet, positive Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Sie gedeihen in einem dynamischen, internationalen Umfeld und sind bestrebt, neue Technologien und sich entwickelnde Herausforderungen anzunehmen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Universitätsabschluss: Universitätsabschluss mit Schwerpunkt in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Wirtschaft oder verwandter Disziplin

• Relevante Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 1–3 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung, davon mindestens 1 Jahr im Bereich Investment Accounting, Investment Reporting oder Investment Operations

• Buchhaltungs- oder Berichtswissen: festes Verständnis von Multi-Bewertungs-Buchhaltungskonzepten, einschließlich US GAAP, US Regulatory (Statutory), IFRS und Tax Reporting
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Erweiterte Excel-Fähigkeiten: Starke Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel mit der Fähigkeit, große Datensätze effizient zu verwalten und zu analysieren

• Data Analytics Tools: Erfahrung mit Power BI, Power Query oder ähnlichen Data Analytics Plattformen ist ein starkes Plus

• Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, sich effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zu beschäftigen

• Tech-Neugier: Ein hohes Interesse am Lernen und der Einführung innovativer Technologien und Werkzeuge zur Verbesserung der analytischen Fähigkeiten

• Detailorientierung: Außergewöhnliche Liebe zum Detail mit einem proaktiven Ansatz zur Identifizierung und Lösung von Diskrepanzen

Diese Rolle wird sich in unserem Büro in Kansas City, MO, befinden. Unser Unternehmen verwendet ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das jede Woche mindestens drei Tage im Büro benötigt, mit der Option, bei Bedarf Vollzeit vor Ort zu arbeiten. Diese Position ist nicht für Vollzeit-Telearbeit, Umzugshilfe oder Visa-Sponsoring geeignet.

Die geschätzte Basisgehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt 52.000 bis 78.000 US-Dollar. Das spezifische Gehalt, das dafür oder eine bestimmte Rolle angeboten wird, berücksichtigt eine Reihe von Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Arbeitsplatz, den Umfang der Rolle, die Qualifikationen, die Komplexität / Spezialisierung / Knappheit von Talenten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Arbeitgeberbudget. Bei Swiss Re verfolgen wir einen "Gesamtvergütungsansatz", wenn wir Entschädigungsentscheidungen treffen. Dies bedeutet, dass wir alle Komponenten der Entschädigung in ihrer Gesamtheit (wie Grundlohn, kurz- und langfristige Anreize und angebotene Leistungen) bei der Festlegung der individuellen Entschädigung berücksichtigen.

Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Schweizer Re ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Es ist unsere Praxis, ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Alter, Schwangerschaft, sexuelle Orientierungen, Familienstand, Militärstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale zu rekrutieren, einzustellen und zu fördern. Entscheidungen über die Beschäftigung basieren ausschließlich auf den Qualifikationen einer Person für die zu besetzende Stelle.

Während des Rekrutierungsprozesses sind angemessene Unterkünfte für Behinderungen auf Anfrage verfügbar. Wenn Sie für ein Interview kontaktiert werden, informieren Sie bitte den Recruiter / HR Professional über die erforderliche Unterkunft.

Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous un professionnel de la finance axé sur les détails avec une passion pour les investissements et un knack pour transformer des données complexes en idées significatives? Rejoignez l'équipe Global Investment Reporting de Swiss Re et jouez un rôle central dans l'élaboration de l'histoire financière derrière l'une des principales sociétés de réassurance au monde !

À propos du rôle
En tant que comptable en investissement au sein de l'équipe Global Investment Reporting (GIR), vous serez au cœur de nos opérations de comptabilité et de reporting en investissement. Vous travaillerez avec un groupe de professionnels talentueux et internationaux pour assurer la transmission précise de l'information financière à plusieurs entités juridiques et évaluations comptables. Il s'agit d'un rôle qui récompense la curiosité, la collaboration et l'engagement envers l'excellence, avec de nombreuses occasions de croître, de relever de nouveaux défis et d'avoir un impact réel.
Principales responsabilités

• Diriger l'exactitude du sous-régime: Exécuter les tâches comptables du sous-régime et présenter les résultats attendus pour diverses évaluations comptables et entités juridiques

• Maîtriser le paysage des données: Développer une compréhension approfondie des flux de données, des architectures de systèmes et des interactions de systèmes qui influent sur les opérations comptables, assurant un traitement précis tout au long du cycle de comptabilité et de déclaration

• Collaborer au-delà des frontières : Assurer la liaison avec les fournisseurs de données et les analystes commerciaux, tant locaux qu'internationals, pour communiquer et résoudre les problèmes découverts au cours du cycle de clôture

• Partenaire avec les principaux intervenants : Faciliter une collaboration solide avec les fonctions de groupe, y compris la gestion des actifs, les impôts, les risques, la trésorerie et les finances de groupe, afin de s'assurer que les rapports répondent aux besoins de tous les intervenants

• Normes de contrôle : Comprendre et appliquer le cadre de contrôle pour répondre à toutes les exigences de vérification interne et externe

• Assurer l'intégrité des données : effectuer le rapprochement, la justification et la résolution des erreurs de qualité des données pour tous les produits d'investissement

• Contribuer à la croissance de l'équipe : participer activement aux initiatives et projets de l'équipe, apportant énergie et efficacité à chaque tâche

À propos de l'équipe
Global Investment Reporting (GIR) fait partie du Groupe Finance et est propriétaire du sous-régime comptable des placements, y compris toutes les évaluations et les produits connexes. Nous sommes une équipe hautement qualifiée, énergique et engagée, favorisant un environnement collaboratif où chaque membre de l'équipe apprend et grandit, tant individuellement que collectivement!
Dans le cadre de l'équipe GIR dans la région des Amériques, vous apporterez une bonne compréhension des produits d'investissement et jouerez un rôle significatif dans la production de comptes, de rapports et d'analyses sur toutes les évaluations pertinentes au sein de Swiss Re.

À propos de toi
Vous êtes proactif, avant-gardiste et vous êtes engagé à fournir des résultats de haute qualité. Un vrai joueur d'équipe avec un fort sens de la responsabilité personnelle, vous apportez un état d'esprit global, axé sur le projet et la capacité de travailler de façon productive dans des situations ambiguës - toujours axé sur la conduite de résultats positifs. Vous prospèrez dans un environnement international dynamique et êtes impatient d'adopter de nouvelles technologies et des défis en évolution.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Diplôme universitaire : Diplôme universitaire mettant l'accent sur les finances, la comptabilité, l'économie ou la discipline connexe

• Expérience professionnelle pertinente: minimum de 1 à 3 ans d'expérience pertinente, y compris au moins 1 an dans le domaine de la comptabilité des investissements, de l'information sur les investissements ou des opérations d'investissement

• Connaissances en matière de comptabilité ou de déclaration: compréhension solide des concepts de comptabilité multi-évaluation, y compris les GAAP américains, la réglementation américaine (législative), les IFRS et la déclaration fiscale
Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Compétences Excel avancées: Une bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Excel, avec la capacité de gérer et d'analyser efficacement les grands ensembles de données

• Outils d'analyse de données: Expérience avec Power BI, Power Query ou des plateformes d'analyse de données similaires est un plus fort

• Compétences en communication : Fortes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, avec la capacité de dialoguer efficacement avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux

• Curiosité technique : Un niveau élevé d'intérêt pour l'apprentissage et l'adoption de technologies et d'outils novateurs pour améliorer les capacités d'analyse

• Orientation détaillée: attention exceptionnelle au détail avec une approche proactive pour identifier et résoudre les divergences

Ce rôle sera situé dans notre bureau de Kansas City, MO. Notre entreprise utilise un modèle de travail hybride nécessitant au moins trois jours au bureau chaque semaine, avec la possibilité de travailler sur place à temps plein si vous préférez. Ce poste n'est pas admissible au télétravail à temps plein, à l'aide à la réinstallation ou au parrainage de visa.

L'échelle salariale de base prévue pour ce poste est de 52 000 $ à 78 000 $. Le salaire spécifique offert pour ce poste, ou tout autre rôle donné, tiendra compte d'un certain nombre de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le lieu d'affectation, l'étendue du rôle, les qualifications, la complexité, la spécialisation ou la pénurie de talents, l'expérience, les études et le budget de l'employeur. Chez Swiss Re, nous adoptons une «approche de la rémunération totale» pour prendre des décisions en matière de rémunération. Cela signifie que nous considérons toutes les composantes de la rémunération dans leur ensemble (comme la rémunération de base, les incitatifs à court et à long terme et les avantages offerts) dans l'établissement de la rémunération individuelle.

À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.

Suisse Re est un employeur à chances égales. Notre pratique consiste à recruter, embaucher et promouvoir sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, au handicap, à l'âge, à la grossesse, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'état civil, à l'état militaire ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont fondées uniquement sur les qualifications d'une personne pour le poste à pourvoir.

Pendant le processus de recrutement, des aménagements raisonnables sont disponibles sur demande. Si vous êtes contacté pour une entrevue, veuillez informer le recruteur/professionnel des RH de l'accommodement nécessaire.

Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Golang
jobs.description:
About the Role
 Join Swiss Re’s IT Resilience unit and contribute to building a robust, future-ready IT landscape that underpins the organisation at global scale. Our team is a diverse, internationally connected group of engineers and architects, united by a commitment to pragmatic engineering, operational excellence, and technology with real purpose. We play a critical role in shaping Swiss Re’s Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) capabilities, including the evolution of our enterprise CMDB and its integrations.
 We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Golang expertise to design, build, and operate the core services that power our enterprise IT ecosystem. You will take a leading role in developing mission-critical backend services, enabling reliable integrations across the business, and supporting the adoption of AI-driven capabilities. While the role is backend-focused, there will be selective involvement in frontend components where this supports end-to-end delivery.
 You will work closely with a dedicated product team and fellow engineers in a collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment, ensuring mutual coverage, shared ownership, and long-term maintainability of our platforms. The role balances strategic engineering with hands-on delivery, contributing directly to system stability, resilience, and continuous improvement whilst building our AI assisted future through meaningful PoCs.
 Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop robust backend services using Golang.

• Architect and maintain our Federated API, connecting configuration and asset information across on-premise and multi-cloud environments.

• Optimize and enhance CMDB database systems and ensure seamless integration with corporate processes.

• Build and manage RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, and CI/CD pipelines with automated testing.

• Implement containerization using Docker and orchestrate deployments in Kubernetes environments.

• Monitor and analyse application performance using tools like Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus.

• Transform and integrate data using ETL practices and complex SQL operations.

• Explore and implement emerging AI technologies, including generative models and intelligent agents.

• Communicate complex technical concepts with clarity and precision.

• Document and share technical knowledge to support team-wide knowledge and growth.
 About You

• Proven 3+ years' experience programming with Golang

• 8+ years' experience with modern programming languages.

• A strong sense of ownership of your work, acting as the CEO of your area, consistently delivering excellence.

• Strong knowledge of SQL, database modeling, and optimization techniques.

• Hands-on experience with Azure or equivalent cloud platforms.

• Proficiency in Angular 2+ and Node.js frontend development.

• Experience with microservices architecture, Kubernetes, and Docker.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable:

• Experience with monitoring tools like Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus.

• Knowledge of AI technologies and intelligent systems.

• Experience with ETL workflows and data processing at scale.

• Background in enterprise IT environments and configuration management.
 We understand that no candidate matches 100% of the requirements. If you're passionate about technology, eager to learn, and meet several of our criteria, we'd love to connect with you.

For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 60,000 and EUR 100,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers: ​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,​

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Informazioni sul ruolo
Unisciti all’unità IT Resilience di Swiss Re e contribuisci alla costruzione di un paesaggio IT robusto e pronto per il futuro che sostenga l’organizzazione a livello globale. Il nostro team è un gruppo diversificato e connesso a livello internazionale di ingegneri e architetti, uniti da un impegno per l'ingegneria pragmatica, l'eccellenza operativa e la tecnologia con scopo reale. Svolgiamo un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione delle capacità di Swiss Re’s Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM), tra cui l’evoluzione della nostra impresa CMDB e le sue integrazioni.
Stiamo cercando un Senior Backend Engineer con una forte competenza Golang per progettare, costruire e gestire i servizi fondamentali che alimentano il nostro ecosistema IT aziendale. Si assumerà un ruolo di primo piano nello sviluppo di servizi di backend mission-critical, consentendo integrazioni affidabili in tutto il business, e supportando l'adozione di funzionalità basate su AI. Mentre il ruolo è focalizzato sul backend, ci sarà coinvolgimento selettivo nei componenti di frontend dove questo supporta la consegna end-to-end.
Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con un team dedicato di prodotti e colleghi ingegneri in un ambiente collaborativo e di condivisione delle conoscenze, garantendo la copertura reciproca, la proprietà condivisa e la manutenbilità a lungo termine delle nostre piattaforme. Il ruolo bilancia l'ingegneria strategica con consegna pratica, contribuendo direttamente alla stabilità del sistema, resilienza e miglioramento continuo, mentre la costruzione del nostro futuro AI assistito attraverso PoC significativi.
Principali responsabilità

• Progettare e sviluppare servizi di backend robusti utilizzando Golang.

• Architetto e mantieni la nostra API Federated, collegando la configurazione e le informazioni sugli asset in ambienti on-premise e multi-cloud.

• Ottimizzare e migliorare i sistemi di database CMDB e garantire una perfetta integrazione con i processi aziendali.

• Costruire e gestire le API RESTful, le architetture dei microservizi e le pipeline CI/CD con test automatizzati.

• Implementare la containerizzazione utilizzando Docker e le implementazioni orchestrate in ambienti Kubernetes.

• Monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni delle applicazioni utilizzando strumenti come Datadog, Grafana o Prometheus.

• Trasformare e integrare i dati utilizzando pratiche ETL e complesse operazioni SQL.

• Esplora e implementa le tecnologie AI emergenti, compresi i modelli generativi e gli agenti intelligenti.

• Comunicare concetti tecnici complessi con chiarezza e precisione.

• Documentare e condividere conoscenze tecniche per supportare la conoscenza e la crescita a livello di team.
A proposito di te

• Prove 3+ anni di esperienza di programmazione con Golang

• Esperienza di 8+ anni con linguaggi di programmazione moderni.

• Un forte senso di proprietà del vostro lavoro, che agisce come CEO della vostra zona, offrendo costantemente l'eccellenza.

• Forte conoscenza di SQL, modellazione database e tecniche di ottimizzazione.

• Esperienza pratica con piattaforme cloud Azure o equivalenti.

• Proficienza nello sviluppo di frontend Angular 2+ e Node.js.

• Esperienza con architettura microservices, Kubernetes e Docker.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese.

Desiderabile:

• Esperienza con strumenti di monitoraggio come Datadog, Grafana o Prometheus.

• Conoscenza delle tecnologie AI e sistemi intelligenti.

• Esperienza con flussi di lavoro ETL e elaborazione dati in scala.

• Sfondo negli ambienti IT aziendali e nella gestione della configurazione.
Sappiamo che nessun candidato corrisponde al 100% dei requisiti. Se siete appassionati di tecnologia, desiderosi di imparare, e soddisfare diversi dei nostri criteri, ci piacerebbe connetterci con voi.

Per la Spagna, la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra 60.000 euro e 100.000 euro (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione.
L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 14.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
