Must have Credit & Surety Underwriting experience
Position location: Midlothian VA
We are considering candidates in the Mid-Atlantic region.

Are you a surety underwriting professional who thrives on building relationships, analyzing complex financials, and making smart, strategic risk decisions? Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is looking for a talented Contract Surety Underwriter to join our dynamic team in Woburn, Massachusetts — where your expertise will directly shape the growth and success of our surety portfolio.

About the Role
As a Contract Surety Underwriter, you'll be at the heart of our surety operations — evaluating risk, approving bonds, and cultivating the agent relationships that drive our business forward. This is a role where analytical rigor meets relationship-building, and where your decisions genuinely matter. You'll have real authority, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Key Responsibilities

• Underwrite contract surety bonds in alignment with Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group underwriting guidelines, assessing risk acceptability and strategic fit

• Manage daily bid and final bond requests, ensuring timely and accurate processing across your assigned territory

• Review new contract bond submissions for completeness and compliance with Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group policies

• Approve surety bonds within your assigned authority level, exercising sound judgment and underwriting discipline

• Oversee the fiscal status of accounts, including in-depth analysis of annual accounting audits and internal financial statements

• Maintain accurate documentation and credit information files in accordance with the Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group Procedure Manual

• Build and enhance agency relationships — schedule regular meetings with established agents, visit bond accounts, and actively identify and secure new agent partnerships

• Drive premium production growth by leveraging strong market knowledge and a proactive, client-focused approach

• Provide quarterly marketing updates to the VP/Branch Manager and contribute to special projects as delegated

• Attend regional meetings and represent the team with professionalism and expertise
About the Team
The Contract Surety team at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is a dedicated group of underwriting professionals responsible for evaluating and approving contract bonds in accordance with our rigorous Surety Group policies. The team analyzes new account submissions across assigned territories, oversees the fiscal health of accounts, and maintains meticulous credit documentation — all while delivering exceptional service to our agent and contractor network. We are a collaborative, high-performing team that combines financial discipline with a strong market presence to deliver outstanding results.

About You
You are a confident, detail-oriented underwriting professional with a passion for surety and a talent for building lasting relationships. You bring strong financial acumen, excellent communication skills, and the ability to balance analytical thinking with a commercially savvy mindset. You're comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and representing Swiss Re Corporate Solutions in the marketplace with energy and professionalism.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Minimum 3–5 years of contract surety underwriting experience , with demonstrated ability to assess and approve bonds within an assigned authority framework

• Strong quantitative and financial analysis skills, including the ability to review and interpret financial statements, accounting audits, and credit information

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word, with the ability to manage documentation, reporting, and data analysis effectively
Additional preferred skills and qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in business, finance, or accounting — or equivalent professional experience

• Proven track record in agency relationship management, including securing new agents and growing a book of business

• Strong marketing and business development skills, with the ability to engage contractor clients and identify new opportunities

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting updates and reports to senior leadership

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% to meet with agents and visit bond accounts

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
The estimated base salary range for this position in Midlothian VA is $156,000 to $234,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
Are you a law student eager to develop your career in a truly international environment? Join our Reinsurance Contracts team in Brazil and gain hands-on experience supporting complex reinsurance transactions across multiple lines of business, while collaborating with colleagues across Latin America and the global Contracts community. This is a unique opportunity to build legal, commercial and analytical skills while working alongside experienced professionals in one of the world's leading reinsurance companies.
 About the Role
 The intern will work under the guidance and supervision of the Senior Reinsurance Contracts Counsel in charge of P&C Reinsurance Contracts in Brazil, performing:
 Contract's support for P&C business in Brazil and aligning Swiss Re´s reinsurance contracts with applicable law, regulations, and internal requirements, including:
 • Supporting the Reinsurance Contracts Counsel in reinsurance agreement reviews and discussions with Underwriters, Client Managers, Operations and other support functions, and including external clients when necessary;
 Effectively performing research activities and using available electronic and AI tools and internal systems to review and draft clauses and reinsurance contracts;
 • Performing administrative duties such as updating the team's SharePoint site and managing online filing systems;
 • Helping with training preparation/presentations, attending internal meetings, and compiling any necessary information for such meetings, as appropriate.
 • Fulfilling other ad hoc projects as assigned by the Senior Reinsurance Contracts Counsel.
 • This is a hybrid role that requires in-office attendance approximately three days per week.
 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is one of our Must Wins as a Company, and you will have the opportunity to learn and talk about it in various internal forums.
 This is a great opportunity to work with different people and cultures and to learn about Reinsurance in Property, Engineering, Casualty, Agriculture, Marine, etc.
 About the Team
 The Reinsurance Contracts Latam team is tasked with an important role, acting as both steer/advisors and valued partners to our clients. We are an experienced team of 4 lawyers who seek to understand and meet the needs of our clients, while providing holistic contracts support as a one stop shop for contracts services for the region. As members of a global team with frequent cross-border interactions, we benefit from meaningful exposure to diverse cultures and perspectives, which enriches our collaborative approach and broadens our strategic outlook.
 About You
 We are looking for:
 • Passionate law student, preferably from 2nd-3rd year on
 • Strong writing and communication skills
 • Language Intermediary on English. Spanish is a plus
 • Intern should be very proactive, detailed driven, curious, quick learner, able to work independently, productively, efficiently and a real team player.
 • Proficient in computer skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc.)
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

Si tratta di un'occasione unica per costruire competenze legali, commerciali e analitiche, lavorando insieme a professionisti esperti in una delle principali aziende di riassicurazione al mondo.
Informazioni sul ruolo
Lo stage lavorerà sotto la guida e la supervisione del Senior Reinsurance Contracts Consigliere incaricato dei Contratti di Riassicurazione P&C in Brasile, eseguendo:
Il supporto del contratto per le imprese P&C in Brasile e l'allineamento dei contratti di riassicurazione della Svizzera con leggi, regolamenti e requisiti interni applicabili, tra cui:
• Sostenere il Consiglio dei Contratti di Riassicurazione in riassicurazione recensioni e discussioni con Underwriters, Client Managers, Operazioni e altre funzioni di supporto, e compresi i clienti esterni quando necessario;
Effettuare attività di ricerca e utilizzare strumenti elettronici e AI disponibili e sistemi interni per rivedere e redigere clausole e contratti di riassicurazione;
• Eseguire compiti amministrativi come l'aggiornamento del sito SharePoint del team e la gestione di sistemi di archiviazione online;
• Aiutare con preparazione/presentazioni di formazione, partecipare a riunioni interne, e compilare tutte le informazioni necessarie per tali riunioni, se del caso.
• Soddisfare altri progetti ad hoc assegnati dal Senior Reinsurance Contracts Council.
• Questo è un ruolo ibrido che richiede la presenza in ufficio circa tre giorni alla settimana.
La diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione è una delle nostre Must Wins come azienda, e avrete l'opportunità di imparare e parlarne in vari forum interni.
Questa è una grande opportunità per lavorare con persone e culture diverse e per conoscere la Riassicurazione in Proprietà, Ingegneria, Casualità, Agricoltura, Marine, ecc.
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team di Reinsurance Contracts Latam ha un ruolo importante, che agisce sia come amministratore/advisori che come partner stimati per i nostri clienti. Siamo un team esperto di 4 avvocati che cercano di capire e soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti, fornendo al tempo stesso il supporto dei contratti olistici come un unico negozio per i servizi di contratti per la regione. Come membri di un team globale con frequenti interazioni transfrontaliere, beneficiamo di un'esposizione significativa a culture e prospettive diverse, che arricchisce il nostro approccio collaborativo e amplia le nostre prospettive strategiche.
A proposito di te
Stiamo cercando:
• Studente di legge appassionato, preferibilmente dal 2-3 ° anno su
• Forte capacità di scrittura e comunicazione
• Intermedio linguistico in inglese. Lo spagnolo è un vantaggio
• Intern dovrebbe essere molto proattivo, guidato dettagliata, curioso, rapido apprendista, in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente, produttivo, efficiente e un vero giocatore di squadra.
• Proficiente in competenze informatiche (Alloggio, PowerPoint, Excel, ecc.)
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 14.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Tutte le nostre posizioni sono affermative per le persone disabili

Sind Sie ein Jurastudent, der bestrebt ist, Ihre Karriere in einem wirklich internationalen Umfeld zu entwickeln? Treten Sie unserem Rückversicherungsvertragsteam in Brasilien bei und sammeln Sie praktische Erfahrungen bei der Unterstützung komplexer Rückversicherungstransaktionen in verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, während Sie mit Kollegen in ganz Lateinamerika und der globalen Vertragsgemeinschaft zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, rechtliche, kaufmännische und analytische Fähigkeiten aufzubauen und gleichzeitig mit erfahrenen Fachleuten in einem der weltweit führenden Rückversicherungsunternehmen zusammenzuarbeiten.
Über die Rolle
Der Praktikant wird unter der Leitung und Aufsicht des Senior Reinsurance Contracts Counsel arbeiten, der für P & C Rückversicherungsverträge in Brasilien verantwortlich ist und Folgendes durchführt:
Contract unterstützt das P&C-Geschäft in Brasilien und passt die Rückversicherungsverträge von Swiss Re an geltende Gesetze, Vorschriften und interne Anforderungen an, darunter:
• Unterstützung des Rückversicherungsvertragsberaters bei der Überprüfung und Diskussion von Rückversicherungsverträgen mit Underwritern, Kundenmanagern, Operations und anderen Supportfunktionen sowie gegebenenfalls Einbeziehung externer Kunden;
Effiziente Durchführung von Forschungsaktivitäten und Nutzung verfügbarer elektronischer und KI-Tools sowie interner Systeme zur Überprüfung und Ausarbeitung von Klauseln und Rückversicherungsverträgen;
• Durchführung von Verwaltungsaufgaben wie Aktualisierung der SharePoint-Website des Teams und Verwaltung von Online-Ablagesystemen;
• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung/Präsentation von Schulungen, Teilnahme an internen Sitzungen und gegebenenfalls Zusammenstellung der für solche Sitzungen erforderlichen Informationen.
• Erfüllung anderer Ad-hoc-Projekte, die vom Senior Rückversicherungsvertragsberater zugewiesen wurden.
• Dies ist eine hybride Rolle, die etwa drei Tage pro Woche eine Anwesenheit im Büro erfordert.
Diversity, Equity und Inklusion ist einer unserer Must Wins als Unternehmen, und Sie haben die Möglichkeit, in verschiedenen internen Foren darüber zu lernen und zu sprechen.
Dies ist eine großartige Gelegenheit, mit verschiedenen Menschen und Kulturen zu arbeiten und etwas über Rückversicherung in Immobilien, Ingenieurwesen, Unfall, Landwirtschaft, Marine usw. zu erfahren.
Über das Team
Das Latam-Team für Rückversicherungsverträge ist mit einer wichtigen Rolle betraut und fungiert sowohl als Steuerberater als auch als geschätzter Partner für unsere Kunden. Wir sind ein erfahrenes Team von 4 Anwälten, die versuchen, die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zu verstehen und zu erfüllen, während sie ganzheitliche Vertragsunterstützung als One-Stop-Shop für Vertragsdienstleistungen für die Region anbieten. Als Mitglieder eines globalen Teams mit häufigen grenzüberschreitenden Interaktionen profitieren wir von einer sinnvollen Exposition gegenüber verschiedenen Kulturen und Perspektiven, was unseren kooperativen Ansatz bereichert und unsere strategische Perspektive erweitert.
Über dich
Wir suchen:
• Passionierter Jurastudent, vorzugsweise ab dem 2.-3.
• Starke Schreib- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Language Intermediary auf Englisch. Spanisch ist ein Plus
• Intern sollte sehr proaktiv, detailreich, neugierig, schnell lernend, unabhängig, produktiv, effizient und ein echter Teamplayer sein.
• Computerkenntnisse (Word, PowerPoint, Excel usw.)
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 14.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

jobs.title: Change Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you at the start of your change management journey and eager to grow into a role where you can make a real impact? Do you have a passion for people, structure, and helping organizations navigate change with confidence? If you're ready to learn, contribute, and develop — this could be the perfect next step for you.

About the Role

Change doesn't manage itself — and that's exactly where you come in. As a Change Enablement Specialist, you'll be supporting some of our most strategically important initiatives, helping to ensure that the people impacted by change are informed, prepared, and set up for success. This is a role where you'll build your change management expertise hands-on, working alongside experienced colleagues to coordinate end-to-end change journeys that drive real, measurable adoption across the organization.

This is a role for someone who is organized, curious, and people-oriented — someone who is ready to grow into a trusted change partner and knows that the true measure of change success is what happens after go-live.

Key responsibilities

• Support change activities across key projects and business initiatives.

• Coordinate activities across teams and stakeholders to ensure everyone stays informed and aligned.

• Work with project teams, business stakeholders, and leaders to support successful change adoption.

• Help identify impacted groups, assess their needs, and understand how changes may affect them.

• Support the creation and delivery of change communications and engagement plans.

• Track change readiness and adoption by gathering feedback, running surveys, and monitoring key metrics.

• Identify potential adoption risks and help address them early.

• Coordinate go-live activities and help prepare employees for upcoming changes.

• Support reporting and maintain visibility of change activities, timelines, and readiness status.

• Contribute to a consistent and practical approach to change management across the organization.

About the Team
 The Change Readiness & Enablement (CRE) team sits within the Operational Model Excellence (OMEX) organizational structure and provides change management strategy and oversight to CorSo's strategic initiatives. CRE's mandate is to ensure our internal communities are prepared, willing and able to adopt the various process and technology changes that impact their roles. We also partner closely with project managers and leaders to ensure there is transparency and collaboration across the portfolio. If you're looking for a role where you apply strategic thinking and can make an impact within CorSo – this is it.

About You

You are an organized, curious, and people-oriented professional who is eager to build a career in change management.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

Sind Sie am Anfang Ihrer Change-Management-Reise und möchten in eine Rolle hineinwachsen, in der Sie wirklich etwas bewirken können? Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für Menschen, Strukturen und helfen Organisationen, Veränderungen mit Zuversicht zu bewältigen? Wenn Sie bereit sind zu lernen, beizutragen und sich zu entwickeln - dies könnte der perfekte nächste Schritt für Sie sein.

Über die Rolle

Veränderung verwaltet sich nicht von selbst - und genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel. Als Change Enablement Specialist unterstützen Sie einige unserer strategisch wichtigsten Initiativen und tragen dazu bei, dass die vom Wandel betroffenen Menschen informiert, vorbereitet und auf den Erfolg vorbereitet sind. Dies ist eine Rolle, in der Sie Ihre Change-Management-Expertise praxisnah aufbauen und zusammen mit erfahrenen Kollegen End-to-End-Change-Reises koordinieren, die eine echte, messbare Akzeptanz in der gesamten Organisation ermöglichen.

Dies ist eine rolle für jemanden, der organisiert, neugierig und menschenorientiert ist - jemand, der bereit ist, zu einem vertrauenswürdigen veränderungspartner zu werden und weiß, dass das wahre maß für den veränderungserfolg das ist, was nach dem go-live passiert.

Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten

• Unterstützung von Veränderungsaktivitäten in wichtigen Projekten und Geschäftsinitiativen.

• Koordinieren Sie die Aktivitäten zwischen Teams und Stakeholdern, um sicherzustellen, dass alle informiert und ausgerichtet bleiben.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Projektteams, geschäftlichen Stakeholdern und Führungskräften zusammen, um eine erfolgreiche Veränderung zu unterstützen.

• Helfen Sie, betroffene Gruppen zu identifizieren, ihre Bedürfnisse zu bewerten und zu verstehen, wie sich Veränderungen auf sie auswirken können.

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Bereitstellung von Change Communications und Engagement-Plänen.

• Verfolgen Sie die Bereitschaft und Annahme von Änderungen, indem Sie Feedback sammeln, Umfragen durchführen und wichtige Metriken überwachen.

• Identifizieren Sie potenzielle Adoptionsrisiken und helfen Sie, sie frühzeitig anzugehen.

• Koordinieren Sie Go-Live-Aktivitäten und helfen Sie, die Mitarbeiter auf bevorstehende Veränderungen vorzubereiten.

• Unterstützung der Berichterstattung und Aufrechterhaltung der Sichtbarkeit von Änderungsaktivitäten, Zeitplänen und Bereitschaftsstatus.

• Tragen Sie zu einem konsistenten und praktischen Ansatz für das Change Management in der gesamten Organisation bei.

Über das Team
Das CRE-Team (Change Readiness & Enablement) befindet sich in der Organisationsstruktur Operational Model Excellence (OMEX) und bietet eine Strategie und Aufsicht für die strategischen Initiativen von CorSo. Das Mandat von CRE besteht darin, sicherzustellen, dass unsere internen Gemeinschaften bereit, willens und in der Lage sind, die verschiedenen Prozess- und Technologieänderungen zu übernehmen, die sich auf ihre Rollen auswirken. Wir arbeiten auch eng mit Projektmanagern und Führungskräften zusammen, um Transparenz und Zusammenarbeit im gesamten Portfolio sicherzustellen. Wenn Sie nach einer Rolle suchen, in der Sie strategisches Denken anwenden und innerhalb von CorSo etwas bewirken können - das ist es.

Über dich

Sie sind ein organisierter, neugieriger und menschenorientierter Fachmann, der eine Karriere im Change Management aufbauen möchte.

Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Veränderungsinitiativen, Geschäftstransformationsprogrammen, Systemimplementierungen, Prozessverbesserungsprojekten oder organisatorischen Veränderungsaktivitäten.

• fließendes Englisch, geschrieben und gesprochen.

• Feste MS Office-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint.

• Starke Stakeholder-Engagement- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in mehreren Teams und Geschäftsfunktionen.

• Erfahrung mit der Koordination von Aktivitäten, Zeitplänen, Abhängigkeiten und Leistungen über mehrere Workstreams hinweg.

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten.

Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Change Communications, Schulungen oder Adoptionsaktivitäten.

• Exposition gegenüber großen, matrixförmigen Organisationen, vorzugsweise innerhalb von Finanzdienstleistungen oder Versicherungen.

• Prosci, CCMP oder andere Change Management-Zertifizierung (oder aktive Verfolgung).

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Zuständigkeiten der Rolle,

• das Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.
Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive leistungsbasierte variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen würdigt.
Darüber hinaus genießen Sie eine Vielzahl von globalen und standortspezifischen Vorteilen. Die Berechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re Police und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
Wir geben allen Kandidaten Feedback per E-Mail. Wenn Sie noch nichts von uns gehört haben, überprüfen Sie bitte Ihren Spam-Ordner.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Questo ruolo richiede di identificare e analizzare le esposizioni di installazione di energia rinnovabile operativa, costruzione e attrezzature per varie classi di settore, eseguire analisi di scrittura per i rischi di grandi e medi, e sviluppare forti relazioni di marketing con i broker e i clienti in Brasile.
Compiti chiave:

• Analizzando i rischi e le sue esposizioni per determinare il livello di qualità del rischio, lavorando anche su possibili scenari di perdita massima probabili;

• Revisione delle parole di assicurazione sottostanti;

• Lavoro sullo sviluppo e la gestione del portafoglio per l'energia rinnovabile operativa

• Lavoro per lo sviluppo e la gestione di CAR/EAR;

• Preparare le sottomissioni di riferimento secondo l'autorità UW guida interna.

• Sviluppare e mantenere una rete di connessioni commerciali al fine di posizionare Swiss Re come il preferito Renewable Energy (Rischio Operativo) e partner business Engineering, per garantire un flusso costante di presentazioni con un elevato rapporto di successo;

• Mantenere e condividere l'intelligenza di mercato con i colleghi.
Informazioni sulla squadra
La posizione sarà quella di comporre il team Engineering and Renewable Energy Underwriting, diventando parte di un gruppo che lavora insieme per lo sviluppo costante della conoscenza, consentendo una posizione di leadership nelle soluzioni di mercato.
A proposito di te
Hai forti competenze interpersonali e comunicare bene, nuove idee ti eccitano e sei entusiasta di esplorare nuove esperienze e possibilità.
Essenziale:

• L'ingegnere si è laureato.

• Esperienza nel mercato delle assicurazioni, come sottoscrittore di energia.

• Conoscenza generale del Verbo Operativo.
Bello da avere:

• Conoscenza generale Ingegneria formulazione.

• Buona fluenza in inglese.

• Proficiente in Excel, Wording e Power BI.

• Impegni capacità di soddisfare i consegnabili a clienti e partner.
Informazioni su Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative alle grandi e medie multinazionali dalle nostre circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro una pace aggiuntiva della mente.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un luogo di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico al lavoro e alla loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto di ritorno alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie verbringen Ihre Tage damit, die Rentabilität eines Unternehmens zu beeinflussen und an differenzierten Lösungen für den Markt zu arbeiten. Interne Stakeholder arbeiten zusammen und tragen zu Ihrer persönlichen Entwicklung bei und bilden ein Team, das vom lokalen und externen Markt als Referenz anerkannt wird. Sie werden die Erfahrung haben, Ihr Wissen in den unterschiedlichsten Arten von Projekten zu vertiefen, die derzeit im Land im Gange sind, immer mit der Unterstützung von Spezialisten und äußerst erfahrenen Fachleuten auf der ganzen Welt, die einen äußerst reichen Wissensaustausch ermöglichen.
Über die Rolle
Diese Rolle erfordert, dass Sie operative Erneuerbare Energien, Bau- und Anlageninstallationsrisiken für verschiedene Branchenklassen identifizieren und analysieren, Zeichnungsanalysen für große und mittlere Risiken durchführen und starke Marketingbeziehungen mit Brokern und Kunden in Brasilien aufbauen.
Hauptaufgaben:

• Analyse der Risiken und ihrer Risiken zur Bestimmung des Risikoqualitätsniveaus, wobei auch an möglichen höchstwahrscheinlichen Verlustszenarien gearbeitet wird;

• Überprüfung der zugrunde liegenden Versicherungstexte;

• Entwicklung und Management des Portfolios für operative erneuerbare Energien

• Entwicklung und Management für CAR/EAR;

• Vorbereitung von Empfehlungseinreichungen gemäß interner Anleitung UW-Behörde.

• Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks von Geschäftsbeziehungen, um Swiss Re als bevorzugten Geschäftspartner für Erneuerbare Energien (Operational Risk) und Engineering zu positionieren, um einen nachhaltigen Fluss von Einreichungen bei gleichzeitig hoher Trefferquote zu gewährleisten;

• Bewahren und teilen Sie Marktinformationen mit Mitarbeitern.
Über das Team
Die Position wird darin bestehen, das Engineering and Renewable Energy Underwriting-Team zusammenzustellen und Teil einer Gruppe zu werden, die für die ständige Entwicklung von Wissen zusammenarbeitet und eine Führungsposition bei Marktlösungen ermöglicht.
Über dich
Du hast starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kommunizierst gut, neue Ideen begeistern dich und du bist daran interessiert, neue Erfahrungen und Möglichkeiten zu erkunden.
Wesentliche Bestandteile:

• Ingenieur absolvierte.

• Erfahrung im Versicherungsmarkt, als Energy Underwriter.

• Allgemeine Kenntnisse über Operational Wording.
Schön zu haben:

• Allgemeines Wissen Technischer Wortlaut.

• Gut fließend auf Englisch.

• Proficient in Excel, Wording und Power BI.

• Verpflichtungen Fähigkeit, Leistungen an Kunden und Partner zu erfüllen.
Über Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen der versicherungsbasierten Risikoübertragung. Wir antizipieren und managen Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität.

Wir bieten innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittlere multinationale Konzerne an unseren rund 50 Standorten weltweit. Wir helfen Kunden, ihre Risikoexposition zu mindern, während unser branchenführender Schadenservice ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit bietet.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. jobs.description:
We are looking for an agile, motivated, and dedicated individual who is ready to join our APAC Property and Casualty Operations Team in Bangalore as Reinsurance Operations Associate. APAC Operations is part of the P&C Re Operations Division, which handles the in-force reinsurance business from end to end.
 About the role:
 In this role, you will be responsible for handling end to end reinsurance accounts and claims, ensuring business deliverables are met (quality output within the turnaround times defined) through adequate understanding of Reinsurance contractual conditions. You will be working within a set framework of policies, processes and having potential opportunities to improve the same. You will own responsibility for an assigned portfolio of APAC clients and collaborate with business partners internally and externally. You will work in a dynamic environment by being capable of navigating through periods of change and ambiguity. You will also be encouraged to pro-actively pursue your career advancement by developing current and new areas of competence on own initiative.
 The role comprises, but not limited to, the following elements: -
 End-to-end processing of client Reinsurance accounts (premiums, claims, brokerage, etc.) ensuring deliverables and quality standards are met as defined

• Handling Reinsurance claims (simple to mid complex cases) through adequate understanding of Reinsurance Claims principles

• Capture accurate claim information by referring to claim advice reported by clients/ brokers and contract documents/conditions

• Maintain accuracy and quality parameters as defined by the process

• Rigorous follow up on outstanding queries/topics as per the defined process using the escalation matrix

• Problem solving/analysis for own portfolio, to determine underlying trends and following up on the same to deliver closure of issues

• Ensure financial transactions/payments are in adherence to processes and guidelines, quality management framework and key controls

• Timely collection of funds (Accounts Receivable), keeping track of financials within the assigned portfolio

• Ensure timely and accurate reporting and compliance with internal/external/regulatory requirements and/or commitments

• Manage own workload effectively to achieve agreed service/business standards

• Contact internal business partners and external clients directly (either written or verbal) to resolve any long pending operational issues like missing accounting information, incorrect data, payment delays, etc.

• You will work collaboratively across teams, functions and regions and support the requirements of internal clients

• Usage of PowerBI and data tools to assess and steer the portfolio
 About the team:
 You will join a very experienced and highly motivated Reinsurance operations team handling portfolios for diverse APAC regions. Our responsibilities require regular interactions with peers and experts from other locations, deliver best service and most value to our clients. With our continuous improvement mindset our aim is to provide our external clients and internal partners with fast, easy, and effective ways of conducting business within an environment where the risks are understood.
 About you:
 Minimum bachelor's in finance, Accounting, Insurance, or related fields, with min 3 years of work experience
 Flair for figures and proficiency in Excel
 Good verbal and written business interpersonal skills
 Being an agile team player with the ability to manage own workload and demonstrate a sense of Accountability, Responsibility and Commitment
 Ability to work together collaboratively, flexibly, and constructively in a team/group environment including in virtual set-ups
 Ability to challenge the status quo and manage multiple business partners (multi-cultural and cross functional teams in a virtual set-up)
 Insurance/Finance related certifications will be an added advantage
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

jobs.description:
About Us
 At Swiss Re, we build innovative, cloud‑native solutions that help Life & Health insurance companies around the world operate smarter, faster, and more securely. Our internal software house delivers modern SaaS and PaaS products used globally — from mature enterprise platforms like Magnum to new and rapidly scaling solutions.
 With a technical community of more than 150+ engineers , architects, and cloud specialists across multiple countries, we design highly available, multi‑regional products built on cutting‑edge technologies and a strong engineering culture focused on quality, innovation, and resilience.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a AI Architect to lead architecture across our Data Analytics and AI/GenAI offerings.
 You will design and shape a cloud-native, enterprise-grade SaaS environment built on Azure, using technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse, modern data lakehouse architecture , and supporting AI components powered by LLMs, RAG, OCR, NLP , and more.
 This is a hands-on leadership role where you will combine high-level architecture with real implementation, experimentation, and guidance for engineering teams. You will be part of our technical leadership group, influencing product direction, platform evolution, and long-term technology strategy.
 What You Will Do
 Architecture & Design

• Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native platforms

• Create architectures with self-healing and highly available capabilities

• Model systems and define technical documentation and specifications
 Technical Leadership

• Guide engineering teams through best practices, design decisions, and innovation

• Present architectural roadmaps to product and business stakeholders

• Mentor engineers and drive strong engineering standards
 Hands-on Engineering

• Contribute to development, troubleshooting, and platform evolution

• Lead PoCs exploring emerging technologies (AI/ML, data engineering, cloud services)

• Support implementation with practical expertise in cloud, code, and infrastructure
 Strategic Impact

• Shape the long-term architecture vision for Data & AI platforms

• Identify future opportunities in cloud, data, AI, and automation
 About You
 We don’t expect perfection — but we’re looking for someone who brings strong architectural thinking, a hands-on mindset, and the curiosity to push technical boundaries.
 You have strong experience with:

• Cloud Architecture: Enterprise-grade Azure solutions (AKS, networking, CDN, WAF, etc.)

• SaaS Platforms: Multi-tenant, high-availability systems

• System Design: Java/Spring MVC and distributed systems

• Security: Zero Trust principles, authentication & network security

• Integrations: REST, SOAP, event-driven patterns

• DevSecOps: CI/CD, IaC, cloud automation, resilient infrastructure

• Architecture Modelling: Technical specs, design documentation

• Team Leadership: Coaching multicultural engineering teams
 Bonus points for:

• Experience with quality and vulnerability tools (SonarQube, Invicti, Aqua)

• Additional non-Java programming background (Python, .NET, ideally Go)

• Maven and/or Gradle experience

For Spain the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 60.000] and [EUR100.000] (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognize your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.

Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

A proposito di te

La tua personalità resiliente ti consente di navigare in modo efficace nel cambiamento mentre fai da mentore agli altri. Sei appassionato di creare soluzioni eleganti ed efficienti e di ampliare continuamente le tue competenze tecniche.

Siamo un datore di lavoro di pari opportunità e la diversità di valore nella nostra azienda. Non discriminare in base a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, genere, tra cui identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, età, stato civile, stato veterano, o stato di disabilità.

As a Senior UI Developer, you'll be the technical cornerstone of our product development lifecycle. You'll collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and UX teams to architect, implement, and maintain sophisticated user interfaces that meet business needs while delivering exceptional user experiences.

Our team is the global L&H Reinsurance Engineering team, responsible for the technical Architecture and Engineering of IT solutions for Reinsurance business unit. The team members are passionate about technologies in building enterprise grade products with a deep understanding of reinsurance business. We closely collaborate with other teams and colleagues around the globe to share knowledge and engineer solutions.
Growing experience will, over time, give you a broad view on Architecture & Engineering of a global reinsurer and enable you to have a comprehensive understanding, people and systems involved and how these systems shape business outcomes. This will allow you to build up an excellent foundation for a next career step in a role closer to the operational business activities in our global organization.
About You
You're a forward-thinking UI expert who thrives in collaborative environments. You approach challenges with creativity and pragmatism, balancing technical excellence with business needs. Your resilient personality enables you to navigate change effectively while mentoring others. You're passionate about creating elegant, efficient solutions and continuously expanding your technical expertise.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 10+ years of experience in UI technologies

• Expert-level proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and frontend frameworks (React.js preferred)

• Strong understanding of UI architecture, component-based development, and state management (Redux, Context API, MobX)

• Understanding of security best practices and data privacy compliance

• Contributions to open-source UI frameworks or community engagement

• Experience with high-performance, data-intensive UI applications

• Understanding of insurance/reinsurance business

• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across cultures and geographies

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, including gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Accountant to join our Finance team supporting the Canadian Branches of Swiss Re, covering Life and Health Reinsurance, Property and Casualty Reinsurance, and Property and Casualty Direct Insurance.
 This role offers an opportunity to build hands-on experience in financial reporting under IFRS 17, and regulatory capital management frameworks, working within a global reinsurance organization. You will support key accounting and reporting processes while collaborating with cross-functional teams across Toronto and international locations including US, India and Europe.
 This is an ideal role for candidates to develop expertise in insurance/reinsurance accounting, capital reporting, and financial analysis within a structured and well-controlled environment while working towards a CPA designation.
 Key Responsibilities

• Support the preparation of technical (IFRS 17) and non-technical (investments, expenses) financial data for regulatory and internal reporting, including:

• Running reports from key source systems, including SAP subledger and general ledger

• Reconciling & analyzing reinsurance cashflow data (premiums, claims, costs) between key source systems.

• Performing quarterly analyses over non-technical investment results and general & administrative expenses

• Assist in the analysis of insurance results under IFRS 17, including understanding key movements in Balance sheet and P&L items, and gathering explanations for key variances versus prior periods and expectations

• Supporting the preparation of quarterly MD&A presentations and annual year-end financial statements (balances and disclosures).

• Building cross-functional working relationships with Central Finance, Actuarial, Claims, Underwriting, and Operations teams to resolve accounting and data issues.

• Support quarterly capital reporting and forecasting, including data validation and reconciliation

• Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of reporting deliverables, including appropriate documentation to support internal controls and audit requirements.

• Perform operational tasks including but not limited to:

• Submission of financial information to various regulatory platforms, such as OSFI, AMF, Statistics Canada, and industry trade associations

• Handling the Canada Finance team's Purchase orders and invoice processing

• Ad hoc cheque deposits and monthly bank reconciliations

• Premium tax filings

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and apply automation in financial reporting processes.

• Support implementation of enhancements related to systems, data quality, and controls.
 About the Team
 The Canadian Finance team is responsible for the accounting and reporting of reinsurance & direct insurance technical balances (premiums, claims, commissions, reserves, together with intra-group reinsurance – "IGR" - thereon), and non-technical balances (e.g., investments, general expenses) for the Canadian Branches of Swiss Re. The team works with various business partners in support of relevant transactions. You will be joining a diverse and inclusive team of finance professionals that come from a variety of backgrounds and experience within the industry. The team works well in a collaborative environment while fostering and developing independent thought.

About You

Experience & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field

• Actively pursuing CPA designation
 Technical Skills

• Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, lookups, data analysis)

• Experience with financial systems (e.g., SAP, FPSL, Business Objects) is an asset

• Exposure to automation tools or process improvement initiatives is an asset
 Core Competencies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• High attention to detail and data integrity

• Ability to manage competing deadlines in a structured reporting environment

• Strong communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams
 The base salary hiring range for this new position is CAD $60,000-75,000. The specific base salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Informazioni sul ruolo
Siamo alla ricerca di un contabile finanziario altamente motivato e orientato al dettaglio per unire il nostro team di finanza che supporta le filiali canadesi di Swiss Re, coprendo la vita e la salute di assicurazione, la proprietà e la sicurezza di responsabilità, e la proprietà e la casualità di assicurazione diretta.
Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di costruire esperienze pratiche nella rendicontazione finanziaria ai sensi dell'IFRS 17, e dei quadri di gestione dei capitali regolamentari, lavorando all'interno di un'organizzazione di riassicurazione globale. Potrai supportare i processi di contabilità e reporting chiave, collaborando con team interfunzionali in Toronto e sedi internazionali tra cui Stati Uniti, India e Europa.
Questo è un ruolo ideale per i candidati a sviluppare competenze nella contabilità di assicurazione / riassicurazione, la rendicontazione dei capitali e l'analisi finanziaria all'interno di un ambiente strutturato e ben controllato mentre si lavora verso una designazione CPA.
Principali responsabilità

• Sostenere la preparazione di dati finanziari tecnici (IFRS 17) e non tecnici (investimenti, spese) per la segnalazione normativa e interna, tra cui:

• Rapporti in esecuzione da sistemi sorgente chiave, tra cui subledger SAP e registro generale

• Riconciliare e analizzare i dati del flusso di cassa di riassicurazione (premium, reclami, costi) tra i sistemi di sorgente chiave.

• Eseguire analisi trimestrali sui risultati degli investimenti non tecnici e sulle spese generali e amministrative

• Assistere nell'analisi dei risultati assicurativi ai sensi dell'IFRS 17, compresi i movimenti chiave di comprensione delle voci Balance Sheet e P&L, e raccogliere spiegazioni per le variazioni chiave rispetto ai periodi e alle aspettative precedenti

• Sostenere la preparazione di presentazioni trimestrali MD&A e di bilancio di fine anno (equilibrio e divulgazione).

• Costruire relazioni di lavoro interfunzionali con i team Central Finance, Actuarial, Claims, Underwriting e Operations per risolvere i problemi di contabilità e dati.

• Supporta report trimestrali di capitale e previsioni, tra cui convalida dei dati e riconciliazione

• Assicurare l'accuratezza dei dati, la completezza e la tempestività dei resoconti, inclusa la documentazione appropriata per supportare i controlli interni e i requisiti di audit.

• Eseguire i compiti operativi, inclusi ma non limitati:

• Sottomissione di informazioni finanziarie a varie piattaforme di regolamentazione, come OSFI, AMF, Statistiche Canada, e associazioni del settore

• Gestione degli ordini e dell'elaborazione delle fatture del team Canada Finance

• Depositi di assegni ad hoc e conciliazioni bancarie mensili

• Fili fiscali premium

• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'efficienza e applicare l'automazione nei processi di reporting finanziario.

• Supporta l'implementazione di miglioramenti relativi a sistemi, qualità dei dati e controlli.
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team canadese delle Finanze è responsabile per la contabilità e la rendicontazione dei bilanci tecnici di assicurazione diretta (premium, reclami, commissioni, riserve, insieme alla riassicurazione intra-gruppo – "IGR" - thereon), e bilanci non tecnici (ad esempio, investimenti, spese generali) per le Filiali Canadesi di Re Svizzera. Il team lavora con vari partner commerciali a supporto di operazioni rilevanti. Ti unirai a un team diversificato e inclusivo di professionisti finanziari che provengono da una varietà di background e di esperienza all'interno del settore. Il team lavora bene in un ambiente collaborativo, promuovendo e sviluppando un pensiero indipendente.

A proposito di te

Esperienza e qualifiche

• Laurea in contabilità, finanza o campo relativo

• Inseguimento attivo della designazione CPA
Competenze tecniche

• Avanzate competenze Excel (PivotTables, lookups, analisi dati)

• L'esperienza con i sistemi finanziari (ad esempio, SAP, FPSL, Business Objects) è un asset

• L'esposizione a strumenti di automazione o iniziative di miglioramento dei processi è un bene
Competenze di base

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving

• Alta attenzione ai dettagli e integrità dei dati

• Capacità di gestire le scadenze concorrenti in un ambiente di reporting strutturato

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare in team interfunzionali
Il range di assunzione di stipendio base per questa nuova posizione è CAD $60,000-75.000. Lo stipendio base specifico offerto per questo o qualsiasi dato ruolo terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui ma non limitato alla posizione del lavoro, alla portata del ruolo, alle qualifiche, alla complessità/specializzazione/scarsità del talento, dell'esperienza, dell'istruzione e del bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Le decisioni sull'occupazione si basano esclusivamente sulle qualifiche di un individuo per la posizione in essere.

Durante il processo di reclutamento, su richiesta sono disponibili sistemazioni ragionevoli per disabili. Se contattato per un colloquio, si prega di informare il Recruiter/HR Professional dell'alloggio necessario.

Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Accountant to join our Finance team supporting the Canadian Branches of Swiss Re, covering Life and Health Reinsurance, Property and Casualty Reinsurance, and Property and Casualty Direct Insurance.
This role offers an opportunity to build hands-on experience in financial reporting under IFRS 17, and regulatory capital management frameworks, working within a global reinsurance organization. You will support key accounting and reporting processes while collaborating with cross-functional teams across Toronto and international locations including US, India and Europe.
This is an ideal role for candidates to develop expertise in insurance/reinsurance accounting, capital reporting, and financial analysis within a structured and well-controlled environment while working towards a CPA designation.
Key Responsibilities

• Support the preparation of technical (IFRS 17) and non-technical (investments, expenses) financial data for regulatory and internal reporting, including:

• Running reports from key source systems, including SAP subledger and general ledger

• Reconciling & analyzing reinsurance cashflow data (premiums, claims, costs) between key source systems.

• Performing quarterly analyses over non-technical investment results and general & administrative expenses

• Assist in the analysis of insurance results under IFRS 17, including understanding key movements in Balance sheet and P&L items, and gathering explanations for key variances versus prior periods and expectations

• Supporting the preparation of quarterly MD&A presentations and annual year-end financial statements (balances and disclosures).

• Building cross-functional working relationships with Central Finance, Actuarial, Claims, Underwriting, and Operations teams to resolve accounting and data issues.

• Support quarterly capital reporting and forecasting, including data validation and reconciliation

• Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of reporting deliverables, including appropriate documentation to support internal controls and audit requirements.

• Perform operational tasks including but not limited to:

• Submission of financial information to various regulatory platforms, such as OSFI, AMF, Statistics Canada, and industry trade associations

• Handling the Canada Finance team's Purchase orders and invoice processing

• Ad hoc cheque deposits and monthly bank reconciliations

• Premium tax filings

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and apply automation in financial reporting processes.

• Support implementation of enhancements related to systems, data quality, and controls.
About the Team
The Canadian Finance team is responsible for the accounting and reporting of reinsurance & direct insurance technical balances (premiums, claims, commissions, reserves, together with intra-group reinsurance – "IGR" - thereon), and non-technical balances (e.g., investments, general expenses) for the Canadian Branches of Swiss Re. The team works with various business partners in support of relevant transactions. You will be joining a diverse and inclusive team of finance professionals that come from a variety of backgrounds and experience within the industry. The team works well in a collaborative environment while fostering and developing independent thought.

About You

Experience & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field

• Actively pursuing CPA designation
Technical Skills

• Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, lookups, data analysis)

• Experience with financial systems (e.g., SAP, FPSL, Business Objects) is an asset

• Exposure to automation tools or process improvement initiatives is an asset
Core Competencies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• High attention to detail and data integrity

• Ability to manage competing deadlines in a structured reporting environment

• Strong communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams
The base salary hiring range for this new position is CAD $60,000-75,000. The specific base salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten und detailorientierten Finanzbuchhalter, der sich unserem Finanzteam anschließt, das die kanadischen Niederlassungen von Swiss Re unterstützt und die Lebens- und Krankenversicherung, Sach- und Unfallrückversicherung sowie Sach- und Unfallversicherung abdeckt.
Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen in der Finanzberichterstattung nach IFRS 17 und in regulatorischen Kapitalverwaltungsrahmen in einer globalen Rückversicherungsorganisation zu sammeln. Sie unterstützen wichtige Buchhaltungs- und Berichtsprozesse und arbeiten mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams in Toronto und internationalen Standorten wie den USA, Indien und Europa zusammen.
Dies ist eine ideale Rolle für Kandidaten, um Fachwissen in der Versicherungs- / Rückversicherungsbuchhaltung, Kapitalberichterstattung und Finanzanalyse in einem strukturierten und gut kontrollierten Umfeld zu entwickeln, während sie auf eine CPA-Bezeichnung hinarbeiten.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Unterstützung der Erstellung technischer (IFRS 17) und nichttechnischer (Investitionen, Aufwendungen) Finanzdaten für die regulatorische und interne Berichterstattung, einschließlich:

• Ausführen von Berichten aus Schlüsselquellensystemen, einschließlich SAP-Subledger und General Ledger

• Abstimmung und Analyse von Rückversicherungs-Cashflow-Daten (Prämien, Forderungen, Kosten) zwischen Schlüsselquellensystemen.

• Durchführung von Quartalsanalysen über nichttechnische Anlageergebnisse und allgemeine und administrative Aufwendungen

• Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Versicherungsergebnissen nach IFRS 17, einschließlich des Verständnisses der wichtigsten Bewegungen in Bilanz- und P&L-Positionen und der Sammlung von Erklärungen für wichtige Abweichungen gegenüber früheren Perioden und Erwartungen

• Unterstützung der Erstellung von vierteljährlichen MD&A-Präsentationen und Jahresabschlüssen zum Jahresende (Salden und Angaben).

• Aufbau funktionsübergreifender Arbeitsbeziehungen mit Teams von Central Finance, Actuarial, Claims, Underwriting und Operations zur Lösung von Buchhaltungs- und Datenproblemen.

• Unterstützung der vierteljährlichen Kapitalberichterstattung und -prognose, einschließlich Datenvalidierung und -abgleich

• Gewährleistung der Datengenauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität der Berichtsunterlagen, einschließlich einer angemessenen Dokumentation zur Unterstützung der internen Kontrollen und Auditanforderungen.

• Durchführung betrieblicher Aufgaben, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Übermittlung von Finanzinformationen an verschiedene Regulierungsplattformen wie OSFI, AMF, Statistics Canada und Branchenverbände

• Bearbeitung der Bestellungen des Canada Finance Teams und Rechnungsbearbeitung

• Ad-hoc-Scheckeinlagen und monatliche Bankabgleiche

• Prämiensteuererklärungen

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, die Effizienz zu verbessern und Automatisierung in Finanzberichterstattungsprozessen anzuwenden.

• Unterstützung der Implementierung von Verbesserungen in Bezug auf Systeme, Datenqualität und Kontrollen.
Über das Team
Das Canadian Finance Team ist verantwortlich für die Bilanzierung und Berichterstattung von technischen Rückversicherungs- und Direktversicherungssalden (Prämien, Forderungen, Provisionen, Rücklagen, zusammen mit gruppeninterner Rückversicherung - "IGR" - darauf) und nichttechnischen Salden (z. B. Investitionen, allgemeine Aufwendungen) für die kanadischen Niederlassungen von Swiss Re. Das Team arbeitet mit verschiedenen Geschäftspartnern zusammen, um relevante Transaktionen zu unterstützen. Sie werden einem vielfältigen und integrativen Team von Finanzexperten beitreten, die aus einer Vielzahl von Hintergründen und Erfahrungen in der Branche stammen. Das Team arbeitet gut in einer kollaborativen Umgebung und fördert und entwickelt unabhängiges Denken.

Über dich

Erfahrung & Qualifikationen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Buchhaltung, Finanzen oder verwandten Bereichen

• Aktive Verfolgung der CPA-Bezeichnung
Technische Fähigkeiten

• Erweiterte Excel-Fähigkeiten (PivotTables, Lookups, Datenanalyse)

• Erfahrung mit Finanzsystemen (z.B. SAP, FPSL, Business Objects) ist ein Asset

• Die Exposition gegenüber Automatisierungstools oder Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen ist ein Vorteil
Kernkompetenzen

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten

• Hohe Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Datenintegrität

• Fähigkeit, konkurrierende Fristen in einer strukturierten Berichtsumgebung zu verwalten

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Fähigkeit, in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu arbeiten
Die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese neue Position beträgt CAD 60.000-75,000. Das spezifische Grundgehalt, das für diese oder eine bestimmte Rolle angeboten wird, berücksichtigt eine Reihe von Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Arbeitsplatz, den Umfang der Rolle, die Qualifikationen, die Komplexität / Spezialisierung / Knappheit von Talenten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Arbeitgeberbudget. Bei Swiss Re verfolgen wir einen "Gesamtvergütungsansatz", wenn wir Entschädigungsentscheidungen treffen. Dies bedeutet, dass wir alle Komponenten der Entschädigung in ihrer Gesamtheit (wie Grundvergütung, kurz- und langfristige Anreize und angebotene Leistungen) bei der Festlegung der individuellen Entschädigung berücksichtigen.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Schweizer Re ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Es ist unsere Praxis, ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Alter, Schwangerschaft, sexuelle Orientierungen, Familienstand, Militärstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale zu rekrutieren, einzustellen und zu fördern. Entscheidungen über die Beschäftigung basieren ausschließlich auf den Qualifikationen einer Person für die zu besetzende Stelle.

Während des Rekrutierungsprozesses sind angemessene Unterkünfte für Behinderungen auf Anfrage verfügbar. Wenn Sie für ein Interview kontaktiert werden, informieren Sie bitte den Recruiter / HR Professional über die erforderliche Unterkunft.

Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.
