jobs.description:
Locations:
Kansas City, MO, US |
Armonk, NY, US |
Fort Wayne, IN, US

Are you a technically savvy problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and the insurance industry? Do you love translating complex technical challenges into elegant, real-world solutions? If so, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact at Swiss Re.
 About the Role
 As a Technical Design Consultant, you will be at the heart of delivering MagnumXP — Swiss Re's industry-leading automated underwriting solution — to client companies across North America. This is a high-visibility, client-facing role where your technical expertise will directly shape how our clients integrate and benefit from one of the most innovative tools in the life insurance space. With significant new client activity underway and continued investment in the MagnumXP Solution, there has never been a more exciting time to join this team.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead technical design and integration : Architect and design integration blueprints for MagnumXP client deployments, ensuring seamless fit within clients' existing IT environments across the Americas

• Drive pre-sales engagement : Deliver compelling pre-sales presentations and provide technical support of the MagnumXP solution to technical audiences, helping prospective clients understand its full potential

• Collaborate across stakeholders : Liaise with clients' in-house IT staff, system integrators, and business partners to plan and identify optimal integration options

• Define and document requirements : Develop clear business and non-functional requirements , and raise well-structured change requests to Product Management

• Support the full implementation lifecycle : Support clients throughout initial installation, integration, and testing and all the way through to production go-live

• Champion best practices : Consult with clients on system integration testing best practices , ensuring robust and reliable deployments

• Coordinate global software releases : Work with MagnumXP colleagues and global development teams to align client software releases , specify and review requirements for core system changes, and validate new releases

• Provide technical support : Serve as one of the key regional resource for handling service issues and change requests with efficiency and care

• Enable client success through training : Deliver required API training to clients on the effective use of MagnumXP software

• Travel as needed : Engage in periodic on-site work at client offices across North America, with occasional international travel to collaborate with global MagnumXP colleagues
 About the Team
 You will be part of the MagnumXP Americas team, sitting within the Life and Health Solutions unit at Swiss Re. Our team is dedicated to implementing and delivering MagnumXP — Swiss Re's suite of underwriting tools — to client companies across US, Canada and Latin America. MagnumXP plays a pivotal role in our clients' risk management strategies, enabling optimized operational processes and laying the groundwork for future growth. Reporting to the Head of L&H UW Solutions, America, you will join a collaborative, globally connected team that is experiencing an exciting period of growth, with significant new client activity.
 About You
 You are a curious, solutions-oriented consultant who brings both depth and breadth to every challenge. You communicate complex ideas with clarity and confidence, build trusted relationships across business and technical disciplines, and approach problems with a logical, detail-oriented mindset. You are energized by working in a dynamic, client-facing environment and are motivated to grow your knowledge of the insurance and reinsurance industry. A collaborative team player at heart, you bring a strong planning and delivery mindset and the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders toward a common goal.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Experience with or knowledge of rule processing engines

• Demonstrated ability to present technical concepts to non-technical audiences in a clear and persuasive manner

• Strong relationship-building skills across both business and technical disciplines

• A track record of successfully managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-driven environment

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with RESTful web services, Java, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS

• Solid knowledge of web service standards , including XML and JSON, as well as industry security standards covering authentication and authorization

• Database proficiency , including query development and experience with reporting tools, combined with familiarity with change management processes and version control software

• Architect, systems analyst, or developer background with broad experience across a range of technologies, preferably within a life insurance environment

• A degree in Computer Science or an equivalent technical discipline
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with the life insurance or reinsurance industry

• Experience or comfort working across global, cross-functional teams
 The estimated base salary range for this position for Armonk, NY is between $161,000 to $269,000 and for Fort Wayne, IN and Kansas City, MO, the range is between $150,000 to $250,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week; however, for an exceptional candidate, the role may be performed remotely within the USA.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sei una tecnicamente esperto problem-solver che prospera all'incrocio di tecnologia all'avanguardia e l'industria dell'assicurazione? Ti piace tradurre complesse sfide tecniche in soluzioni eleganti e reali? Se è così, questa è la vostra opportunità di fare un impatto significativo a Swiss Re.
Informazioni sul ruolo
In qualità di Technical Design Consultant, sarai al centro della fornitura di MagnumXP - soluzione di sottoscrizione automatizzata leader nel settore di Swiss Re - alle aziende clienti in tutto il Nord America. Si tratta di un ruolo di alta visibilità, rivolto al cliente, in cui la vostra competenza tecnica formerà direttamente come i nostri clienti integrano e beneficiano di uno degli strumenti più innovativi nello spazio di assicurazione sulla vita. Con una significativa nuova attività client in corso e un investimento continuato nella soluzione MagnumXP, non c'è mai stato un momento più emozionante per unirsi a questo team.
Principali responsabilità

• Progettazione tecnica di piombo e integrazione: progetti di integrazione architettonica e di progettazione per le implementazioni dei clienti MagnumXP, garantendo una perfetta vestibilità all'interno degli ambienti IT esistenti dei clienti in tutte le Americhe

• Guidare l'impegno pre-vendita: fornire presentazioni pre-vendita convincenti e fornire supporto tecnico della soluzione MagnumXP al pubblico tecnico, aiutando i potenziali clienti a capire il suo pieno potenziale

• Collabora tra le parti interessate: Liaise con il personale IT interno dei clienti, integratori di sistema e partner commerciali per pianificare e identificare le opzioni di integrazione ottimali

• Definire e documentare i requisiti: sviluppare requisiti aziendali e non funzionali e aumentare le richieste di cambiamento ben strutturate nella gestione dei prodotti

• Sostenere il ciclo di vita completo di implementazione: Supportare i clienti durante l'installazione iniziale, l'integrazione e il test e tutto il percorso fino alla produzione

• Migliori pratiche campione: Consultare con i clienti sulle migliori pratiche di test di integrazione del sistema, garantendo implementazioni robuste e affidabili

• Coordinate le versioni del software globale: Lavora con i colleghi MagnumXP e i team di sviluppo globali per allineare le versioni del software client , specificare e rivedere i requisiti per le modifiche del sistema core e convalidare le nuove versioni

• Fornire assistenza tecnica: Servire come una delle risorse regionali chiave per la gestione dei problemi di servizio e cambiare le richieste con efficienza e cura

• Abilitare il successo del cliente attraverso la formazione: fornire la formazione API necessaria ai clienti sull'uso efficace del software MagnumXP

• Viaggiare come necessario: Impegnarsi nel lavoro in loco periodico presso gli uffici clienti in Nord America, con occasionali viaggi internazionali per collaborare con i colleghi globali MagnumXP
Informazioni sulla squadra
Faremo parte del team MagnumXP Americas, che siede all'interno dell'unità Life and Health Solutions di Swiss Re. Il nostro team è dedicato all'implementazione e alla fornitura di MagnumXP - Swiss Re's suite of underwriting tools - alle aziende clienti di Stati Uniti, Canada e America Latina. MagnumXP svolge un ruolo fondamentale nelle strategie di gestione del rischio dei nostri clienti, consentendo processi operativi ottimizzati e ponendo le basi per una crescita futura. Reporting to the Head of L&H UW Solutions, America, ti unirai a un team collaborativo e globalmente connesso che sta vivendo un periodo di crescita emozionante, con una significativa nuova attività client.
A proposito di te
Sei un consulente curioso e orientato alle soluzioni che porta profondità e larghezza ad ogni sfida. Comunichi idee complesse con chiarezza e fiducia, costruisci relazioni di fiducia tra le discipline aziendali e tecniche, e affronti problemi con una mentalità logica, orientata ai dettagli. Siete stimolati dal lavoro in un ambiente dinamico, rispetto al cliente e sono motivati a crescere la vostra conoscenza del settore assicurativo e di riassicurazione. Un giocatore di squadra collaborativo a cuore, si porta una forte mentalità di pianificazione e consegna e la capacità di influenzare e allineare i diversi stakeholder verso un obiettivo comune.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Esperienza con o conoscenza dei motori di elaborazione delle regole

• Dimostrata capacità di presentare concetti tecnici al pubblico non tecnico in modo chiaro e persuasivo

• Forte capacità di costruzione di relazioni in entrambe le discipline aziendali e tecniche

• Un track record di gestione con successo di più priorità in un ambiente veloce e guidato dal cliente

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza pratica con i servizi web RESTful, Java, JavaScript, HTML5 e CSS

• Conoscenza solida degli standard di servizio web, tra cui XML e JSON, così come gli standard di sicurezza del settore che coprono l'autenticazione e l'autorizzazione

• Proficienza del database, tra cui lo sviluppo delle query e l'esperienza con gli strumenti di reporting, insieme alla familiarità con i processi di gestione dei cambiamenti e software di controllo delle versioni

• Architetto, analista di sistemi o background sviluppatore con ampia esperienza in una gamma di tecnologie, preferibilmente all'interno di un ambiente di assicurazione vita

• Una laurea in Informatica o una disciplina tecnica equivalente
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Familiarità con l'assicurazione sulla vita o l'industria di riassicurazione

• Esperienza o comfort che lavorano in team globali e multifunzionali
Il range di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione per Armonk, NY è tra $161,000 a $269,000 e per Fort Wayne, IN e Kansas City, MO, la gamma è tra $150,000 a $250,000. Lo stipendio specifico offerto per questo, o qualsiasi dato ruolo terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, la posizione del lavoro, la portata del ruolo, le qualifiche, la complessità/specializzazione/scarsità del talento, l'esperienza, l'istruzione e il bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.
La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana; tuttavia, per un candidato eccezionale, il ruolo può essere svolto in remoto negli Stati Uniti.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Le decisioni sull'occupazione si basano esclusivamente sulle qualifiche di un individuo per la posizione in essere.

Durante il processo di reclutamento, su richiesta sono disponibili sistemazioni ragionevoli per disabili. Se contattato per un colloquio, si prega di informare il Recruiter/HR Professional dell'alloggio necessario.

Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Are you a technically savvy problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and the insurance industry? Do you love translating complex technical challenges into elegant, real-world solutions? If so, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact at Swiss Re.
About the Role
As a Technical Design Consultant, you will be at the heart of delivering MagnumXP — Swiss Re's industry-leading automated underwriting solution — to client companies across North America. This is a high-visibility, client-facing role where your technical expertise will directly shape how our clients integrate and benefit from one of the most innovative tools in the life insurance space. With significant new client activity underway and continued investment in the MagnumXP Solution, there has never been a more exciting time to join this team.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead technical design and integration : Architect and design integration blueprints for MagnumXP client deployments, ensuring seamless fit within clients' existing IT environments across the Americas

• Drive pre-sales engagement : Deliver compelling pre-sales presentations and provide technical support of the MagnumXP solution to technical audiences, helping prospective clients understand its full potential

• Collaborate across stakeholders : Liaise with clients' in-house IT staff, system integrators, and business partners to plan and identify optimal integration options

• Define and document requirements : Develop clear business and non-functional requirements , and raise well-structured change requests to Product Management

• Support the full implementation lifecycle : Support clients throughout initial installation, integration, and testing and all the way through to production go-live

• Champion best practices : Consult with clients on system integration testing best practices , ensuring robust and reliable deployments

• Coordinate global software releases : Work with MagnumXP colleagues and global development teams to align client software releases , specify and review requirements for core system changes, and validate new releases

• Provide technical support : Serve as one of the key regional resource for handling service issues and change requests with efficiency and care

• Enable client success through training : Deliver required API training to clients on the effective use of MagnumXP software

• Travel as needed : Engage in periodic on-site work at client offices across North America, with occasional international travel to collaborate with global MagnumXP colleagues
About the Team
You will be part of the MagnumXP Americas team, sitting within the Life and Health Solutions unit at Swiss Re. Our team is dedicated to implementing and delivering MagnumXP — Swiss Re's suite of underwriting tools — to client companies across US, Canada and Latin America. MagnumXP plays a pivotal role in our clients' risk management strategies, enabling optimized operational processes and laying the groundwork for future growth. Reporting to the Head of L&H UW Solutions, America, you will join a collaborative, globally connected team that is experiencing an exciting period of growth, with significant new client activity.
About You
You are a curious, solutions-oriented consultant who brings both depth and breadth to every challenge. You communicate complex ideas with clarity and confidence, build trusted relationships across business and technical disciplines, and approach problems with a logical, detail-oriented mindset. You are energized by working in a dynamic, client-facing environment and are motivated to grow your knowledge of the insurance and reinsurance industry. A collaborative team player at heart, you bring a strong planning and delivery mindset and the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders toward a common goal.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Experience with or knowledge of rule processing engines

• Demonstrated ability to present technical concepts to non-technical audiences in a clear and persuasive manner

• Strong relationship-building skills across both business and technical disciplines

• A track record of successfully managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-driven environment

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with RESTful web services, Java, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS

• Solid knowledge of web service standards , including XML and JSON, as well as industry security standards covering authentication and authorization

• Database proficiency , including query development and experience with reporting tools, combined with familiarity with change management processes and version control software

• Architect, systems analyst, or developer background with broad experience across a range of technologies, preferably within a life insurance environment

• A degree in Computer Science or an equivalent technical discipline
These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with the life insurance or reinsurance industry

• Experience or comfort working across global, cross-functional teams
The estimated base salary range for this position for Armonk, NY is between $161,000 to $269,000 and for Fort Wayne, IN and Kansas City, MO, the range is between $150,000 to $250,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week; however, for an exceptional candidate, the role may be performed remotely within the USA.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sind Sie ein technisch versierter Problemlöser, der an der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und Versicherungsbranche gedeiht? Lieben Sie es, komplexe technische Herausforderungen in elegante, reale Lösungen zu übersetzen? Wenn ja, ist dies Ihre Chance, bei Swiss Re einen sinnvollen Beitrag zu leisten.
Über die Rolle
Als Technical Design Consultant stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt der Bereitstellung von MagnumXP – der branchenführenden automatisierten Underwriting-Lösung von Swiss Re – für Kundenunternehmen in ganz Nordamerika. Dies ist eine hoch sichtbare, kundenorientierte Rolle, bei der Ihre technische Expertise direkt beeinflusst, wie unsere Kunden eines der innovativsten Tools im Lebensversicherungsbereich integrieren und davon profitieren. Mit erheblichen neuen Kundenaktivitäten und kontinuierlichen Investitionen in die MagnumXP-Lösung gab es noch nie eine aufregendere Zeit, um diesem Team beizutreten.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie technisches Design und Integration: Architekten- und Designintegrations-Blueprints für MagnumXP-Client-Bereitstellungen, die eine nahtlose Anpassung an die bestehenden IT-Umgebungen der Kunden in ganz Amerika gewährleisten

• Förderung des Pre-Sales-Engagements: Liefern Sie überzeugende Pre-Sales-Präsentationen und bieten Sie technische Unterstützung der MagnumXP-Lösung für technische Zielgruppen, damit potenzielle Kunden ihr volles Potenzial erkennen können

• Zusammenarbeit zwischen Stakeholdern: Verbindung mit den internen IT-Mitarbeitern der Kunden, Systemintegratoren und Geschäftspartnern, um optimale Integrationsoptionen zu planen und zu identifizieren

• Definieren und Dokumentieren von Anforderungen: Entwickeln Sie klare geschäftliche und nicht funktionale Anforderungen und erheben Sie gut strukturierte Änderungsanforderungen an das Produktmanagement

• Unterstützen Sie den vollständigen Implementierungslebenszyklus: Unterstützen Sie Clients während der Erstinstallation, Integration und des Tests bis hin zum Go-Live-Betrieb.

• Bieten Sie technischen Support : Dienen Sie als eine der wichtigsten regionalen Ressourcen für den Umgang mit Serviceproblemen und Änderungsanforderungen mit Effizienz und Sorgfalt

• Ermöglichen des Kundenerfolgs durch Schulungen: Liefern Sie den Kunden erforderliche API-Schulungen zum effektiven Einsatz der MagnumXP-Software

• Reisen Sie nach Bedarf: Arbeiten Sie regelmäßig vor Ort in Kundenbüros in ganz Nordamerika mit gelegentlichen internationalen Reisen, um mit globalen MagnumXP-Kollegen zusammenzuarbeiten
Über das Team
Sie werden Teil des MagnumXP Americas-Teams und sitzen in der Life and Health Solutions-Einheit von Swiss Re. Unser Team widmet sich der Implementierung und Bereitstellung von MagnumXP - der Swiss Re-Suite an Underwriting-Tools - für Kundenunternehmen in den USA, Kanada und Lateinamerika. MagnumXP spielt eine zentrale Rolle in den Risikomanagementstrategien unserer Kunden, ermöglicht optimierte operative Prozesse und legt die Grundlage für zukünftiges Wachstum. Wenn Sie an den Head of L&H UW Solutions, Amerika, berichten, treten Sie einem kollaborativen, global vernetzten Team bei, das eine aufregende Wachstumsphase mit erheblichen neuen Kundenaktivitäten durchlebt.
Über dich
Sie sind ein neugieriger, lösungsorientierter Berater, der sowohl Tiefe als auch Breite in jede Herausforderung einbringt. Sie kommunizieren komplexe Ideen mit Klarheit und Vertrauen, bauen vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen zwischen Unternehmen und technischen Disziplinen auf und gehen Probleme mit einer logischen, detailorientierten Denkweise an. Sie werden durch die Arbeit in einem dynamischen, kundenorientierten Umfeld angeregt und sind motiviert, Ihr Wissen über die Versicherungs- und Rückversicherungsbranche zu erweitern. Als kollaborativer Teamplayer bringen Sie eine starke Planungs- und Liefermentalität und die Fähigkeit mit, verschiedene Stakeholder auf ein gemeinsames Ziel zu beeinflussen und auszurichten.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Erfahrung mit oder Kenntnis von Regelverarbeitungsmaschinen

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte dem nicht-technischen Publikum klar und überzeugend zu präsentieren

• Starke Fähigkeiten zum Aufbau von Beziehungen sowohl in geschäftlichen als auch in technischen Disziplinen

• Erfolgreiches Management mehrerer Prioritäten in einer schnelllebigen, kundenorientierten Umgebung

• Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit RESTful Web Services, Java, JavaScript, HTML5 und CSS

• Solides Wissen über Web-Service-Standards, einschließlich XML und JSON, sowie Industrie-Sicherheitsstandards für Authentifizierung und Autorisierung

• Datenbankkenntnisse, einschließlich Abfrageentwicklung und Erfahrung mit Reporting-Tools, kombiniert mit der Vertrautheit mit Change-Management-Prozessen und Versionskontrollsoftware

• Architekt, Systemanalytiker oder Entwicklerhintergrund mit breiter Erfahrung in einer Reihe von Technologien, vorzugsweise in einer Lebensversicherungsumgebung

• Ein Abschluss in Informatik oder einer gleichwertigen technischen Disziplin
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Vertrautheit mit der Lebens- oder Rückversicherungsbranche

• Erfahrung oder Komfort in globalen, funktionsübergreifenden Teams
Die geschätzte Basisgehaltsspanne für diese Position für Armonk, NY, liegt zwischen $ 161.000 und $ 269.000 und für Fort Wayne, IN und Kansas City, MO, liegt die Bandbreite zwischen $ 150.000 und $ 250.000. Das spezifische Gehalt, das dafür oder eine bestimmte Rolle angeboten wird, berücksichtigt eine Reihe von Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Arbeitsplatz, den Umfang der Rolle, die Qualifikationen, die Komplexität / Spezialisierung / Knappheit von Talenten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Arbeitgeberbudget. Bei Swiss Re verfolgen wir einen "Gesamtvergütungsansatz", wenn wir Entschädigungsentscheidungen treffen. Dies bedeutet, dass wir alle Komponenten der Entschädigung in ihrer Gesamtheit (wie Grundvergütung, kurz- und langfristige Anreize und angebotene Leistungen) bei der Festlegung der individuellen Entschädigung berücksichtigen.
Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind; Für einen außergewöhnlichen Kandidaten kann die Rolle jedoch innerhalb der USA aus der Ferne ausgeführt werden.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Êtes-vous un résolveur de problèmes techniquement averti qui prospère à l'intersection de la technologie de pointe et de l'industrie de l'assurance? Vous aimez traduire des défis techniques complexes en solutions élégantes et réelles ? Si oui, c'est l'occasion de faire un impact significatif à Swiss Re.
À propos du rôle
En tant que consultant en conception technique, vous serez au cœur de la livraison de MagnumXP, la solution de souscription automatisée de Swiss Re, aux entreprises clientes de toute l'Amérique du Nord. Il s'agit d'un rôle de grande visibilité, orienté vers le client, où votre expertise technique façonnera directement la façon dont nos clients intègrent et profitent de l'un des outils les plus innovants dans l'espace d'assurance vie. Avec une nouvelle activité cliente importante en cours et un investissement continu dans la solution MagnumXP, il n'y a jamais eu de temps plus excitant pour rejoindre cette équipe.
Principales responsabilités

• Conception et intégration techniques de pointe : plans d'intégration d'architectes et de design pour les déploiements de clients MagnumXP, assurant une intégration transparente dans les environnements informatiques existants des clients à travers les Amériques

• Conduire l'engagement pré-vente : offrir des présentations pré-ventes convaincantes et fournir un soutien technique à la solution MagnumXP aux publics techniques, aidant les clients potentiels à comprendre tout son potentiel

• Collaborer entre les parties prenantes : Assurer la liaison avec le personnel informatique interne des clients, les intégrateurs de systèmes et les partenaires commerciaux pour planifier et identifier des options d'intégration optimales

• Définir et documenter les exigences : Élaborer des exigences opérationnelles et non fonctionnelles claires et présenter des demandes de changement bien structurées à la gestion des produits

• Soutenir le cycle de vie complet de la mise en œuvre : soutenir les clients tout au long de l'installation, de l'intégration et des essais initiaux et tout au long de la production

• Meilleures pratiques championnes : Consulter les clients sur l'intégration du système testant les meilleures pratiques, assurant des déploiements robustes et fiables

• Coordonner les versions de logiciels mondiales : Collaborer avec les collègues de MagnumXP et les équipes de développement mondial pour aligner les versions de logiciels client , spécifier et revoir les exigences pour les changements de système de base, et valider les nouvelles versions

• Fournir un soutien technique : Servir d'une ressource régionale clé pour traiter les questions de service et de changement avec efficacité et soin

• Permettre la réussite du client grâce à la formation : Offrir aux clients la formation requise en API sur l'utilisation efficace du logiciel MagnumXP

• Voyage au besoin : Effectuer des travaux périodiques sur place dans les bureaux clients de toute l'Amérique du Nord, avec des voyages internationaux occasionnels pour collaborer avec des collègues mondiaux de MagnumXP
À propos de l'équipe
Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de MagnumXP Americas, qui siège au sein de l'unité Life and Health Solutions de Swiss Re. Notre équipe est dédiée à la mise en œuvre et à la livraison de MagnumXP — la suite d'outils de souscription de Swiss Re — à des entreprises clientes aux États-Unis, au Canada et en Amérique latine. MagnumXP joue un rôle central dans les stratégies de gestion des risques de nos clients, permettant d'optimiser les processus opérationnels et de jeter les bases d'une croissance future. Sous l'autorité du responsable de L&H UW Solutions, en Amérique, vous rejoindrez une équipe collaborative, connectée à l'échelle mondiale, qui connaît une période de croissance passionnante, avec une nouvelle activité client importante.
À propos de toi
Vous êtes un consultant curieux, orienté vers les solutions qui apporte à la fois profondeur et ampleur à chaque défi. Vous communiquez des idées complexes avec clarté et confiance, créez des relations de confiance entre les disciplines commerciales et techniques, et abordez les problèmes avec un état d'esprit logique et axé sur les détails. Vous êtes sous-alimenté en travaillant dans un environnement dynamique et orienté vers le client et êtes motivé à développer votre connaissance du secteur de l'assurance et de la réassurance. Un joueur d'équipe collaborative à cœur, vous apportez une solide planification et la prestation esprit d'esprit et la capacité d'influencer et d'aligner divers intervenants vers un objectif commun.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Expérience ou connaissance des moteurs de traitement des règles

• Capacité démontrée de présenter des concepts techniques aux publics non techniques de manière claire et convaincante

• Compétences solides en matière d'établissement de relations entre les entreprises et les disciplines techniques

• Une expérience de gestion réussie de multiples priorités dans un environnement accéléré et axé sur le client

• Minimum 3 ans d'expérience pratique avec les services web RESTful, Java, JavaScript, HTML5 et CSS

• Connaissance approfondie des normes de service Web, y compris XML et JSON, ainsi que des normes de sécurité de l'industrie couvrant l'authentification et l'autorisation

• Compétence de la base de données , y compris le développement des requêtes et l'expérience des outils de rapport, combinée avec la connaissance des processus de gestion du changement et du logiciel de contrôle de version

• Architecte, analyste de systèmes ou développeur ayant une vaste expérience dans une gamme de technologies, de préférence dans un environnement d'assurance-vie

• Un diplôme en informatique ou une discipline technique équivalente
Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Connaissance du secteur de l'assurance-vie ou de la réassurance

• Expérience ou confort au sein d'équipes mondiales et interfonctionnelles
L'échelle salariale de base estimative pour ce poste pour Armonk, NY est comprise entre 161 000 $ et 269 000 $ et pour Fort Wayne, IN et Kansas City, MO, l'échelle est comprise entre 150 000 $ et 250 000 $. Le salaire spécifique offert pour ce poste, ou tout autre rôle donné, tiendra compte d'un certain nombre de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le lieu d'affectation, l'étendue du rôle, les qualifications, la complexité, la spécialisation ou la pénurie de talents, l'expérience, les études et le budget de l'employeur. Chez Swiss Re, nous adoptons une «approche de la rémunération totale» pour prendre des décisions en matière de rémunération. Cela signifie que nous considérons toutes les composantes de la rémunération dans leur ensemble (comme la rémunération de base, les incitatifs à court et à long terme et les avantages offerts) dans l'établissement de la rémunération individuelle.
Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine; cependant, pour un candidat exceptionnel, le rôle peut être joué à distance aux États-Unis.
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Nous couvrons à la fois Propriété & Casualty et Vie & Santé. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

jobs.description:
In this role, you will become the strategic architecture authority for Digital & Tech Asset Management (D&T AM), ensuring alignment with Swiss Re’s enterprise-wide architecture vision and business priorities. You will act as a senior architectural leader, driving measurable improvements in platform resilience, engineering productivity and data-centric transformation while maintaining enterprise-grade security and cost discipline.
 Working closely with the EA leadership team, Design Authority, domain architects, and senior business and IT stakeholders, you will ensure our platforms, data ecosystems, and integration capabilities evolve in a secure, scalable, and future-ready manner.
 Key Responsibilities
 Enterprise & Solution Architecture Leadership

• Own the AM Landscape design. Define and maintain the target architecture vision, principles, standards, and technology roadmap for D&T Asset Management aligned with enterprise strategy and business outcomes.

• Serve as the senior architecture authority for the division, define architectural guardrails and govern alignment of solution designs with target-state architecture, technology selection, and major transformation initiatives.

• Translate complex technical and architectural topics into clear business decisions and executive-level recommendations.

• Ensure alignment with Business Architecture & Capability Management.
 Data Architecture & Information Strategy

• Define and evolve the division’s data architecture strategy, including data flows, integration patterns, data models, lineage, governance, and platform interoperability.

• Guide architecture decisions related to data platforms, APIs, event-driven integration, master/reference data, and AI-enabled data capabilities.
 Technology Strategy & Innovation

• Drive technology modernization and evaluate emerging capabilities through PoCs and assessments, ensuring scalable adoption of enterprise-aligned platforms.

• Champion Generative AI capabilities, AI-augmented engineering practices, and intelligent automation - evaluating enterprise AI platforms for productivity and operational impact.

• Drive remediation of tech debt.
 Enterprise Representation

• Represent D&T Asset Management in Swiss Re enterprise architecture forums, governance bodies, and strategic technology discussions.

• Influence enterprise-wide technology direction through active contribution to architecture standards, reference architectures, patterns, and governance processes.
 Governance & Operational Resilience

• Lead architecture reviews and enforce architecture standards, security requirements, resilience objectives, and operational excellence goals.

• Ensure consistent documentation and application of architecture principles and standards across the division.
 About the Team
 The D&T Asset Management (D&T AM) team sits within Swiss Re's Group Digital & Technology Office (GDTO) — a global function at the heart of Swiss Re's technology transformation. Our team is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the technology and data architecture that underpins Swiss Re's Asset Management capabilities.
 We work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and complex financial ecosystems, partnering closely with business and IT stakeholders across the globe to deliver scalable, resilient, and innovative solutions. We value pragmatic thinking, bold ideas, and a shared commitment to making Swiss Re's platforms future-ready.
 About You
 You can envision the future state architecture while understanding the practical steps to get there. You thrive in collaborative environments where you can translate complex technical concepts into business value.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise or domain architecture and technology strategy within complex IT environments

• Proven expertise in data architecture concepts including data modeling, integration architecture, governance, data lineage, and distributed data ecosystems

• Experience driving large-scale modernization and transformation initiatives in complex, regulated environments

• Demonstrated understanding of AI and intelligent automation in enterprise IT contexts — including Generative AI adoption, LLM-based tooling, AI governance frameworks, and their practical applications such as developer copilots, AIOps, automated testing, and documentation generation — combined with strong awareness of responsible AI principles, data privacy, and compliance

• Proven ability to collaborate across leadership levels and influence effectively in complex, matrixed organizational structures
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with asset management technology and the specific platforms, data, and regulatory landscape of the financial services industry

• Experience in vendor management and technology partnerships , with a track record of successful collaboration with external technology providers

• Hands-on experience with Enterprise Architecture tools

• Experience defining or contributing to an enterprise AI strategy or AI governance framework, including responsible AI principles, model risk management, and AI ethics considerations

• TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification

• Experience contributing to or leading architecture governance bodies and design authority forums
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 3,200] and [EUR 5,300] per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In questo ruolo, diventerai l’autorità strategica di architettura per Digital & Tech Asset Management (D&T AM), garantendo l’allineamento con la visione aziendale e le priorità aziendali di Swiss Re. Potrai agire come leader architettonico senior, guidando miglioramenti misurabili nella resilienza della piattaforma, produttività ingegneristica e trasformazione data-centric, mantenendo la sicurezza e la disciplina dei costi di livello aziendale.
Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team di leadership EA, l'Autorità di progettazione, gli architetti di dominio, e gli stakeholder di business senior e IT, vi assicurerete che le nostre piattaforme, gli ecosistemi di dati e le capacità di integrazione si evolvono in modo sicuro, scalabile e pronto per il futuro.
Principali responsabilità
Enterprise & Solution Architettura Leadership

• Disegno Paesaggio AM. Definire e mantenere la visione di architettura target, principi, standard e roadmap tecnologica per D&T Asset Management allineati con strategia aziendale e risultati aziendali.

• Servire come autorità di architettura senior per la divisione, definire i guardrails architettonici e governare l'allineamento dei progetti di soluzioni con architettura target-state, selezione della tecnologia e importanti iniziative di trasformazione.

• Traduci argomenti tecnici e architettonici complessi in chiare decisioni aziendali e raccomandazioni a livello esecutivo.

• Assicurare l'allineamento con Business Architecture & Capability Management.
Architettura e strategia dell'informazione

• Definire ed evolvere la strategia di architettura dei dati della divisione, compresi i flussi di dati, modelli di integrazione, modelli di dati, lineage, governance e interoperabilità della piattaforma.

• Decisioni di architettura di guida relative a piattaforme di dati, API, integrazione basata su eventi, dati master/reference e funzionalità di dati abilitate AI.
Strategia tecnologica e innovazione

• Ammodernamento della tecnologia di azionamento e valutazione delle capacità emergenti attraverso PoC e valutazioni, garantendo l'adozione scalabile delle piattaforme allineate alle imprese.

• Campione Capacità AI Generative, pratiche ingegneristiche potenziate dall'IA e automazione intelligente - valutazione delle piattaforme AI enterprise per la produttività e l'impatto operativo.

• Rimediazione del debito tecnico.
Rappresentanza delle imprese

• Rappresentare D&T Asset Management in Swiss Re enterprise forum di architettura, enti di governance e discussioni tecnologiche strategiche.

• Influenza la direzione tecnologica aziendale attraverso il contributo attivo a standard di architettura, architetture di riferimento, modelli e processi di governance.
Governance & Resilienza Operativa

• Guidare le recensioni di architettura e rispettare gli standard di architettura, requisiti di sicurezza, obiettivi di resilienza e obiettivi di eccellenza operativa.

• Assicurare la documentazione coerente e l'applicazione dei principi e degli standard di architettura in tutta la divisione.
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team D&T Asset Management (D&T AM) si trova all'interno dello Swiss Re's Group Digital & Technology Office (GDTO) – una funzione globale al centro della trasformazione tecnologica di Swiss Re. Il nostro team è responsabile per la definizione, il governo e l'evoluzione della tecnologia e dell'architettura dei dati che supporta le capacità di gestione patrimoniale di Swiss Re.
Lavoriamo all'incrocio tra tecnologie all'avanguardia e ecosistemi finanziari complessi, collaborando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali e IT di tutto il mondo per fornire soluzioni scalabili, resilienti e innovative. Apprezziamo il pensiero pragmatico, le idee audaci e un impegno condiviso per rendere le piattaforme di Swiss Re pronte al futuro.
A proposito di te
È possibile immaginare la futura architettura di stato, mentre la comprensione dei passaggi pratici per arrivare lì. Si prospera in ambienti collaborativi dove è possibile tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in valore aziendale.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• 10+ anni di esperienza nell'architettura aziendale o di dominio e nella strategia tecnologica all'interno di ambienti IT complessi

• Prove competenze nei concetti di architettura dei dati tra cui la modellazione dei dati, l'architettura di integrazione, la governance, la linea di dati e gli ecosistemi di dati distribuiti

• Esperienza che guida iniziative di modernizzazione e trasformazione su larga scala in ambienti complessi e regolamentati

• La comprensione dimostrata dell'intelligenza artificiale e dell'automazione intelligente nei contesti IT aziendali — tra cui l'adozione Generativa dell'IA, l'attrezzo basato su LLM, i quadri di governance dell'AI e le loro applicazioni pratiche come copiloti dello sviluppatore, AIOps, test automatizzati e generazione di documentazione — combinati con la consapevolezza forte dei principi di AI responsabili, la privacy dei dati e la conformità

• Prova capacità di collaborare a livello di leadership e di influenzare efficacemente in strutture organizzative complesse e matrici
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Familiarità con la tecnologia di gestione degli asset e le piattaforme specifiche, i dati e il paesaggio normativo del settore dei servizi finanziari

• Esperienza nella gestione dei fornitori e partnership tecnologiche , con un track record di collaborazione di successo con i fornitori di tecnologie esterne

• Esperienza pratica con strumenti Enterprise Architecture

• Esperienza nella definizione o nel contributo di una strategia AI aziendale o di un framework di governance AI, compresi i principi AI responsabili, la gestione del rischio di modello e le considerazioni di etica AI

• TOGAF o certificazione di architettura aziendale equivalente

• Esperienza contribuendo a o principali enti di governance dell'architettura e forum autorità di progettazione
Per la Slovacchia la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra [EUR 3.200] e [EUR 5.300] al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione.
L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

In dieser Funktion werden Sie die strategische Architekturbehörde für Digital & Tech Asset Management (D&T AM) und gewährleisten die Ausrichtung auf die unternehmensweite Architekturvision und Geschäftsprioritäten von Swiss Re. Sie werden als leitender Architekturleiter auftreten und messbare Verbesserungen in Bezug auf die Widerstandsfähigkeit der Plattform, die technische Produktivität und die datenzentrierte Transformation vorantreiben, während Sie gleichzeitig die Sicherheit und Kostendisziplin auf Unternehmensebene beibehalten.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem EA-Führungsteam, der Design Authority, Domänenarchitekten sowie leitenden Geschäfts- und IT-Stakeholdern stellen Sie sicher, dass sich unsere Plattformen, Datenökosysteme und Integrationsfähigkeiten sicher, skalierbar und zukunftsfähig entwickeln.
Hauptzuständigkeiten
Enterprise & Solution Architektur Führung

• Besitzen Sie das AM Landscape Design. Definieren und pflegen Sie die Zielarchitektur Vision, Prinzipien, Standards und Technologie-Roadmap für D & T Asset Management ausgerichtet auf Unternehmensstrategie und Geschäftsergebnisse.

• Dienen Sie als leitende Architekturbehörde für die Division, definieren Sie architektonische Leitplanken und regeln Sie die Ausrichtung von Lösungsdesigns auf die Zielstaatarchitektur, die Technologieauswahl und wichtige Transformationsinitiativen.

• Übersetzen Sie komplexe technische und architektonische Themen in klare Geschäftsentscheidungen und Empfehlungen auf Führungsebene.

• Stellen Sie eine Abstimmung mit Business Architecture & Capability Management sicher.
Datenarchitektur und Informationsstrategie

• Definieren und entwickeln Sie die Datenarchitekturstrategie der Division, einschließlich Datenflüssen, Integrationsmustern, Datenmodellen, Abstammung, Governance und Interoperabilität der Plattform.

• Leiten Sie Architekturentscheidungen in Bezug auf Datenplattformen, APIs, ereignisgesteuerte Integration, Master-/Referenzdaten und KI-fähige Datenfunktionen.
Technologiestrategie und Innovation

• Antriebstechnologiemodernisierung und Bewertung neuer Fähigkeiten durch PoCs und Bewertungen, um eine skalierbare Einführung unternehmensorientierter Plattformen zu gewährleisten.

• Champion Generative AI-Fähigkeiten, KI-erweiterte Engineering-Praktiken und intelligente Automatisierung - Bewertung von KI-Plattformen für Unternehmen auf Produktivität und betriebliche Auswirkungen.

• Förderung der Sanierung von Tech-Schulden.
Unternehmensvertretung

• Vertretung von D&T Asset Management in Swiss Re Enterprise Architecture Foren, Governance Gremien und strategischen Technologiediskussionen.

• Beeinflussen Sie die unternehmensweite Technologierichtung durch aktiven Beitrag zu Architekturstandards, Referenzarchitekturen, Mustern und Governance-Prozessen.
Governance und operative Resilienz

• Leiten Sie Architekturüberprüfungen und erzwingen Sie Architekturstandards, Sicherheitsanforderungen, Resilienzziele und operative Exzellenzziele.

• Gewährleistung einer einheitlichen Dokumentation und Anwendung der Architekturprinzipien und -standards in der gesamten Abteilung.
Über das Team
Das Team von D&T Asset Management (D&T AM) ist Teil des Group Digital & Technology Office (GDTO) von Swiss Re – einer globalen Funktion im Zentrum der Technologietransformation von Swiss Re. Unser Team ist verantwortlich für die Definition, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung der Technologie und Datenarchitektur, die die Asset Management-Fähigkeiten von Swiss Re untermauern.
Wir arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und komplexen Finanzökosystemen und arbeiten eng mit Geschäfts- und IT-Stakeholdern auf der ganzen Welt zusammen, um skalierbare, belastbare und innovative Lösungen zu liefern. Wir schätzen pragmatisches Denken, mutige Ideen und das gemeinsame Engagement, die Plattformen von Swiss Re zukunftsfähig zu machen.
Über dich
Sie können sich die zukünftige staatliche Architektur vorstellen und gleichzeitig die praktischen Schritte verstehen, um dorthin zu gelangen. Sie gedeihen in kollaborativen Umgebungen, in denen Sie komplexe technische Konzepte in Geschäftswert umsetzen können.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Unternehmens- oder Domänenarchitektur und Technologiestrategie in komplexen IT-Umgebungen

• Nachgewiesene Expertise in Datenarchitekturkonzepten einschließlich Datenmodellierung, Integrationsarchitektur, Governance, Datenlinie und verteilten Datenökosystemen

• Erfahren Sie, wie Sie große Modernisierungs- und Transformationsinitiativen in komplexen, regulierten Umgebungen vorantreiben

• Demonstriertes Verständnis von KI und intelligenter Automatisierung in Unternehmens-IT-Kontexten - einschließlich Generativer KI-Akzeptanz, LLM-basierter Tools, KI-Governance-Frameworks und ihrer praktischen Anwendungen wie Entwickler-Copiloten, AIOps, automatisiertem Testen und Erstellung von Dokumentation - kombiniert mit einem starken Bewusstsein für verantwortungsvolle KI-Prinzipien, Datenschutz und Compliance

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, über Führungsebenen hinweg zusammenzuarbeiten und effektiv in komplexen, matrixförmigen Organisationsstrukturen zu beeinflussen
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Vertrautheit mit der Asset Management Technologie und den spezifischen Plattformen, Daten und der regulatorischen Landschaft der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche

• Erfahrung in Vendor Management und Technologiepartnerschaften, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Technologieanbietern

• Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise Architecture Tools

• Erfahrung in der Definition oder dem Beitrag zu einer KI-Strategie oder einem KI-Governance-Framework für Unternehmen, einschließlich verantwortungsvoller KI-Prinzipien, Modellrisikomanagement und KI-Ethiküberlegungen

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Dans ce rôle, vous deviendrez l'autorité d'architecture stratégique pour Digital & Tech Asset Management (D&T AM), assurant l'alignement avec la vision d'architecture d'entreprise et les priorités d'affaires de Swiss Re. Vous jouerez le rôle de chef de file en matière d'architecture, favorisant des améliorations mesurables de la résilience de la plate-forme, de la productivité d'ingénierie et de la transformation axée sur les données, tout en maintenant la sécurité et la discipline des coûts.
En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de direction de l'EE, l'autorité de conception, les architectes de domaine et les principaux intervenants en affaires et en TI, vous veillerez à ce que nos plateformes, nos écosystèmes de données et nos capacités d'intégration évoluent de façon sûre, évolutive et prête à l'avenir.
Principales responsabilités
Leadership en architecture d'entreprise et de solutions

• Posséder la conception AM Landscape. Définir et maintenir la vision, les principes, les normes et la feuille de route technologique de l'architecture cible pour la D&T Asset Management en harmonie avec la stratégie d'entreprise et les résultats opérationnels.

• Servir d'autorité principale en matière d'architecture pour la division, définir les garde-corps architecturaux et régir l'alignement des conceptions de solutions avec l'architecture de l'État cible, le choix de la technologie et les grandes initiatives de transformation.

• Traduire des sujets techniques et architecturaux complexes en décisions d'affaires claires et en recommandations de niveau exécutif.

• Assurer l'alignement avec l'architecture opérationnelle et la gestion des capacités.
Architecture des données et stratégie d'information

• Définir et développer la stratégie d'architecture des données de la division, y compris les flux de données, les modèles d'intégration, les modèles de données, la lignage, la gouvernance et l'interopérabilité des plates-formes.

• Guider les décisions d'architecture relatives aux plates-formes de données, aux API, à l'intégration axée sur les événements, aux données de référence et aux capacités de données compatibles avec l'IA.
Stratégie technologique et innovation

• Favoriser la modernisation de la technologie et évaluer les capacités émergentes au moyen de programmes et d'évaluations, en assurant l'adoption évolutive de plates-formes alignées sur l'entreprise.

• Champion Capacités d'IA génériques, pratiques d'ingénierie augmentées par l'IA et automatisation intelligente - évaluation des plateformes d'IA d'entreprise pour la productivité et l'impact opérationnel.

• Encourager l'assainissement de la dette technologique.
Représentation des entreprises

• Représenter D&T Asset Management dans les forums d'architecture d'entreprise, les organes de gouvernance et les discussions stratégiques sur les technologies.

• Influencer l'orientation technologique à l'échelle de l'entreprise en contribuant activement aux normes d'architecture, aux architectures de référence, aux modèles et aux processus de gouvernance.
Gouvernance et résilience opérationnelle

• L'architecture chef de file examine et applique les normes d'architecture, les exigences de sécurité, les objectifs de résilience et les objectifs d'excellence opérationnelle.

• Assurer l'uniformité de la documentation et de l'application des principes et des normes d'architecture dans l'ensemble de la division.
À propos de l'équipe
L'équipe D&T Asset Management (D&T AM) siège au sein du Swiss Re's Group Digital & Technology Office (GDTO), une fonction mondiale au cœur de la transformation technologique de Swiss Re. Notre équipe est responsable de la définition, de la gouvernance et de l'évolution de l'architecture technologique et de données qui sous-tendent les capacités de Swiss Re Asset Management.
Nous travaillons à l'intersection de technologies de pointe et d'écosystèmes financiers complexes, en partenariat étroit avec les entreprises et les intervenants en TI partout dans le monde pour offrir des solutions évolutives, résistantes et innovantes. Nous apprécions la pensée pragmatique, les idées audacieuses et l'engagement commun à rendre les plateformes Swiss Re prêtes à l'avenir.
À propos de toi
Vous pouvez imaginer la future architecture d'état tout en comprenant les étapes pratiques pour y arriver. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements collaboratifs où vous pouvez traduire des concepts techniques complexes en valeur commerciale.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• 10+ ans d'expérience en architecture d'entreprise ou de domaine et stratégie technologique dans des environnements informatiques complexes

• Expertise éprouvée dans les concepts d'architecture de données, y compris la modélisation de données, l'architecture d'intégration, la gouvernance, la lignée de données et les écosystèmes de données distribués

• Expérience des initiatives de modernisation et de transformation à grande échelle dans des environnements complexes et réglementés

• Compréhension démontrée de l'IA et de l'automatisation intelligente dans les contextes informatiques d'entreprise — y compris adoption de l'IA Generative, outillage basé sur LLM, cadres de gouvernance de l'IA, et leurs applications pratiques telles que copilotes développeurs, AIOps, tests automatisés et production de documentation — associée à une forte sensibilisation aux principes responsables de l'IA, à la confidentialité des données et à la conformité

• Capacité éprouvée de collaborer à tous les niveaux de leadership et d'influencer efficacement les structures organisationnelles complexes et matricielles
Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Connaissance de la technologie de gestion d'actifs et des plateformes, données et contexte réglementaire spécifiques du secteur des services financiers

• Expérience dans la gestion des fournisseurs et les partenariats technologiques, avec une collaboration réussie avec des fournisseurs de technologie externes

• Expérience pratique avec les outils d'architecture d'entreprise

• Expérience de la définition ou de la contribution d'une stratégie d'entreprise en matière d'IA ou d'un cadre de gouvernance de l'IA, y compris les principes responsables en matière d'IA, la gestion modèle des risques et les considérations éthiques en matière d'IA

• TOGAF ou certification d'architecture d'entreprise équivalente

• Expérience de la contribution ou de la direction d'organismes de gouvernance de l'architecture et de forums d'autorités de conception
Pour la Slovaquie, l'échelle de salaire de base pour ce poste se situe entre [3200 EUR] et [5300 EUR] par mois (pour un rôle à temps plein). Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle,

• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience.
En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété d'avantages globaux et spécifiques à l'emplacement.
L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,
il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al vostro stipendio base, si può essere idonei per ulteriori ricompense e benefici, tra cui un attraente bonus basato sulle prestazioni.

Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Are you a motivated finance professional looking to grow your accounting expertise in a dynamic, international environment?
 Join our Intra-Group Retrocession (IGR) team and develop your skills while supporting key internal reinsurance processes and collaborating with teams across Swiss Re. In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with financial processes, systems, and accounting topics, working closely with experienced colleagues in a supportive environment.
 About the Role
 You will support the execution of core financial processes that connect different parts of Swiss Re’s business. Working in a structured and supportive environment, you will contribute to the lifecycle of Intra-Group Reinsurance (IGR) transactions and help ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
 Key Responsibilities:
 • Support quarterly financial production for Intra-Group Reinsurance transactions, following defined timelines and guidelines
 • Assist with the set up and maintenance of IGR contracts in finance systems, ensuring data accuracy and completeness
 • Prepare financial results and perform reconciliations and basic validations to support reporting processes
 • Execute standard accounting and reporting activities in line with established processes and internal controls
 • Contribute to system enhancements and testing activities, including User Acceptance Testing, under guidance
 • Collaborate with Finance teams and cross-functional functions (e.g. Risk Management, Treasury, and Audit), to support operational processes
 About the Team
 The Intra Group Reinsurance team, established in 2018, is part of Global Finance Operations & Transformation team (GFO&T). The team manages global internal reinsurance financial processes across Swiss Re entities, including contract setup, calculation, reporting, and settlement of transactions.
 We are an international and collaborative team that values open communication, reliability, and continuous learning. We support knowledge sharing and provide a positive environment for developing new skills and gaining professional and personal development.
 About You
 You are a detail oriented finance professional who enjoys working with numbers and structured processes. You are eager to learn, comfortable working in an international environment, and able to manage multiple tasks with guidance and support.
 We are looking for candidates with:
 • Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting
 • 1–3 years of experience in a finance or accounting role
 • Basic experience with accounting or reporting systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle)
 • Good knowledge of MS Excel
 • Fluent English (written and spoken)
 • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn
 • Ability to work collaboratively and follow established processes
 Nice to have:
 • Exposure to US GAAP and/or IFRS
 • Experience working in an international or cross functional environment
 • Interest in developing deeper expertise in accounting or reinsurance topics

For Slovakia, the base salary range for this position is between 1,300 EUR and 2,200 EUR for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
 We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. Our aim is to live visible and invisible diversity – diversity of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, physical abilities, personalities and experiences – at all levels and in all functions and regions. We also collaborate in a flexible working environment, providing you with a compelling degree of autonomy to decide how, when and where to carry out your tasks.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
