descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous passionné de naviguer dans le monde complexe du respect des sanctions internationales? Rejoignez notre équipe dynamique chez Swiss Re où vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de stratégies qui contrôlent notre exposition au risque de sanctions tout en permettant des opérations conformes dans le monde entier.
Nous sommes ouverts à l'examen de candidats basés à d'autres endroits.
À propos du rôle
En tant que cadre pour les risques liés aux sanctions Propriétaire, vous serez le moteur de la stratégie de Swiss Re en matière de respect des sanctions. Vous concevrez, superviserez et développerez en permanence notre cadre mondial de gestion des risques en matière de sanctions, rassemblant votre expertise en matière de régimes de sanctions, d'interprétation de l'évolution des sanctions et de leur application au secteur de l'assurance avec un esprit stratégique.
Principales responsabilités

• Posséder et améliorer le cadre mondial de gestion des risques liés aux sanctions, y compris les politiques, les normes et les processus qui constituent le fondement de notre approche de gestion des risques liés aux sanctions.

• Surveiller et interpréter l'évolution des sanctions de la part des autorités compétentes, en les traduisant en effets sur nos activités.

• Élaborer et coordonner les réponses, y compris les approbations, la communication et la mise en oeuvre dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

• Assurer une surveillance continue de la conception et de l'efficacité du cadre de contrôle des sanctions.

• Fournir un appui consultatif d'experts aux principaux intervenants sur les questions liées aux sanctions et élaborer des exposés de position afin de permettre une orientation cohérente entre les unités opérationnelles.

• Posséder et diriger la mise en oeuvre et l'efficacité continue des contrôles des sanctions dans le dépistage et les outils connexes.

• Diriger la formation et la sensibilisation en élaborant du matériel de formation complet à l'intention des employés, en menant des formations et en appuyant le développement des compétences en matière de sanctions au sein des équipes de conformité.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue de nos processus et contrôles de conformité, contribuant ainsi à la stratégie plus générale de gestion du risque de criminalité financière.
Veuillez noter que ce rôle n'implique pas de contrôle pratique, de traitement d'alerte ou de traitement de cas KYC.
À propos de l'équipe
L'équipe des Cadres de lutte contre la criminalité financière (CRF) est responsable des Cadres de lutte contre la criminalité financière (CRF) qui couvrent quatre principaux risques de criminalité financière : la fraude, la corruption et la corruption, le blanchiment d'argent et le financement du terrorisme et les sanctions économiques. Nous développons, maintenons et mettons en oeuvre des politiques, des normes, des processus et des technologies d'appui mondiaux pour gérer efficacement ces risques. Notre équipe diversifiée couvre New York, Bratislava et Londres, travaillant en collaboration pour surveiller les risques émergents et les développements réglementaires dans toutes les juridictions où Swiss Re opère.
À propos de toi
Vous êtes un professionnel de la conformité axé sur les détails avec une expertise en matière de sanctions profonde à travers les régimes de sanctions et d'excellentes compétences en communication. Vous prospèrez dans un environnement de collaboration tout en étant capable de travailler de façon indépendante sur des questions de sanctions complexes. Votre état d'esprit analytique vous permet de traduire les exigences réglementaires en cadres et solutions pratiques.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

•
• Forte expérience de conformité , y compris au moins 5 ans axés sur les sujets des sanctions , idéalement dans le secteur de l'assurance .

• Une expertise approfondie en matière de sanctions financières, économiques et commerciales.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la traduction de l'évolution des sanctions entre les régimes, les règlements et les programmes en effets commerciaux et en mesures de gestion des risques.

• Une bonne expérience dans les cadres de risque, particulièrement dans l'élaboration des politiques, des normes et des processus, et le maintien d'un cadre de risque de conformité.

• Université ou diplôme équivalent avec compétence en anglais (écrit et parlé); la formation juridique serait bénéfique.

• Forte capacité de communication et de gestion des intervenants avec la capacité de dialoguer efficacement avec les collègues de tous les niveaux d'ancienneté.

Ce serait un plus:

• Spécialiste certifié des sanctions mondiales (CGSS) ou autre certification de sanctions professionnelles

• Connaissance des autres risques de criminalité financière (fraude, blanchiment d'argent et financement du terrorisme, corruption et corruption)

• Langues supplémentaires, en particulier l'allemand

• Expérience de l'élaboration et de la prestation de programmes de formation sur la conformité

• Compétences solides en gestion de projet et de changement
Modèle de rémunération et de travail
Pour le Royaume-Uni, l'échelle salariale de base pour ce poste se situe entre 76 000 GBP et 114 000 GBP pour un poste à temps plein.
Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:
• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle
• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience
Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
#LI-Hybrid
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 14 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

jobs.title: Catering & Events Associate
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating exceptional food experiences and unforgettable events? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, people-centric environment where no two days are the same? If you have a flair for hospitality, a sharp eye for detail, and a love for bringing people together — we want to hear from you!

About the Role

As a Catering & Events Associate at Swiss Re, you will be at the heart of our workplace experience, delivering world-class food & beverage services and orchestrating seamless corporate events. From strategic planning to hands-on execution, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the day-to-day hospitality experience for our employees and guests in Hyderabad. This is your opportunity to combine your passion for food, events, and people into a role that truly makes an impact.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and execute food & beverage strategies that align with organizational standards and cater to the diverse needs of our internal customers

• Champion sustainable gastronomy practices, driving initiatives that align with our environmental and organizational objectives

• Plan and manage end-to-end corporate events, including developing event plans, timelines, and conducting venue inspections and evaluations

• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors — including kitchen staff, caterers, decorators, and audiovisual providers — to ensure timely and flawless service delivery

• Ensure full compliance with ISO 22000 and all applicable food safety, health & safety regulations, licensing, tax obligations, and labour laws

• Organise FOSTAC training for all food handlers and manage Background Verification documentation

• Create and manage budgets, track financial performance, analyse trends, and prepare regular financial and dashboard reports

• Build and nurture strong vendor and partner relationships, negotiating contracts and establishing KPIs to ensure cost-effectiveness and service excellence

• Drive process improvement initiatives, including automation and streamlining operations to enhance efficiency and overall experience

• Gather and act on feedback from employees and guests to continuously elevate the hospitality and events experience

• Lead and develop contract staff, fostering a positive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture

• Stay current with industry trends and best practices in catering, sustainable gastronomy, and event management

About the Team

The Corporate Real Estate and Services (CRES) team is on a mission to create and sustain a world-class office environment that aligns with Swiss Re's strategic vision and goals. Our diverse team of experts spans real estate, security, facilities management, and hospitality operations — working collaboratively to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions that make a real difference.

We believe that a well-maintained, secure, and thoughtfully designed workspace — paired with exceptional service offerings — is a powerful driver of employee well-being and productivity. As trusted advisors and partners, we are committed to consistently exceeding service standards by leveraging our collective expertise, fostering open communication, and embracing continuous learning and improvement.

About You

You are a hospitality professional who leads with warmth, precision, and purpose. You bring a solution-focused mindset, a genuine passion for customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with grace. You take full ownership and accountability for your work, demonstrating strong leadership in everything you do — whether managing a high-profile event or resolving a day-to-day operational challenge. You thrive in dynamic environments, build strong relationships effortlessly, and are always looking for smarter, better ways to deliver exceptional experiences.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in catering, food & beverage management, event management, or a related corporate role, with demonstrated experience managing large teams

• Strong knowledge of food safety regulations, including ISO 22000 standards, and experience implementing and enforcing safe food handling procedures

• Proven budget management and financial analysis skills, with the ability to create, oversee, and report on budgets and financial performance

• Experience in vendor and contract management, including negotiating contracts and managing relationships with external partners and suppliers

• Proficiency in event planning and execution, including developing event plans, timelines, and coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders

• Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and leadership skills — the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, lead by example, and drive results even in ambiguous or challenging situations

What Would Make You Stand Out:

• Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Event Planning, Culinary Arts, or a related field

• Certifications such as ServSafe Food Handler or similar food safety credentials

• Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) or equivalent event management certification

• Experience working in diverse, multi-geography environments

• Familiarity with MSME vendor payment regulations and compliance requirements

• Knowledge of local occupational health and safety regulations in India

• Experience with automation and process improvement initiatives in a hospitality or facilities management context

• Proficiency in preparing dashboards and data reports for consumption and budget tracking

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and the local language

• A collaborative, empathetic approach to teamwork across virtual and in-person environments

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di creare esperienze culinarie eccezionali e eventi indimenticabili? Si prospera in un ambiente frenetico e centrato sulle persone dove non ci sono due giorni uguali? Se avete un tocco di ospitalità, un occhio affilato per i dettagli, e un amore per riunire le persone — vogliamo sentire da voi!

Informazioni sul ruolo

In qualità di Catering & Events Associate presso Swiss Re, sarai al centro della nostra esperienza sul posto di lavoro, offrendo servizi di ristorazione e bevande di livello mondiale e organizzando eventi aziendali senza interruzioni. Dalla pianificazione strategica all'esecuzione pratica, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione dell'esperienza di ospitalità quotidiana per i nostri dipendenti e ospiti a Hyderabad. Questa è la vostra opportunità di combinare la vostra passione per il cibo, gli eventi e le persone in un ruolo che realmente fa un impatto.

Principali responsabilità

• Progettare ed eseguire strategie alimentari e bevande che si allineano agli standard organizzativi e rispondono alle diverse esigenze dei nostri clienti interni

• Campione pratiche gastronomiche sostenibili, iniziative di guida che si allineano con i nostri obiettivi ambientali e organizzativi

• Pianificare e gestire eventi aziendali end-to-end, tra cui lo sviluppo di piani di eventi, linee temporali, e condurre ispezioni e valutazioni delle sedi

• Collaborare con team interni e fornitori esterni — tra cui personale di cucina, catering, decoratori e fornitori audiovisivi — per garantire la consegna tempestiva e impeccabile dei servizi

• Assicurare il pieno rispetto della ISO 22000 e di tutte le normative in materia di sicurezza alimentare, salute e sicurezza, licenze, obblighi fiscali e leggi sul lavoro

• Organizzare la formazione FOSTAC per tutti i gestori e gestire la documentazione di verifica dello sfondo

• Creare e gestire budget, monitorare le prestazioni finanziarie, analizzare le tendenze e preparare rapporti finanziari e di dashboard regolari

• Costruire e nutrire forti rapporti tra fornitori e partner, negoziare contratti e stabilire KPI per garantire l'efficienza dei costi e l'eccellenza dei servizi

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento del processo, tra cui operazioni di automazione e razionalizzazione per migliorare l'efficienza e l'esperienza complessiva

• Raccogliere e agire su feedback da dipendenti e ospiti per elevare continuamente l'esperienza di ospitalità e eventi

• Condurre e sviluppare il personale contrattuale, favorendo una cultura positiva, collaborativa e di alto livello

• Rimani attuale con le tendenze del settore e le migliori pratiche nella ristorazione, nella gastronomia sostenibile e nella gestione degli eventi

Informazioni sulla squadra

Il team Corporate Real Estate and Services (CRES) è in missione per creare e sostenere un ambiente di ufficio di livello mondiale che si allinea alla visione strategica e agli obiettivi di Swiss Re. Il nostro team di esperti si occupa di operazioni immobiliari, di sicurezza, di gestione delle strutture e di ospitalità, lavorando in collaborazione per fornire soluzioni innovative e basate sui dati che fanno una vera differenza.

Crediamo che uno spazio di lavoro ben mantenuto, sicuro e premurosamente progettato — abbinato a offerte di servizio eccezionali — sia un potente driver di benessere e produttività dei dipendenti. Come consulenti e partner di fiducia, ci impegniamo a superare costantemente gli standard di servizio sfruttando le nostre competenze collettive, promuovendo la comunicazione aperta e abbracciando l'apprendimento continuo e il miglioramento.

A proposito di te

Sei un professionista dell'ospitalità che conduce con calore, precisione e scopo. Porti una mentalità orientata alla soluzione, una vera passione per il servizio clienti, e la capacità di gestire più priorità con grazia. Si prende la piena proprietà e la responsabilità per il vostro lavoro, dimostrando una forte leadership in tutto ciò che si fa — se gestire un evento di alto profilo o risolvere una sfida operativa quotidiana. Si prospera in ambienti dinamici, costruire relazioni forti senza sforzo, e sono sempre alla ricerca di modi più intelligenti e migliori per offrire esperienze eccezionali.

Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella ristorazione, nella gestione del cibo e delle bevande, nella gestione degli eventi o in un ruolo aziendale correlato, con esperienza dimostrata nella gestione di grandi team

• Forte conoscenza delle normative sulla sicurezza alimentare, compresi gli standard ISO 22000, e l'esperienza di attuazione e di rafforzamento delle procedure di gestione degli alimenti sicuri

• Prove capacità di gestione del bilancio e di analisi finanziaria, con la capacità di creare, supervisionare e segnalare bilanci e performance finanziarie

• Esperienza nella gestione dei fornitori e dei contratti, compresi i contratti di negoziazione e la gestione dei rapporti con partner esterni e fornitori

• Proficienza nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione degli eventi, tra cui lo sviluppo di piani di eventi, tempi e coordinamento con più stakeholder interni ed esterni

• Proprietà dimostrata, responsabilità e capacità di leadership — la capacità di prendere la responsabilità per i risultati, portare per esempio, e guidare i risultati anche in situazioni ambigue o stimolanti

Cosa ti farebbe stare in piedi:

• Laurea in gestione dell'ospitalità, pianificazione degli eventi, arti culinarie, o un campo relativo

• Certificazioni come ServSafe Food Handler o simili credenziali di sicurezza alimentare

• Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) o equivalente certificazione di gestione eventi

• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti diversi e multi-geografia

• Familiarità con le normative di pagamento del fornitore MSME e i requisiti di conformità

• Conoscenza delle normative locali in materia di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro in India

• Esperienza con iniziative di automazione e miglioramento dei processi in un contesto di gestione dell'ospitalità o delle strutture

• Competenza nella preparazione di dashboard e report di dati per il monitoraggio dei consumi e del budget

• Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta sia in inglese che in lingua locale

• Un approccio collaborativo ed empatico al lavoro di squadra in ambienti virtuali e in-persona

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana

Informazioni su Swiss Re
 Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
 Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, außergewöhnliche Essenserlebnisse und unvergessliche Ereignisse zu schaffen? Gedeihen Sie in einer schnelllebigen, menschenzentrierten Umgebung, in der keine zwei Tage gleich sind? Wenn Sie ein Gespür für Gastfreundschaft haben, ein scharfes Auge für Details und die Liebe, Menschen zusammenzubringen - wir möchten von Ihnen hören!

Über die Rolle

Als Catering & Events Associate bei Swiss Re stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt unserer Arbeitsplatzerfahrung, bieten erstklassige Food & Beverage-Services und orchestrieren nahtlose Firmenveranstaltungen. Von der strategischen Planung bis zur praktischen Ausführung spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung des täglichen Gastfreundschaftserlebnisses für unsere Mitarbeiter und Gäste in Hyderabad. Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, Ihre Leidenschaft für Essen, Veranstaltungen und Menschen in einer Rolle zu kombinieren, die wirklich einen Einfluss hat.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Design und Umsetzung von Lebensmittel- und Getränkestrategien, die sich an den organisatorischen Standards orientieren und den unterschiedlichen Bedürfnissen unserer internen Kunden gerecht werden

• Verfechten Sie nachhaltige Gastronomiepraktiken und fördern Sie Initiativen, die sich an unseren ökologischen und organisatorischen Zielen orientieren

• Planen und verwalten Sie durchgängige Unternehmensveranstaltungen, einschließlich der Entwicklung von Veranstaltungsplänen, Zeitplänen und der Durchführung von Inspektionen und Bewertungen am Veranstaltungsort.

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und externen Anbietern - einschließlich Küchenpersonal, Caterern, Dekorateuren und audiovisuellen Anbietern -, um eine zeitnahe und fehlerfreie Servicebereitstellung zu gewährleisten

• Gewährleistung der vollständigen Einhaltung der ISO 22000 und aller geltenden Lebensmittelsicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsvorschriften, Lizenz-, Steuer- und Arbeitsgesetze

• Organisation von FOSTAC-Schulungen für alle Lebensmittelhändler und Verwaltung der Dokumentation zur Überprüfung des Hintergrunds

• Erstellen und Verwalten von Budgets, verfolgen Sie die finanzielle Performance, analysieren Sie Trends und erstellen Sie regelmäßige Finanz- und Dashboardberichte

• Aufbau und Pflege starker Lieferanten- und Partnerbeziehungen, Vertragsverhandlungen und Festlegung von KPIs, um Kosteneffizienz und Service-Exzellenz zu gewährleisten

• Initiativen zur Prozessverbesserung, einschließlich Automatisierung und Optimierung von Abläufen, um die Effizienz und die Gesamterfahrung zu verbessern

• Sammeln und handeln Sie auf Feedback von Mitarbeitern und Gästen, um die Gastfreundschaft und das Erlebnis der Veranstaltungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern

• Leitung und Entwicklung von Vertragsmitarbeitern, Förderung einer positiven, kooperativen und leistungsstarken Teamkultur

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit Branchentrends und Best Practices in den Bereichen Catering, nachhaltige Gastronomie und Eventmanagement

Über das Team

Das CRES-Team (Corporate Real Estate and Services) hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, eine erstklassige Büroumgebung zu schaffen und zu erhalten, die mit der strategischen Vision und den Zielen von Swiss Re übereinstimmt. Unser vielfältiges Expertenteam umfasst Immobilien-, Sicherheits-, Facility Management- und Hospitality-Betriebe und arbeitet gemeinsam an innovativen, datengesteuerten Lösungen, die einen echten Unterschied machen.

Wir glauben, dass ein gepflegter, sicherer und durchdachter Arbeitsplatz – gepaart mit außergewöhnlichen Serviceangeboten – ein starker Treiber für das Wohlbefinden und die Produktivität der Mitarbeiter ist. Als vertrauenswürdige Berater und Partner sind wir bestrebt, die Servicestandards konsequent zu übertreffen, indem wir unser gemeinsames Fachwissen nutzen, eine offene Kommunikation fördern und kontinuierliches Lernen und Verbessern fördern.

Über dich

Sie sind ein Gastfreundschaftsprofi, der mit Wärme, Präzision und Zweck führt. Sie bringen eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise, eine echte Leidenschaft für den Kundenservice und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten mit Anmut zu verwalten. Sie übernehmen die volle Verantwortung und Verantwortlichkeit für Ihre Arbeit und zeigen eine starke Führungsrolle bei allem, was Sie tun - ob Sie eine hochkarätige Veranstaltung leiten oder eine tägliche operative Herausforderung lösen. Sie gedeihen in dynamischen Umgebungen, bauen mühelos starke Beziehungen auf und sind immer auf der Suche nach intelligenteren, besseren Wegen, um außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu liefern.

Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Catering, Food & Beverage Management, Event Management oder einer damit verbundenen Unternehmensrolle mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung im Management großer Teams

• Kenntnis der Lebensmittelsicherheitsvorschriften, einschließlich der ISO 22000-Normen, und Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung und Durchsetzung sicherer Lebensmittelbehandlungsverfahren

• Bewährte Budgetmanagement- und Finanzanalysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Budgets und finanzielle Leistung zu erstellen, zu überwachen und zu berichten

• Erfahrung im Lieferanten- und Vertragsmanagement, einschließlich Vertragsverhandlungen und Management von Beziehungen mit externen Partnern und Lieferanten

• Kompetenz in der Eventplanung und -durchführung, einschließlich der Entwicklung von Eventplänen, Zeitplänen und der Koordination mit mehreren internen und externen Stakeholdern

• Demonstriertes Eigentum, Rechenschaftspflicht und Führungsqualitäten - die Fähigkeit, Verantwortung für Ergebnisse zu übernehmen, mit gutem Beispiel voranzugehen und Ergebnisse auch in mehrdeutigen oder herausfordernden Situationen zu erzielen

Was würde dich abheben:

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Hospitality Management, Event Planning, Culinary Arts oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Zertifizierungen wie ServSafe Food Handler oder ähnliche Lebensmittelsicherheitsnachweise

• Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) oder gleichwertige Event Management Zertifizierung

• Erfahrung in vielfältigen, multi-geographischen Umgebungen

• Vertrautheit mit den Zahlungsvorschriften und Compliance-Anforderungen von MSME-Anbietern

• Kenntnisse über lokale Arbeitsschutz- und Gesundheitsvorschriften in Indien

• Erfahrung mit Automatisierungs- und Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen im Hospitality- oder Facility-Management-Kontext

• Kenntnisse in der Erstellung von Dashboards und Datenberichten für die Verbrauchs- und Budgetverfolgung

• Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowohl in Englisch als auch in der lokalen Sprache

• Ein kollaborativer, empathischer Ansatz für die Teamarbeit in virtuellen und persönlichen Umgebungen

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind

Über Swiss Re
 Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
 Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

Êtes-vous passionné par des expériences culinaires exceptionnelles et des événements inoubliables? Est-ce que vous prospèrez dans un environnement axé sur les gens où les deux jours ne sont pas les mêmes ? Si vous avez un goût pour l'hospitalité, un œil aigu pour les détails et un amour pour réunir les gens — nous voulons entendre de vous!

À propos du rôle

En tant qu'associé de restauration et d'événements chez Swiss Re, vous serez au cœur de notre expérience sur le lieu de travail, offrant des services de restauration et de boissons de calibre mondial et orchestrant des événements corporatifs sans faille. De la planification stratégique à l'exécution pratique, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'élaboration de l'expérience d'accueil quotidienne pour nos employés et invités à Hyderabad. C'est l'occasion de combiner votre passion pour la nourriture, les événements et les gens en un rôle qui fait vraiment un impact.

Principales responsabilités

• Concevoir et exécuter des stratégies alimentaires et boissons qui s'harmonisent avec les normes organisationnelles et répondent aux divers besoins de nos clients internes

• Championne des pratiques de gastronomie durable, des initiatives qui s'harmonisent avec nos objectifs environnementaux et organisationnels

• Planifier et gérer les activités ministérielles de bout en bout, y compris l'élaboration de plans d'activités, de calendriers et la réalisation d'inspections et d'évaluations sur place

• Collaborer avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs externes, y compris le personnel de cuisine, les traiteurs, les décorateurs et les fournisseurs d'audiovisuel, pour assurer la prestation de services en temps opportun et sans faille

• Assurer le respect intégral de la norme ISO 22000 et de tous les règlements applicables en matière de sécurité alimentaire, de santé et de sécurité, de licences, d'obligations fiscales et de droit du travail

• Organiser une formation FOSTAC pour tous les gestionnaires de produits alimentaires et gérer la documentation de vérification des antécédents

• Créer et gérer des budgets, suivre les résultats financiers, analyser les tendances et établir des rapports financiers et des tableaux de bord réguliers

• Établir et entretenir de solides relations avec les fournisseurs et les partenaires, négocier des contrats et établir des ICR pour assurer la rentabilité et l'excellence des services

• Diriger les initiatives d'amélioration des processus, y compris l'automatisation et la rationalisation des opérations pour améliorer l'efficacité et l'expérience globale

• Rassembler et agir sur les commentaires des employés et des invités pour élever continuellement l'expérience de l'hospitalité et des événements

• Diriger et développer le personnel contractuel, favoriser une culture d'équipe positive, collaborative et performante

• Restez au courant des tendances de l'industrie et des meilleures pratiques en restauration, gastronomie durable et gestion des événements

À propos de l'équipe

L'équipe de Corporate Real Estate and Services (CRES) a pour mission de créer et de maintenir un environnement de bureau de classe mondiale qui s'harmonise avec la vision stratégique et les objectifs de Swiss Re. Notre équipe diversifiée d'experts couvre les domaines de l'immobilier, de la sécurité, de la gestion des installations et de l'accueil.

Nous croyons qu'un espace de travail bien entretenu, sécurisé et bien conçu, jumelé à des services exceptionnels, est un puissant moteur du bien-être et de la productivité des employés. En tant que conseillers et partenaires de confiance, nous nous engageons à dépasser constamment les normes de service en tirant parti de notre expertise collective, en favorisant une communication ouverte et en adoptant l'apprentissage et l'amélioration continus.

À propos de toi

Vous êtes un professionnel de l'hospitalité qui mène avec chaleur, précision et objectif. Vous apportez un état d'esprit axé sur la solution, une véritable passion pour le service à la clientèle, et la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités avec grâce. Vous assumez la pleine appropriation et la responsabilité de votre travail, faisant preuve d'un leadership solide dans tout ce que vous faites, qu'il s'agisse de gérer un événement de grande envergure ou de résoudre un défi opérationnel quotidien. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements dynamiques, construisez des relations solides sans effort, et êtes toujours à la recherche de meilleures façons de fournir des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la restauration, la gestion des aliments et des boissons, la gestion d'événements ou un rôle corporatif connexe, avec une expérience démontrée de la gestion de grandes équipes

• Connaissance approfondie des règlements sur la salubrité des aliments, y compris les normes ISO 22000, et expérience de la mise en oeuvre et de l'application de procédures de manipulation sécuritaire des aliments

• Compétences éprouvées en gestion budgétaire et en analyse financière, avec la capacité de créer, de superviser et de rendre compte des budgets et des résultats financiers

• Expérience de la gestion des fournisseurs et des contrats, y compris la négociation de contrats et la gestion des relations avec les partenaires et fournisseurs externes

• Compétence dans la planification et l'exécution des événements, y compris l'élaboration de plans d'événements, de calendriers et la coordination avec plusieurs intervenants internes et externes

• Compétences démontrées en matière d'appropriation, de responsabilisation et de leadership – capacité de prendre en charge les résultats, de donner l'exemple et de produire des résultats même dans des situations ambiguës ou difficiles

Qu'est-ce qui vous ferait sortir :

• Baccalauréat en gestion d'accueil, planification d'événements, arts culinaires ou un domaine connexe

• Certifications telles que ServSafe Food Handler ou références similaires pour la salubrité des aliments

• Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) ou une certification équivalente pour la gestion des événements

• Expérience de travail dans divers environnements multigéographiques

• Connaissance des règlements de paiement des fournisseurs du MSME et des exigences de conformité

• Connaissance des réglementations locales en matière de santé et de sécurité au travail en Inde

• Expérience des initiatives d'automatisation et d'amélioration des processus dans un contexte d'accueil ou de gestion des installations

• Compétence dans la préparation des tableaux de bord et des rapports de données pour la consommation et le suivi budgétaire

• Fortes compétences en communication orale et écrite en anglais et en langue locale

• Une approche collaborative et empathique du travail d'équipe dans des environnements virtuels et en personne

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine

À propos de Swiss Re
 Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Nous couvrons à la fois Propriété & Casualty et Vie & Santé. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
 Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

Corporate Solutions Property Underwriter – Mexico

About the Role
 We are looking for a market-oriented Property Underwriter to support the profitable growth of our Corporate Solutions portfolio in Mexico. This role combines strong underwriting capabilities with a highly commercial mindset, focusing on developing broker and client relationships, originating new business opportunities and delivering tailored insurance solutions.
 The successful candidate will bring an established market presence and a strong network within the Mexican Property insurance sector, helping to strengthen Swiss Re Corporate Solutions' position in the market while driving sustainable portfolio growth.
 About the Team
 We are a diverse and collaborative team focused on delivering Property insurance solutions for corporate clients across Mexico and the Caribbean. By combining market knowledge, technical expertise and a strong client focus, we help our customers navigate risk and support the sustainable growth of our business.
 In this role, you will:

• Develop and grow a profitable Property portfolio within the Mexican market.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers and clients to generate new business and keep renewals opportunities and strengthen Swiss Re Corporate Solutions' market presence.

• Underwrite Property risks within delegated authority, balancing technical assessment with commercial objectives.

• Negotiate terms, conditions and pricing while ensuring sustainable portfolio profitability.

• Collaborate across underwriting, engineering, claims and other functions to deliver client-focused solutions.

• Promote and cross-sell the broader Swiss Re Corporate Solutions product offering.

• Leverage underwriting tools, market insights and portfolio analysis to support sound business decisions.

About You
 You are a commercially driven underwriting professional who enjoys building relationships, developing business and creating value for clients and brokers. You combine solid Property underwriting expertise with a strong understanding of the Mexican insurance market and a proactive approach to business development.

Professional Experience

• 4–7 years of experience within the insurance industry.

• Solid Property underwriting experience in the Mexican market.

• Strong and established network within the Mexican Property insurance market, with demonstrated experience managing broker relationships and originating new business opportunities.

• Proven ability to develop business opportunities and manage commercial relationships.

• Good understanding of Property risk assessment, pricing and portfolio management principles.

• Experience negotiating terms, conditions and pricing with brokers and clients.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across internal and external audiences.

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Risk Management, Business, Economics or a related field preferred.

Personal Qualities

• Strong commercial acumen and client focus.

• Relationship builder with a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset.

• Effective negotiation and influencing skills.

• Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills.

• Ability to balance technical analysis with business development objectives.

• Fluent in Spanish and English.

• Willingness to travel within Mexico as required.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Property Underwriter orientato al mercato per sostenere la crescita proficua del nostro portafoglio Corporate Solutions in Messico. Informazioni sulla squadra

jobs.description:
About the Team and our Scope

Our team, a software house within Swiss Re, develops cloud-native (Azure-based) SaaS/PaaS solutions for external Life & Health insurance clients. Our portfolio includes globally established products and those in growth or incubation stages. We utilize the latest technology and prioritize innovation to stay competitive.

Our technical team comprises professionals with multidisciplinary skills, located in various countries, delivering highly available, multi-regional solutions used worldwide.

About the Role

As the Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong frontend skills, you will design and develop software solutions, assist fellow engineers through peer coding and reviews, and lead discussions on development approaches and best practices. Collaborate with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business needs into robust technological solutions that align with the product vision and roadmap.

Your responsibilities will be:

• Design and develop high-quality, rich front-end applications for cloud-native, scalable environments.

• Build and maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing software that meets scalability and client requirements.

• Participate in architecture and design workshops, code reviews, and SDLC activities, collaborating closely with architects, engineering managers, and product owners.

• Evaluate and prototype new technologies by building Proofs of Concept (PoCs).

• Promote and apply software engineering best practices through collaboration, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

• Working in Agile environments, delivering high-quality software, mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving engineering best practices.

About You

Nobody is perfect and meets 100% requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are genuinely curious about the world of software development, we will be happy to meet you.

If you possess traits and experience that fit into the below, we’d love to hear from you.

Must have excellent technical proficiency in

• Expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and React, including hooks, functional components, and modern React patterns.

• Strong UI development experience with responsive design, MUI, CSS-Modules, Tailwind CSS, Post CSS, and Sass/Less.

• Strong knowledge of Redux Toolkit, Context API, Tan Stack Query, React Router/Tan Stack Router, route-driven UX, lazy loading, code splitting, and frontend performance optimization.

• Strong knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG), semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and automated accessibility testing.

• Strong testing experience with Jest, React Testing Library, user-event, and exposure to Cypress or Playwright.

• Experience in designing, developing, and integrating APIs, with the ability to understand backend implementations and perform end-to-end troubleshooting.

• Strong knowledge of relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL), schema versioning (Flyway), and ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA).

• Experience designing, implementing, testing, and delivering reliable, high-performance, scalable cloud-native applications using modern cloud services and architectural patterns.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise authentication and identity solutions.

• Experience with application packaging and containerization, including build tooling, Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.

• Strong understanding of secure software design, secure coding practices, static code analysis, vulnerability scanning, and remediation.

• Basic knowledge of Terraform, including reading existing configurations and implementing minor changes.

• Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud infrastructure, networking, security, resource provisioning, and cloud operating models.

Nice to have

• Experience designing and implementing enterprise backend applications using Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot.

• Knowledge of cross-service communication patterns, including REST APIs, messaging, and JSON serialization.

• Experience with advanced Spring Boot features such as custom annotation processors, request interceptors, background task executors, asynchronous jobs, and Spring Security.

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,800 and EUR 6,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

Come Senior Full Stack Engineer con forti capacità di frontend, si progetta e sviluppa soluzioni software, assistere i colleghi ingegneri attraverso peer coding e recensioni, e condurre discussioni su approcci di sviluppo e best practice. Deve avere un'eccellente competenza tecnica

• Competenza in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript e React, compresi ganci, componenti funzionali e moderni modelli React.

• Forte esperienza di sviluppo dell'interfaccia utente con design reattivo, MUI, CSS-Modules, Tailwind CSS, Post CSS e Sass/Less.

• Forte conoscenza di Redux Toolkit, Context API, Tan Stack Query, React Router/Tan Stack Router, route-driven UX, carico pigro, divisione codice e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni frontend.

• Forte conoscenza dell'accessibilità web (WCAG), HTML semantico, ARIA, navigazione della tastiera, contrasto del colore e test di accessibilità automatizzati.

• Forte esperienza di test con Jest, React Testing Library, user-event e l'esposizione a Cypress o Playwright.

• Esperienza nella progettazione, nello sviluppo e nell'integrazione delle API, con la capacità di comprendere le implementazioni backend ed eseguire la risoluzione dei problemi end-to-end.

• Forte conoscenza dei database relazionali (MSSQL, PostgreSQL), versione schema (Flyway), e ORM framework (Hibernate, JPA).

• La progettazione, l'implementazione, il test e la fornitura di applicazioni cloud-native affidabili, ad alte prestazioni e scalabili utilizzando moderni servizi cloud e modelli architettonici.

• Esperienza pratica con soluzioni di autenticazione e identità aziendali.

• Esperienza con l'imballaggio delle applicazioni e la containerizzazione, tra cui la costruzione di utensili, Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker e Kubernetes.

• Forte comprensione della progettazione sicura del software, delle pratiche di codifica sicure, dell'analisi del codice statico, della scansione della vulnerabilità e della bonifica.

• Conoscenza di base di Terraform, inclusa la lettura delle configurazioni esistenti e l'attuazione di modifiche minori.

• Comprensione di Infrastructure come Code (IaC), infrastrutture cloud, networking, sicurezza, provisioning delle risorse e modelli operativi cloud.

Che bello avere

• Scopri la progettazione e l'implementazione di applicazioni backend aziendali utilizzando Java/Kotlin e Spring Boot.

• Conoscenza dei modelli di comunicazione cross-service, tra cui API REST, messaggistica e serializzazione JSON.

• Esperienza con funzioni avanzate di Spring Boot come processori di annotazione personalizzati, intercettatori di richiesta, esecutori di compiti di sfondo, lavori asincroni, e Spring Security.

Per la Slovacchia l'intervallo di stipendio base per questa posizione è compreso tra EUR 3.800 e EUR 6.300 al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione.
L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

About the Team and our Scope

Our team, a software house within Swiss Re, develops cloud-native (Azure-based) SaaS/PaaS solutions for external Life & Health insurance clients. Our portfolio includes globally established products and those in growth or incubation stages. We utilize the latest technology and prioritize innovation to stay competitive.

Our technical team comprises professionals with multidisciplinary skills, located in various countries, delivering highly available, multi-regional solutions used worldwide.

About the Role

As the Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong frontend skills, you will design and develop software solutions, assist fellow engineers through peer coding and reviews, and lead discussions on development approaches and best practices. Collaborate with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business needs into robust technological solutions that align with the product vision and roadmap.

Your responsibilities will be:

• Design and develop high-quality, rich front-end applications for cloud-native, scalable environments.

• Build and maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing software that meets scalability and client requirements.

• Participate in architecture and design workshops, code reviews, and SDLC activities, collaborating closely with architects, engineering managers, and product owners.

• Evaluate and prototype new technologies by building Proofs of Concept (PoCs).

• Promote and apply software engineering best practices through collaboration, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

• Working in Agile environments, delivering high-quality software, mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving engineering best practices.

About You

Nobody is perfect and meets 100% requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are genuinely curious about the world of software development, we will be happy to meet you.

If you possess traits and experience that fit into the below, we’d love to hear from you.

Must have excellent technical proficiency in

• Expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and React, including hooks, functional components, and modern React patterns.

• Strong UI development experience with responsive design, MUI, CSS-Modules, Tailwind CSS, Post CSS, and Sass/Less.

• Strong knowledge of Redux Toolkit, Context API, Tan Stack Query, React Router/Tan Stack Router, route-driven UX, lazy loading, code splitting, and frontend performance optimization.

• Strong knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG), semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and automated accessibility testing.

• Strong testing experience with Jest, React Testing Library, user-event, and exposure to Cypress or Playwright.

• Experience in designing, developing, and integrating APIs, with the ability to understand backend implementations and perform end-to-end troubleshooting.

• Strong knowledge of relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL), schema versioning (Flyway), and ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA).

• Experience designing, implementing, testing, and delivering reliable, high-performance, scalable cloud-native applications using modern cloud services and architectural patterns.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise authentication and identity solutions.

• Experience with application packaging and containerization, including build tooling, Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.

• Strong understanding of secure software design, secure coding practices, static code analysis, vulnerability scanning, and remediation.

• Basic knowledge of Terraform, including reading existing configurations and implementing minor changes.

• Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud infrastructure, networking, security, resource provisioning, and cloud operating models.

Nice to have

• Experience designing and implementing enterprise backend applications using Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot.

• Knowledge of cross-service communication patterns, including REST APIs, messaging, and JSON serialization.

• Experience with advanced Spring Boot features such as custom annotation processors, request interceptors, background task executors, asynchronous jobs, and Spring Security.

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,800 and EUR 6,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. jobs.title: AI Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Join P&C Reinsurance Engineering as an AI Engineering Lead and help shape the software systems, engineering practices, and technical direction behind our AI and agentic capabilities.
 We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with strong software engineering fundamentals who enjoys building and operating production systems while mentoring others and driving technical excellence.
 This is a hands-on leadership role focused on delivering business value through modern software engineering and practical AI adoption.
 About the Role
 As an AI Engineering Lead, you will lead the design, development, and operation of AI-enabled software systems supporting our reinsurance business. You will provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and help establish engineering standards while remaining actively involved in architecture and delivery decisions.
 You will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and engineers to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with business objectives.
 What You Will Do

• Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous learning

• Provide technical leadership across AI-enabled software solutions and platforms

• Drive implementation decisions for scalable, production-grade systems

• Oversee the development of services, integrations, APIs, and workflows supporting AI and agentic applications

• Ensure solutions deliver measurable business value and can be operated effectively at scale

• Guide teams in applying AI technologies pragmatically and responsibly

• Establish engineering standards for testing, deployment, monitoring, quality assurance, and operational excellence

• Support teams in building evaluation frameworks and quality controls for AI-powered systems

• Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to prioritize and deliver impactful solutions

Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. jobs.description:
In this role, you will become the strategic architecture authority for Digital & Tech Asset Management (D&T AM), ensuring alignment with Swiss Re’s enterprise-wide architecture vision and business priorities. You will act as a senior architectural leader, driving measurable improvements in platform resilience, engineering productivity and data-centric transformation while maintaining enterprise-grade security and cost discipline.
 Working closely with the EA leadership team, Design Authority, domain architects, and senior business and IT stakeholders, you will ensure our platforms, data ecosystems, and integration capabilities evolve in a secure, scalable, and future-ready manner.
 Key Responsibilities
 Enterprise & Solution Architecture Leadership

• Own the AM Landscape design. Define and maintain the target architecture vision, principles, standards, and technology roadmap for D&T Asset Management aligned with enterprise strategy and business outcomes.

• Serve as the senior architecture authority for the division, define architectural guardrails and govern alignment of solution designs with target-state architecture, technology selection, and major transformation initiatives.

• Translate complex technical and architectural topics into clear business decisions and executive-level recommendations.

• Ensure alignment with Business Architecture & Capability Management.
 Data Architecture & Information Strategy

• Define and evolve the division’s data architecture strategy, including data flows, integration patterns, data models, lineage, governance, and platform interoperability.

• Guide architecture decisions related to data platforms, APIs, event-driven integration, master/reference data, and AI-enabled data capabilities.
 Technology Strategy & Innovation

• Drive technology modernization and evaluate emerging capabilities through PoCs and assessments, ensuring scalable adoption of enterprise-aligned platforms.

• Champion Generative AI capabilities, AI-augmented engineering practices, and intelligent automation - evaluating enterprise AI platforms for productivity and operational impact.

• Drive remediation of tech debt.
 Enterprise Representation

• Represent D&T Asset Management in Swiss Re enterprise architecture forums, governance bodies, and strategic technology discussions.

• Influence enterprise-wide technology direction through active contribution to architecture standards, reference architectures, patterns, and governance processes.
 Governance & Operational Resilience

• Lead architecture reviews and enforce architecture standards, security requirements, resilience objectives, and operational excellence goals.

• Ensure consistent documentation and application of architecture principles and standards across the division.
 About the Team
 The D&T Asset Management (D&T AM) team sits within Swiss Re's Group Digital & Technology Office (GDTO) — a global function at the heart of Swiss Re's technology transformation. Our team is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the technology and data architecture that underpins Swiss Re's Asset Management capabilities.
 We work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and complex financial ecosystems, partnering closely with business and IT stakeholders across the globe to deliver scalable, resilient, and innovative solutions. We value pragmatic thinking, bold ideas, and a shared commitment to making Swiss Re's platforms future-ready.
 About You
 You can envision the future state architecture while understanding the practical steps to get there. You thrive in collaborative environments where you can translate complex technical concepts into business value.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 15+ years of experience in enterprise or domain architecture and technology strategy within complex IT environments

• Proven expertise in data architecture concepts including data modeling, integration architecture, governance, data lineage, and distributed data ecosystems

• Experience driving large-scale modernization and transformation initiatives in complex, regulated environments

• Demonstrated understanding of AI and intelligent automation in enterprise IT contexts — including Generative AI adoption, LLM-based tooling, AI governance frameworks, and their practical applications such as developer copilots, AIOps, automated testing, and documentation generation — combined with strong awareness of responsible AI principles, data privacy, and compliance

• Proven ability to collaborate across leadership levels and influence effectively in complex, matrixed organizational structures
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with asset management technology and the specific platforms, data, and regulatory landscape of the financial services industry

• Experience in vendor management and technology partnerships , with a track record of successful collaboration with external technology providers

• Hands-on experience with Enterprise Architecture tools

• Experience defining or contributing to an enterprise AI strategy or AI governance framework, including responsible AI principles, model risk management, and AI ethics considerations

• TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification

• Experience contributing to or leading architecture governance bodies and design authority forums
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 5,200] and [EUR 8,700] per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
