Êtes-vous un assureur expérimenté prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur l'un des marchés de réassurance les plus dynamiques d'Afrique? Si vous vous développez sur la complexité, aimez établir des relations avec les clients, et voulez faire partie d'une équipe qui fait vraiment une différence — ce pourrait être votre prochain grand mouvement.
À propos du rôle
C'est une occasion rare d'entrer dans un rôle d'assurance senior à haut impact chez Swiss Re, l'un des premiers réassureurs au monde. Basé dans notre bureau du Cap ou de Johannesburg, vous serez au cœur de l'évaluation de la mortalité, de la morbidité et des risques financiers complexes pour les activités de réassurance de vie et de santé en Afrique subsaharienne. Vous jouerez un rôle central en soutenant les objectifs stratégiques de Swiss Re en fournissant des décisions de souscription de haute qualité, des évaluations des risques et une expertise technique à la fois aux clients et aux intervenants internes, tout en contribuant à façonner l'avenir de la réassurance dans la région.
Principales responsabilités

• Évaluer les risques complexes : évaluer la mortalité, la morbidité et les risques financiers complexes pour les entreprises de réassurance vie et santé avec précision et confiance

• Favoriser la performance du portefeuille : Collaborer avec les équipes de tarification, d'actuariat et de réclamations pour assurer des résultats durables et rentables

• Être un partenaire client fiable : agir en tant que consultant en souscription technique et en tant que partenaire pour les cédants, les appuyer dans les pratiques exemplaires, la formation, les vérifications et l'amélioration des processus

• Contribuer à la croissance des entreprises : fournir une expertise en matière de souscription lors des négociations de traités et des initiatives de développement de produits

• Partagez vos connaissances : Dirigez et mentorez des collègues, contribuant au développement de la capacité de souscription au sein de l'équipe

• Représenter Suisse Externe: Assister et assister à des conférences, séminaires et ateliers clients, en élevant le profil de Swiss Re sur le marché

• Fournir des renseignements sur l'évaluation des risques : fournir des renseignements sur la gestion du portefeuille et des conseils techniques aux intervenants internes pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques
À propos de l'équipe
Swiss Re Africa est l'un des principaux réassureurs sur le marché de l'Afrique subsaharienne, tant à court terme qu'à long terme. Nous sommes une équipe dynamique et collaborative qui s'intéresse fortement aux clients et qui s'engage à favoriser un environnement inclusif et favorable pour tous les employés. Rejoindre cette équipe signifie faire partie d'un groupe passionné par l'innovation, l'excellence et faire une réelle différence dans le paysage de l'assurance en Afrique.
À propos de toi
Vous êtes un professionnel curieux, motivé et techniquement fort de souscription qui prend possession et dirige avec confiance. Vous apportez un esprit de collaboration, une véritable passion pour l'engagement client, et la capacité de naviguer la complexité avec clarté. Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler dans un environnement en constante évolution et vous êtes stimulé par l'opportunité de guider les autres, d'influencer la stratégie et de représenter Swiss Re en tant que leader de la pensée sur le marché.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• 8 à 10 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la vie et de la santé, avec une compréhension solide et démontrable des risques complexes de mortalité et de morbidité

• Une expertise financière et médicale approfondie , avec la capacité d'évaluer des cas sophistiqués et de grande valeur

• Forte connaissance des marchés locaux de l'Afrique du Sud et de l'Afrique subsaharienne en général
Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Expérience en matière de développement de produits L&H et/ou de gestion de projets , ou expérience dans un rôle de réassurance ou d'assurance orienté vers le client

• La compétence linguistique afrikaans — un atout précieux lorsqu'il s'agit de s'entretenir avec un large éventail de clients et d'intervenants locaux

• Capacité démontrée de diriger, d'entraîner et de mentorer des assureurs juniors ou des membres de l'équipe interfonctionnelle

• Expérience représentant une organisation extérieure lors d'événements, de conférences ou d'ateliers clients

• Connaissance des processus de négociation des traités et de la capacité de contribuer utilement aux discussions sur le développement des produits et des entreprises
Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
La préférence sera accordée aux candidats à l'équité en matière d'emploi. #LI-Hybrid
Pour l'Afrique du Sud, l'échelle salariale de base annuelle pour ce poste se situe entre 700 000 ZAR et 1 160 000 ZAR (pour un rôle à temps plein). Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle,

• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience.
En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété de prestations globales et spécifiques à l'emplacement, par exemple la contribution de l'employeur à la caisse de retraite et à l'aide médicale à la découverte. L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Nous couvrons à la fois Propriété & Casualty et Vie & Santé. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

jobs.title: Senior Marine Underwriter
jobs.description:
Are you a highly motivated individual looking for an exciting opportunity to join our Marine and Energy team in London? Do you have passion for underwriting and are looking for a prominent role where you can demonstrate your expertise and market knowledge? If so, we want you to join our team!

About the Role

Our Team is looking for a Senior Underwriter with recognised experience and a successful track record in underwriting Large and Medium Sized Corporates. As a Senior Marine Underwriter, you will play an instrumental role shaping our Marine & Energy underwriting portfolio and will be a key contributor in driving our strategy. Experience with underwriting Composite placements is a plus. Your responsibilities will include:

• Analysing and assessing submissions in respect of exposures and coverages as well as identifying and negotiating the best position for Swiss Re

• Underwrite treaty reinsurance business for the various Marine classes including Cargo, Hull, Liability, Energy and PVT, including preparing quotations, offering proposals, wordings and clauses.

• Developing strategies to expand our position on current accounts and to cross-sell other lines of business.

• Support LoB Head with portfolio strategy and initiatives

• Share technical subject matter underwriting expertise with underwriters. Provide regular trainings on overarching topics and LoB governance specific topics

About You

We are looking for an open-minded, trustworthy and enthusiastic team player who can constructively and respectfully engage in challenging conversations. To be successful, you need to have strong communication, negotiation and partnering skills. Are you at ease with leaving the comfort zone and performing under pressure? Do you consider yourself to be a "self-starter", able and willing to take initiative and implement measures in a detail and goal-oriented manner with:

• Minimum 7–10 years relevant experience within the insurance and/or reinsurance industry, gained in underwriting, broking, or related market-facing roles. Experience leading placements, negotiations, and client relationships is highly desirable

• Strong background in building broker and client relationships.

• Proficiency in the use of underwriting tools and ability to interpret and judge the results

• Ability to handle multiple deals in parallel without losing oversight

• Strong Commercial mindset combined with technical expertise.

• Excellent Communication, negotiation and influencing skills.

• Good level of energy and pro-active behaviour

About the Team

Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. In questo ruolo, si acquisirà un'esposizione unica alla gestione senior e contribuire a progetti che influenzano direttamente il processo decisionale strategico, la comunicazione dei mercati finanziari e l'allocazione dei capitali. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate attraverso Finanza, Strategia, Tesoro e le Business Unit e sviluppare una profonda comprensione di come una società di servizi finanziari globali è gestito e valutato. In questo ruolo, si comunicherà.
Responsabilità chiave

• Supporta l'analisi delle performance finanziarie e la reportistica sulle aziende di Swiss Re, identificando le tendenze chiave e i driver aziendali

• Sostenere la preparazione di presentazioni, report e analisi per la gestione senior, il Comitato Esecutivo e il Consiglio di Amministrazione

• Svolgere un ruolo attivo nella preparazione di materiali di risultati finanziari trimestrali e annuali, nonché Investor Day e altri eventi chiave dell'investitore

• Condurre la ricerca sui mercati finanziari, le tendenze dell'industria di riassicurazione, la ricerca sul mercato, i concorrenti e gli sviluppi degli azionisti per fornire una gestione senior con approfondimenti esterni

• Sostenere le operazioni quotidiane del team mantenendo i materiali di reportistica, coordinando i processi ricorrenti e contribuendo al continuo miglioramento dei flussi di lavoro interni attraverso l'utilizzo di analytics e AI

Informazioni sulla squadra

Gruppo FP&A & Investor Relations si trova al centro del processo decisionale finanziario e strategico di Swiss Re. Il nostro lavoro combina analisi finanziarie, strategia aziendale, gestione dei capitali e comunicazione dei mercati dei capitali.

Come parte di un piccolo team di alto livello, lavorerai direttamente con professionisti esperti e acquisirai l'esposizione alla gestione esecutiva, ai leader aziendali e alla comunità di investimento. Promuoviamo un ambiente di curiosità intellettuale, di proprietà e di apprendimento continuo, dove i membri del team sono incoraggiati a sfidare le idee, prendere iniziative e contribuire dal primo giorno.

Su di te

• Corso di laurea (completato o vicino al completamento) in Finanza, Economia, Business Administration o un campo relativo

• Forte mentalità analitica

• Proficienza avanzata in PowerPoint ed Excel

• Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese; il tedesco è un vantaggio

• Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali

• Proattivo, curioso e desideroso di imparare in un ambiente veloce e internazionale

• Alto livello di integrità e professionalità quando si tratta di informazioni riservate

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

Si tratta di una posizione studentesca di lavoro (50-80%) con un contratto a tempo determinato di 12 mesi con la possibilità di estendere. Questo ruolo ha anche il potenziale di transizione a un ruolo a tempo pieno. I candidati di alto livello possono avere l'opportunità di passare a un ruolo a tempo pieno e continuare la loro carriera in Swiss Re

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione!

La gamma di stipendio base per questa posizione sarà condivisa con voi durante il processo di intervista.

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

About the Role

Are you interested in understanding how one of the world's leading financial institutions creates value, allocates capital and engages with investors? Are you excited by the intersection of finance, strategy and capital markets?
Group FP&A & Investor Relations is looking for a motivated Financial Analyst (Working Student) to join our team. Sitting at the centre of Swiss Re's financial planning, performance management and investor communication, we play a key role in supporting strategic decision-making and shaping how Swiss Re is perceived by the investment community.

In this role, you will gain unique exposure to senior management and contribute to projects that directly influence strategic decision-making, financial markets communication and capital allocation. You will work closely with stakeholders across Finance, Strategy, Treasury and the Business Units and develop a deep understanding of how a global financial services company is managed and valued.

Key responsibilities

• Support financial performance analysis and reporting across Swiss Re's businesses, identifying key trends and business drivers

• Support the preparation of presentations, reports and analyses for senior management, the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors

• Play an active role in the preparation of quarterly and annual financial results materials, as well as Investor Day and other key investor events

• Conduct research on financial markets, re/insurance industry trends, sell-side research, competitors and shareholder developments to provide senior management with external insights

• Support the team's day-to-day operations by maintaining reporting materials, coordinating recurring processes and contributing to the continuous improvement of internal workflows through the use of analytics and AI

About the Team

Group FP&A & Investor Relations sits at the centre of Swiss Re's financial and strategic decision-making process. Our work combines financial analysis, corporate strategy, capital management and capital markets communication.

As part of a small, high-performing team, you will work directly with experienced professionals and gain exposure to executive management, business leaders and the investment community. We foster an environment of intellectual curiosity, ownership and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge ideas, take initiative and contribute from day one.

About you

• Bachelor's degree (completed or close to completion) in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field

• Strong analytical mindset

• Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel

• Excellent written and spoken English; German is an advantage

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Proactive, curious and eager to learn in a fast-paced, international environment

• High level of integrity and professionalism when handling confidential information

Further information about the role

This is a working student position (50-80%) with a fixed-term contract of 12 months with the option to extend. High-performing candidates may have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role and continue their career at Swiss Re.

We look forward to receiving your application!

The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Engineering Underwriter, Swiss Re India Branch
 Are you a detail-oriented insurance professional with a passion for engineering risk and a drive to make a real impact in one of the world's most dynamic markets? This is your opportunity to join a global reinsurance leader and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of engineering underwriting in India.

About the Role
 As an Engineering Underwriter, you will be at the heart of our underwriting operations — bridging analytical excellence with client-focused solutions. You will partner closely with senior underwriters to drive economic profit growth, delivering sharp pre-underwriting analysis and seamless post-underwriting support across treaty and facultative engineering business. This role offers a unique blend of technical depth and market exposure.
 Key Responsibilities

• Drive economic profit growth by providing high-quality analytical support to senior underwriters in India, enabling informed underwriting decisions on engineering treaty and facultative business

• Conduct thorough exposure assessments, input pricing data into systems, and prepare pre-underwriting notes for review by Engineering Underwriters

• Complete post-underwriting activities accurately and efficiently in the system upon finalization of business by the underwriter

• Analyse client requests from the Indian market and deliver well-reasoned recommendations on engineering treaty and facultative business

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support deal-team solutions and client needs

• Contribute to and exchange knowledge within the Engineering Underwriting community, sharing insights and best practices across the global network

• Stay informed on global Engineering market trends and developments, applying specialist know-how to add value to clients and client teams in India

• Bring a collaborative mindset and technical expertise to cross-functional initiatives

About the Team
 Our Engineering Underwriting team in India is a dynamic and collaborative group dedicated to growing and managing a high-quality engineering reinsurance portfolio across treaty and facultative lines. The team works closely with global underwriting communities to deliver tailored, innovative solutions to clients across the Indian market. With a strong focus on knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and market development, the team plays a strategic role in Swiss Re's presence and growth in one of the world's most exciting insurance markets.

About You
 You are a curious and analytically minded professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and is eager to deepen your expertise in engineering reinsurance. You bring a structured approach to problem-solving, communicate complex ideas with clarity, and are motivated by contributing to a high-performing team. You are entrepreneurial, proactive, and detail-oriented — someone who takes ownership and is passionate about building deep knowledge in a specialised and globally relevant field.
 The successful candidate will demonstrate the following core professional attributes, which are considered essential to performing effectively in this role and integral to our team culture:

• Collaborative team orientation — ability to work cohesively within a team, actively contributing to shared goals and supporting colleagues across all levels

• Adaptability — the capacity to respond constructively to changing priorities, evolving business needs, and new challenges with composure and professionalism

• Open-mindedness — a genuine willingness to consider diverse perspectives, embrace new ideas, and engage with different approaches to problem-solving

• Interpersonal effectiveness — the ability to build positive, productive working relationships with colleagues, clients, and stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner
 We are looking for candidates with the following requirements:

• 3–8 years of insurance industry experience or reinsurance sector, with underwriting experience preferred

• On-ground experience in the construction industry, providing practical understanding of engineering risks and project environments is preferred

• Engineering qualification — a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil, Mechanical Engineering from a recognised government or elite private institution

• A Master's in Business Administration from the National Insurance Academy or an equivalent (re)insurance-specialised institution is an added advantage
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with the Indian insurance or reinsurance market and its regulatory landscape

• Experience working with pricing tools or underwriting systems and inputting/managing technical data

• Exposure to claims advisory or coverage analysis in an engineering context

• Entrepreneurial mindset — a sense of urgency, cost-consciousness, and willingness to take calculated risks, with a commitment to sustainable performance and continuous improvement

• Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage peak-period workloads effectively

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment, adapting seamlessly to a fast-paced and evolving landscape

• Creative thinking and problem-solving attitude, with a proactive approach to challenges

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Ingegneria Underwriter, Swiss Re India Branch
Sei un professionista dell'assicurazione orientato al dettaglio con una passione per il rischio di ingegneria e una spinta a fare un impatto reale in uno dei mercati più dinamici del mondo? Questa è la vostra occasione per unire un leader di riassicurazione globale e svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione del futuro della sottoscrizione di ingegneria in India.

Informazioni sul ruolo
Come Sottoscrittore di Ingegneria, sarete al centro delle nostre operazioni di sottoscrizione - bridging eccellenza analitica con soluzioni orientate al cliente. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con gli scrittori senior per guidare la crescita del profitto economico, offrendo analisi di pre-underwriting taglienti e supporto post-underwriting senza soluzione di continuità attraverso il trattato e il business di ingegneria facoltativa. Questo ruolo offre una miscela unica di profondità tecnica e esposizione al mercato.
Principali responsabilità

• Promuovere la crescita del profitto economico fornendo un supporto analitico di alta qualità ai sottoscritti senior in India, consentendo decisioni di sottoscrizione informate sul trattato di ingegneria e le imprese facoltative

• Condurre valutazioni approfondite dell'esposizione, dati dei prezzi degli input nei sistemi, e preparare le note pre-underwriting per la revisione da parte di Engineering Underwriters

• Completa attività post-underwriting con precisione ed efficienza nel sistema dopo la finalizzazione del business da parte del sottoscrittore

• Analizzare le richieste dei clienti dal mercato indiano e fornire raccomandazioni ben risonate sul trattato di ingegneria e le imprese facoltative

• Collabora con i team interfunzionali per supportare le soluzioni per i sistemi di controllo e le esigenze dei clienti

• Contribuisci e scambia le conoscenze all'interno della community di Engineering Underwriting, condividendo intuizioni e best practice in tutta la rete globale

• Resta informato sulle tendenze e gli sviluppi del mercato di ingegneria globale, applicando know-how specialistico per aggiungere valore ai clienti e ai team dei clienti in India

• Portare una mentalità collaborativa e competenze tecniche a iniziative interfunzionali

Informazioni sulla squadra
Il nostro team Engineering Underwriting in India è un gruppo dinamico e collaborativo dedicato alla crescita e alla gestione di un portafoglio di riassicurazione ingegneristica di alta qualità attraverso linee di trattato e di facoltativi. Il team lavora a stretto contatto con le comunità di sottoscrittura globali per fornire soluzioni personalizzate e innovative ai clienti in tutto il mercato indiano. Con un forte focus sulla condivisione delle conoscenze, l'eccellenza tecnica e lo sviluppo del mercato, il team svolge un ruolo strategico nella presenza e nella crescita di Swiss Re in uno dei mercati assicurativi più emozionanti del mondo.

A proposito di te
Sei un professionista curioso e analiticamente consapevole che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo ed è ansioso di approfondire la tua esperienza nella riassicurazione ingegneristica. Si porta un approccio strutturato per risolvere i problemi, comunicare idee complesse con chiarezza, e sono motivati da contribuire a un team di alta formazione. Voi siete imprenditoriali, proattivi e orientati al dettaglio – qualcuno che prende la proprietà ed è appassionato di costruire una profonda conoscenza in un campo specializzato e globalmente rilevante.
Il candidato di successo dimostrerà i seguenti attributi professionali fondamentali, che sono considerati essenziali per svolgere efficacemente in questo ruolo e parte integrante della nostra cultura del team:

• L'orientamento del team collaborativo — la capacità di lavorare in modo coerente all'interno di un team, contribuendo attivamente a obiettivi condivisi e supportando i colleghi di tutti i livelli

• Adaptability — la capacità di rispondere in modo costruttivo alle mutevoli priorità, alle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione e alle nuove sfide con la compostezza e la professionalità

• La mentalità aperta — una sincera volontà di considerare prospettive diverse, abbracciare nuove idee, e impegnarsi con approcci diversi per risolvere i problemi

• Efficienza interpersonale — la capacità di costruire relazioni di lavoro positive e produttive con colleghi, clienti e stakeholder in modo professionale e avvicinabile
Stiamo cercando candidati con i seguenti requisiti:

• 3-8 anni di esperienza del settore assicurativo o di riassicurazione, con esperienza di sottoscrizione preferita

• L'esperienza on-ground nel settore delle costruzioni, fornendo comprensione pratica dei rischi di ingegneria e ambienti di progetto è preferito

• Qualifica di ingegneria — una laurea o master in ingegneria civile, meccanica da un governo riconosciuto o istituto privato d'elite

• Un Master in Business Administration presso l'Accademia Nazionale di Assicurazione o un'istituzione equivalente (re)specializzata dell'assicurazione è un vantaggio aggiunto
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Familiarità con il mercato indiano dell'assicurazione o della riassicurazione e il suo paesaggio normativo

• Esperienza di lavoro con strumenti di pricing o sistemi di sottoscrizione e input/managing dati tecnici

• Esposizione a reclami di consulenza o analisi di copertura in un contesto ingegneristico

• Mindset imprenditoriale — un senso di urgenza, coscienza dei costi e la volontà di assumere rischi calcolati, con un impegno per prestazioni sostenibili e un miglioramento continuo

• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto, con la capacità di gestire carichi di lavoro di alto livello in modo efficace

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo all'interno di un ambiente di squadra, adattandosi senza soluzione di continuità ad un paesaggio veloce ed in evoluzione

• Il pensiero creativo e l'atteggiamento di problem solving, con un approccio proattivo alle sfide

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese

Engineering Underwriter, Swiss Re India Branch
Are you a detail-oriented insurance professional with a passion for engineering risk and a drive to make a real impact in one of the world's most dynamic markets? This is your opportunity to join a global reinsurance leader and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of engineering underwriting in India.

About the Role
As an Engineering Underwriter, you will be at the heart of our underwriting operations — bridging analytical excellence with client-focused solutions. You will partner closely with senior underwriters to drive economic profit growth, delivering sharp pre-underwriting analysis and seamless post-underwriting support across treaty and facultative engineering business. This role offers a unique blend of technical depth and market exposure.
Key Responsibilities

• Drive economic profit growth by providing high-quality analytical support to senior underwriters in India, enabling informed underwriting decisions on engineering treaty and facultative business

• Conduct thorough exposure assessments, input pricing data into systems, and prepare pre-underwriting notes for review by Engineering Underwriters

• Complete post-underwriting activities accurately and efficiently in the system upon finalization of business by the underwriter

• Analyse client requests from the Indian market and deliver well-reasoned recommendations on engineering treaty and facultative business

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support deal-team solutions and client needs

• Contribute to and exchange knowledge within the Engineering Underwriting community, sharing insights and best practices across the global network

• Stay informed on global Engineering market trends and developments, applying specialist know-how to add value to clients and client teams in India

• Bring a collaborative mindset and technical expertise to cross-functional initiatives

About the Team
Our Engineering Underwriting team in India is a dynamic and collaborative group dedicated to growing and managing a high-quality engineering reinsurance portfolio across treaty and facultative lines. The team works closely with global underwriting communities to deliver tailored, innovative solutions to clients across the Indian market. With a strong focus on knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and market development, the team plays a strategic role in Swiss Re's presence and growth in one of the world's most exciting insurance markets.

About You
You are a curious and analytically minded professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and is eager to deepen your expertise in engineering reinsurance. You bring a structured approach to problem-solving, communicate complex ideas with clarity, and are motivated by contributing to a high-performing team. You are entrepreneurial, proactive, and detail-oriented — someone who takes ownership and is passionate about building deep knowledge in a specialised and globally relevant field.
The successful candidate will demonstrate the following core professional attributes, which are considered essential to performing effectively in this role and integral to our team culture:

• Collaborative team orientation — ability to work cohesively within a team, actively contributing to shared goals and supporting colleagues across all levels

• Adaptability — the capacity to respond constructively to changing priorities, evolving business needs, and new challenges with composure and professionalism

• Open-mindedness — a genuine willingness to consider diverse perspectives, embrace new ideas, and engage with different approaches to problem-solving

• Interpersonal effectiveness — the ability to build positive, productive working relationships with colleagues, clients, and stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner
We are looking for candidates with the following requirements:

• 3–8 years of insurance industry experience or reinsurance sector, with underwriting experience preferred

• On-ground experience in the construction industry, providing practical understanding of engineering risks and project environments is preferred

• Engineering qualification — a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil, Mechanical Engineering from a recognised government or elite private institution

• A Master's in Business Administration from the National Insurance Academy or an equivalent (re)insurance-specialised institution is an added advantage
These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with the Indian insurance or reinsurance market and its regulatory landscape

• Experience working with pricing tools or underwriting systems and inputting/managing technical data

• Exposure to claims advisory or coverage analysis in an engineering context

• Entrepreneurial mindset — a sense of urgency, cost-consciousness, and willingness to take calculated risks, with a commitment to sustainable performance and continuous improvement

• Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage peak-period workloads effectively

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment, adapting seamlessly to a fast-paced and evolving landscape

• Creative thinking and problem-solving attitude, with a proactive approach to challenges

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Engineering Underwriter, Niederlassung Swiss Re India
Sind Sie ein detailorientierter Versicherungsprofi mit einer Leidenschaft für technische Risiken und dem Drang, in einem der dynamischsten Märkte der Welt wirklich etwas zu bewirken? Dies ist Ihre Chance, sich einem globalen Rückversicherungsführer anzuschließen und eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft des Engineering Underwriting in Indien zu spielen.

Über die Rolle
Als Engineering Underwriter stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt unserer Underwriting-Aktivitäten - eine Brücke zwischen analytischer Exzellenz und kundenorientierten Lösungen. Sie werden eng mit leitenden Underwritern zusammenarbeiten, um das wirtschaftliche Gewinnwachstum voranzutreiben, eine scharfe Pre-Underwriting-Analyse und nahtlose Post-Underwriting-Unterstützung im gesamten Vertrags- und Optionsgeschäft zu liefern. Diese Rolle bietet eine einzigartige Mischung aus technischer Tiefe und Marktexposition.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Förderung des wirtschaftlichen Gewinnwachstums durch die Bereitstellung hochwertiger analytischer Unterstützung für leitende Underwriter in Indien, die fundierte Zeichnungsentscheidungen zu Ingenieurverträgen und fakultativen Geschäften ermöglicht

• Führen Sie gründliche Expositionsbewertungen durch, geben Sie Preisdaten in Systeme ein und bereiten Sie Pre-Underwriting-Anmerkungen für die Überprüfung durch Engineering Underwriter vor

• Komplette Post-Underwriting-Aktivitäten genau und effizient im System nach Abschluss des Geschäfts durch den Underwriter

• Analysieren Sie Kundenanfragen aus dem indischen Markt und liefern Sie fundierte Empfehlungen zu Ingenieurverträgen und fakultativen Geschäften

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Unterstützung von Deal-Team-Lösungen und Kundenanforderungen

• Beitrag zu und Austausch von Wissen innerhalb der Engineering Underwriting-Community, Austausch von Erkenntnissen und Best Practices im globalen Netzwerk

• Bleiben Sie informiert über globale Engineering-Markttrends und -entwicklungen und wenden Sie Fachwissen an, um Kunden und Kundenteams in Indien einen Mehrwert zu bieten

• Bringen Sie eine kollaborative Denkweise und technisches Fachwissen in funktionsübergreifende Initiativen ein

Über das Team
Unser Engineering Underwriting-Team in Indien ist eine dynamische und kooperative Gruppe, die sich dem Wachstum und der Verwaltung eines hochwertigen Engineering-Rückversicherungsportfolios über Vertrags- und Optionslinien hinweg widmet. Das Team arbeitet eng mit globalen Underwriting-Communities zusammen, um maßgeschneiderte, innovative Lösungen für Kunden auf dem indischen Markt zu liefern. Mit einem starken Fokus auf Wissensaustausch, technische Exzellenz und Marktentwicklung spielt das Team eine strategische Rolle bei der Präsenz und dem Wachstum von Swiss Re in einem der aufregendsten Versicherungsmärkte der Welt.

Über dich
Sie sind ein neugieriger und analytisch denkender Fachmann, der in einem kollaborativen Umfeld gedeiht und bestrebt ist, Ihre Expertise in der technischen Rückversicherung zu vertiefen. Sie bringen einen strukturierten Ansatz zur Problemlösung mit, kommunizieren komplexe Ideen klar und sind motiviert, zu einem leistungsstarken Team beizutragen. Sie sind unternehmerisch, proaktiv und detailorientiert - jemand, der Verantwortung übernimmt und leidenschaftlich daran interessiert ist, tiefes Wissen in einem spezialisierten und global relevanten Bereich aufzubauen.
Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird die folgenden beruflichen Kerneigenschaften zeigen, die als wesentlich für eine effektive Leistung in dieser Rolle und als integraler Bestandteil unserer Teamkultur angesehen werden:

• Teamorientierung – Fähigkeit, in einem Team kohäsiv zu arbeiten, aktiv zu gemeinsamen Zielen beizutragen und Kollegen auf allen Ebenen zu unterstützen

• Anpassungsfähigkeit - die Fähigkeit, konstruktiv auf sich ändernde Prioritäten, sich ändernde Geschäftsanforderungen und neue Herausforderungen mit Gelassenheit und Professionalität zu reagieren

• Aufgeschlossenheit - eine echte Bereitschaft, verschiedene Perspektiven zu berücksichtigen, neue Ideen anzunehmen und sich mit verschiedenen Ansätzen zur Problemlösung auseinanderzusetzen

• Zwischenmenschliche Effektivität - die Fähigkeit, positive, produktive Arbeitsbeziehungen mit Kollegen, Kunden und Stakeholdern professionell und zugänglich aufzubauen
Wir suchen Kandidaten mit folgenden Anforderungen:

• 3-8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche oder im Rückversicherungssektor, wobei versicherungstechnische Erfahrung bevorzugt wird

• Vor-Ort-Erfahrung in der Bauindustrie, die ein praktisches Verständnis der technischen Risiken und Projektumgebungen bietet, wird bevorzugt

• Ingenieur-Qualifikation - ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Bauwesen, Maschinenbau von einer anerkannten Regierung oder Elite private Institution

• Ein Master in Business Administration von der National Insurance Academy oder eine gleichwertige (Rück-)Versicherung spezialisierte Institution ist ein zusätzlicher Vorteil
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Vertrautheit mit dem indischen Versicherungs- oder Rückversicherungsmarkt und seiner Regulierungslandschaft

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Pricing-Tools oder Underwriting-Systemen und der Eingabe / Verwaltung technischer Daten

• Exposition gegenüber Schadensberatung oder Deckungsanalyse im technischen Kontext

• Unternehmerische Denkweise - ein Gefühl der Dringlichkeit, des Kostenbewusstseins und der Bereitschaft, kalkulierte Risiken einzugehen, mit der Verpflichtung zu nachhaltiger Leistung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung

• Starke organisatorische und Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Arbeitsbelastungen in der Hauptphase effektiv zu verwalten

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ in einer Teamumgebung zu arbeiten und sich nahtlos an eine schnelllebige und sich entwickelnde Landschaft anzupassen

• Kreatives Denken und Problemlösungshaltung mit proaktiver Herangehensweise an Herausforderungen

• Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch

Underwriter du génie, Swiss Re India Branch
Êtes-vous un professionnel de l'assurance de détail avec une passion pour le risque d'ingénierie et un effort pour faire un impact réel sur l'un des marchés les plus dynamiques du monde? C'est l'occasion pour vous de rejoindre un leader mondial de la réassurance et de jouer un rôle central dans l'élaboration de l'avenir de la souscription d'ingénierie en Inde.

À propos du rôle
En tant qu'Ingénieur, vous serez au cœur de nos activités de souscription, côtoyant l'excellence analytique à des solutions axées sur le client. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des assureurs chevronnés afin de stimuler la croissance des profits économiques, de fournir une analyse pré-assurance rigoureuse et un soutien continu après l'assurance dans l'ensemble des activités d'ingénierie conventionnelle et facultative. Ce rôle offre un mélange unique de profondeur technique et d'exposition au marché.
Principales responsabilités

• Favoriser la croissance des profits économiques en fournissant un soutien analytique de haute qualité aux principaux assureurs indiens, permettant de prendre des décisions éclairées de souscription sur les traités d'ingénierie et les affaires facultatives

• Effectuer des évaluations exhaustives de l'exposition, des données sur les prix des intrants dans les systèmes et préparer des notes de pré-assurance pour examen par les sous-traitants du génie

• Achèvement des activités de post-assurance avec précision et efficacité dans le système dès la finalisation des activités par le sous-traitant

• Analyser les demandes des clients du marché indien et formuler des recommandations judicieuses sur les traités d'ingénierie et les affaires facultatives

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour soutenir les solutions d'équipe et les besoins des clients

• Contribuer à l'échange de connaissances au sein de la communauté de l'Ingénierie, partager des connaissances et des pratiques exemplaires dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial

• Restez informé sur les tendances et les développements mondiaux du marché de l'ingénierie, en appliquant le savoir-faire spécialisé pour ajouter de la valeur aux clients et aux équipes clientes en Inde

• Apporter un esprit de collaboration et une expertise technique aux initiatives interfonctionnelles

À propos de l'équipe
Notre équipe d'Ingénierie en Inde est un groupe dynamique et collaboratif dédié à la croissance et la gestion d'un portefeuille de réassurance d'ingénierie de haute qualité à travers les lignes conventionnelles et facultatives. L'équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec les communautés de souscription mondiales pour offrir des solutions innovantes et adaptées aux clients du marché indien. Forte du partage des connaissances, de l'excellence technique et du développement du marché, l'équipe joue un rôle stratégique dans la présence et la croissance de Swiss Re sur l'un des marchés d'assurance les plus intéressants au monde.

À propos de toi
Vous êtes un professionnel curieux et analytique qui prospère dans un environnement collaboratif et qui est désireux d'approfondir votre expertise en réassurance d'ingénierie. Vous apportez une approche structurée à la résolution de problèmes, communiquez des idées complexes avec clarté et êtes motivé en contribuant à une équipe hautement performante. Vous êtes entrepreneurial, proactif et axé sur le détail, quelqu'un qui prend en main et qui est passionné par la construction de connaissances approfondies dans un domaine spécialisé et pertinent au niveau mondial.
Le candidat retenu démontrera les attributs professionnels fondamentaux suivants, qui sont considérés comme essentiels pour s'acquitter efficacement de ce rôle et faire partie intégrante de notre culture d'équipe :

• Orientation de l'équipe en collaboration — capacité de travailler de façon cohérente au sein d'une équipe, de contribuer activement à la réalisation d'objectifs communs et d'appuyer ses collègues à tous les niveaux

• Capacité d'adaptation — capacité de répondre de façon constructive à l'évolution des priorités, à l'évolution des besoins des entreprises et aux nouveaux défis avec souplesse et professionnalisme

• L'ouverture d'esprit — une réelle volonté d'examiner diverses perspectives, d'adopter de nouvelles idées et de s'engager dans différentes approches pour résoudre les problèmes

• Efficacité interpersonnelle — la capacité d'établir des relations de travail positives et productives avec les collègues, les clients et les intervenants d'une manière professionnelle et accessible
Nous recherchons des candidats ayant les exigences suivantes :

• 3-8 ans d'expérience dans le secteur de l'assurance ou de la réassurance, avec une expérience de souscription préférée

• Expérience sur le terrain dans l'industrie de la construction, offrant une compréhension pratique des risques d'ingénierie et des environnements de projet est préféré

• Diplôme d'ingénieur — baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie civil, mécanique d'un établissement privé reconnu du gouvernement ou d'élite

• Une maîtrise en administration des affaires de l'Académie nationale d'assurance ou d'un établissement équivalent (ré)spécialisé en assurance est un avantage supplémentaire
Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Connaissance du marché indien de l'assurance ou de la réassurance et de son paysage réglementaire

• Expérience de travail avec des outils de tarification ou des systèmes de souscription et saisie/gestion des données techniques

• Exposition à un avis de réclamation ou à une analyse de couverture dans un contexte technique

• L'esprit d'entreprise — un sentiment d'urgence, de conscience des coûts et de volonté de prendre des risques calculés, avec un engagement à des performances durables et une amélioration continue

• Fortes compétences en gestion d'organisation et de projet, avec la capacité de gérer efficacement les charges de travail des périodes de pointe

• Capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et en collaboration dans un environnement d'équipe, en s'adaptant parfaitement à un paysage en évolution rapide

• Pensée créative et attitude de résolution de problèmes, avec une approche proactive des défis

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais

jobs.title: Financial Reporting Associate
jobs.description:
Are you a detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys turning numbers into meaningful insights while working with cutting-edge technology and AI? If you're ready to grow your career in financial reporting within a dynamic, global organization — this is your opportunity!
 About the Role
 As a Financial Reporting Associate, you will play a meaningful role in supporting the financial reporting and analysis for the US P&C Reinsurance legal entities. You'll be part of a collaborative team that delivers accurate, timely, and insightful financial information to key stakeholders across Finance and business functions. Beyond traditional financial reporting, you will help shape the future of Finance by contributing to the transformation of reporting processes through automation, AI-enabled solutions and modern technologies. This is a fantastic opportunity to build a strong foundation in U.S. Statutory reporting while helping shape the future of Finance in a fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environment.
 Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and compile high-quality financial information on a U.S. Statutory basis, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established guidelines and review processes

• Support legal entity performance analysis , including variance analysis and trend monitoring to provide actionable insights to finance and business partners

• Assist with period-end close and reporting activities , maintaining accuracy and adherence to established controls and deadlines

• Execute assigned control activities and maintain thorough documentation within the financial reporting environment

• Contribute to the transformation of Finance by identifying process improvement opportunities and leveraging automation, AI-enabled solutions and modern technologies to increase efficiency, strengthen controls and streamline workflows

• Collaborate with internal partners and global finance teams to support a wide range of reporting and analytical requests
 About the Team
 The Americas Carrier Management Team is a highly motivated and forward-thinking group dedicated to continuously developing and strengthening reporting, consolidation, and analytical capabilities. We are passionate about delivering insightful, meaningful, and decision-ready financial information to our stakeholders and business leaders. As part of this team, you will work in an intellectually stimulating and complex environment that encourages curiosity, innovation, and collaboration. We are at the forefront of transforming Finance through the adoption of modern technologies and AI-enabled solutions, embedding automation and advanced analytics into our core processes. This creates unique opportunities to shape the future of Finance while working with cutting-edge tools and technologies. You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact — building and enhancing capabilities that support strategic decision-making across the organization, all while being supported by experienced colleagues who are invested in your growth and development.
 About You
 You bring a curious and growth-oriented mindset, ready to explore new challenges and find creative solutions. You communicate effectively, build strong relationships with ease, and are not afraid to ask questions or challenge the status quo. You thrive in a structured environment while remaining adaptable and open to change. Your attention to detail and commitment to quality sets you apart.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements :

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• Foundational knowledge of accounting principles , with exposure to U.S. Statutory accounting or insurance accounting being a plus

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel ; genuine interest in learning reporting and automation tools

• Strong interest in leveraging modern technologies and AI to transform Finance processes

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and prioritize effectively in a reporting environment

• Strong intellectual curiosity to perform root cause analysis and understand and challenge status quo

• Proactive approach to continuous learning and self-development
 These are additional nice-to-haves :

• Prior experience in the property and casualty insurance industry, financial reporting, or public accounting/audit

• Active progress toward CPA certification or CPA designation is a plus

• Familiarity with financial systems or reporting automation tools (e.g., Power BI, Alteryx, or similar)

• Experience with U.S. Statutory or IFRS accounting standards within the insurance industry

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional or global team environment
 The role will be located in our Kansas City, MO office. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework, relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $52,000 to $78,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role, will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sei un professionista finanziario orientato al dettaglio che gode di trasformare i numeri in insight significativi mentre si lavora con tecnologia all'avanguardia e AI? Se sei pronto a crescere la tua carriera nel reporting finanziario all'interno di un'organizzazione dinamica e globale - questa è la tua opportunità!
Informazioni sul ruolo
In qualità di Financial Reporting Associate, svolgerai un ruolo significativo nel sostenere la rendicontazione finanziaria e l'analisi per le entità legali della Riassicurazione P&C. Sarai parte di un team collaborativo che fornisce informazioni finanziarie accurate, tempestive e intuitive ai principali stakeholder tra le funzioni Finance e business. Oltre alla tradizionale relazione finanziaria, contribuirai a plasmare il futuro delle Finanze, contribuendo alla trasformazione dei processi di report attraverso l'automazione, le soluzioni AI e le moderne tecnologie. Questa è una fantastica opportunità per costruire una forte fondazione nel reportage degli Stati Uniti, aiutando a plasmare il futuro delle Finanze in un ambiente frenetico e intellettuale.
Principali responsabilità

• Preparare e compilare informazioni finanziarie di alta qualità su base legale degli Stati Uniti, garantendo accuratezza e aderenza alle linee guida e ai processi di revisione stabiliti

• Sostenere l'analisi legale delle prestazioni dell'entità, tra cui l'analisi della varianza e il monitoraggio della tendenza per fornire informazioni attuabili al finanziamento e ai partner commerciali

• Assistere con attività di chiusura e reporting di fine periodo, mantenendo accuratezza e aderenza ai controlli e alle scadenze stabilite

• Eseguire le attività di controllo assegnate e mantenere una documentazione approfondita all'interno dell'ambiente di reporting finanziario

• Contribuisci alla trasformazione delle Finanze individuando opportunità di miglioramento del processo e sfruttando l'automazione, soluzioni AI e tecnologie moderne per aumentare l'efficienza, rafforzare i controlli e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro

• Collabora con partner interni e team finanziari globali per supportare una vasta gamma di richieste di report e analisi
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il Team Americas Carrier Management è un gruppo altamente motivato e in avanti dedicato allo sviluppo continuo e al rafforzamento delle capacità di reporting, consolidamento e analisi. Siamo appassionati di fornire informazioni finanziarie approfondite, significative e pronte a decisioni ai nostri stakeholder e leader aziendali. Nell'ambito di questo team, lavorerai in un ambiente intellettuale stimolante e complesso che incoraggia curiosità, innovazione e collaborazione. Siamo all'avanguardia nella trasformazione delle Finanze attraverso l'adozione di tecnologie moderne e soluzioni AI-enabled, l'integrazione di automazione e analisi avanzate nei nostri processi fondamentali. Questo crea opportunità uniche per plasmare il futuro delle Finanze, lavorando con strumenti e tecnologie all'avanguardia. Avrai l'opportunità di avere un impatto reale — costruire e migliorare le capacità che sostengono il processo decisionale strategico in tutta l'organizzazione, il tutto pur essendo supportato da colleghi esperti che sono investiti nella vostra crescita e sviluppo.
A proposito di te
Porti una mentalità curiosa e orientata alla crescita, pronta ad esplorare nuove sfide e trovare soluzioni creative. Si comunica efficacemente, costruire relazioni forti con facilità, e non hanno paura di fare domande o sfidare lo status quo. Si prospera in un ambiente strutturato pur rimanendo adattabile e aperto al cambiamento. La vostra attenzione al dettaglio e all'impegno per la qualità vi contraddistingue.
Stiamo cercando candidati che soddisfino questi requisiti:

• Laurea in Contabilità, Finanza o un campo relativo

• Conoscenza fondazionale dei principi contabili , con esposizione alla contabilità legale degli Stati Uniti o la contabilità assicurativa è un plus

• Forte competenza in Microsoft Excel; autentico interesse nell'apprendimento degli strumenti di reporting e automazione

• Forte interesse a sfruttare le moderne tecnologie e AI per trasformare i processi di finanza

• Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di gestire più scadenze e priorità in modo efficace in un ambiente di report

• Forte curiosità intellettuale per eseguire l'analisi causa radice e capire e sfidare lo status quo

• Approccio proattivo all'apprendimento continuo e all'autosviluppo
Questi sono altri tipi di comportamento:

• Esperienza prioritaria nel settore delle assicurazioni di proprietà e perdite, rendicontazione finanziaria o contabilità pubblica/audit

• Il progresso attivo verso la certificazione CPA o la designazione CPA è un plus

• Familiarità con sistemi finanziari o strumenti di segnalazione di automazione (ad esempio, Power BI, Alteryx, o simili)

• Esperienza con gli standard di contabilità legale o IFRS degli Stati Uniti nel settore assicurativo

• Capacità dimostrata di lavorare in collaborazione in un ambiente di team interfunzionale o globale
Il ruolo sarà situato nella nostra Kansas City, ufficio MO. La nostra azienda utilizza un modello di lavoro ibrido che richiede almeno tre giorni in ufficio ogni settimana, con la possibilità di lavorare in loco a tempo pieno se preferito. Questa posizione non è idonea per il telelavoro a tempo pieno, l'assistenza di trasferimento o la sponsorizzazione del visto.
L'intervallo di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione è $52,000 a $78,000. Lo stipendio specifico offerto per questo, o qualsiasi dato ruolo, terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, la posizione del lavoro, la portata del ruolo, le qualifiche, la complessità/specializzazione/scarsità del talento, l'esperienza, l'istruzione e il bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Le decisioni sull'occupazione si basano esclusivamente sulle qualifiche di un individuo per la posizione in essere.

Durante il processo di reclutamento, su richiesta sono disponibili sistemazioni ragionevoli per disabili. Se contattato per un colloquio, si prega di informare il Recruiter/HR Professional dell'alloggio necessario.

Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys turning numbers into meaningful insights while working with cutting-edge technology and AI? If you're ready to grow your career in financial reporting within a dynamic, global organization — this is your opportunity!
About the Role
As a Financial Reporting Associate, you will play a meaningful role in supporting the financial reporting and analysis for the US P&C Reinsurance legal entities. You'll be part of a collaborative team that delivers accurate, timely, and insightful financial information to key stakeholders across Finance and business functions. Beyond traditional financial reporting, you will help shape the future of Finance by contributing to the transformation of reporting processes through automation, AI-enabled solutions and modern technologies. This is a fantastic opportunity to build a strong foundation in U.S. Statutory reporting while helping shape the future of Finance in a fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environment.
Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and compile high-quality financial information on a U.S. Statutory basis, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established guidelines and review processes

• Support legal entity performance analysis , including variance analysis and trend monitoring to provide actionable insights to finance and business partners

• Assist with period-end close and reporting activities , maintaining accuracy and adherence to established controls and deadlines

• Execute assigned control activities and maintain thorough documentation within the financial reporting environment

• Contribute to the transformation of Finance by identifying process improvement opportunities and leveraging automation, AI-enabled solutions and modern technologies to increase efficiency, strengthen controls and streamline workflows

• Collaborate with internal partners and global finance teams to support a wide range of reporting and analytical requests
About the Team
The Americas Carrier Management Team is a highly motivated and forward-thinking group dedicated to continuously developing and strengthening reporting, consolidation, and analytical capabilities. We are passionate about delivering insightful, meaningful, and decision-ready financial information to our stakeholders and business leaders. As part of this team, you will work in an intellectually stimulating and complex environment that encourages curiosity, innovation, and collaboration. We are at the forefront of transforming Finance through the adoption of modern technologies and AI-enabled solutions, embedding automation and advanced analytics into our core processes. This creates unique opportunities to shape the future of Finance while working with cutting-edge tools and technologies. You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact — building and enhancing capabilities that support strategic decision-making across the organization, all while being supported by experienced colleagues who are invested in your growth and development.
About You
You bring a curious and growth-oriented mindset, ready to explore new challenges and find creative solutions. You communicate effectively, build strong relationships with ease, and are not afraid to ask questions or challenge the status quo. You thrive in a structured environment while remaining adaptable and open to change. Your attention to detail and commitment to quality sets you apart.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements :

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• Foundational knowledge of accounting principles , with exposure to U.S. Statutory accounting or insurance accounting being a plus

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel ; genuine interest in learning reporting and automation tools

• Strong interest in leveraging modern technologies and AI to transform Finance processes

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and prioritize effectively in a reporting environment

• Strong intellectual curiosity to perform root cause analysis and understand and challenge status quo

• Proactive approach to continuous learning and self-development
These are additional nice-to-haves :

• Prior experience in the property and casualty insurance industry, financial reporting, or public accounting/audit

• Active progress toward CPA certification or CPA designation is a plus

• Familiarity with financial systems or reporting automation tools (e.g., Power BI, Alteryx, or similar)

• Experience with U.S. Statutory or IFRS accounting standards within the insurance industry

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional or global team environment
The role will be located in our Kansas City, MO office. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework, relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.
The estimated base salary range for this position is $52,000 to $78,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role, will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
