jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned technical leader in Life & Health (re)insurance, ready to shape the future of underwriting and claims across one of the world's most dynamic and diverse regions? This is a rare opportunity to drive technical excellence, lead a vibrant community of experts, and make a lasting impact across the APAC ex China (APAX) market.
 About the Role
 The Head L&H Underwriting & Claims Office APAX provides technical leadership for Underwriting & Claims across APAX, ensuring the consistent application and evolution of Swiss Re's underwriting and claims philosophy, strong technical governance and quality assurance, and continued development of our underwriting and claims capabilities.
 The role translates Swiss Re's global underwriting and claims philosophy, standards and risk appetite into the APAX context, reflecting the region's diverse markets, distribution models and evolving risk landscape. It provides senior technical judgement on complex and emerging risks and works closely with market teams and Global Underwriting & Claims to ensure that regional perspectives are appropriately reflected in the evolution of global philosophy and standards.
 A key part of the role is to drive the evolution of underwriting approaches in APAX. Working closely with Underwriting Solutions and other partners, the role brings together underwriting expertise, data and technology to advance how we assess and accept risks, while ensuring that new approaches remain technically sound and appropriately embedded into underwriting philosophy and practice.
 The role is responsible for technical governance and quality assurance across Underwriting & Claims in APAX. This includes maintaining an effective first-line assurance framework, conducting targeted technical deep-dives into market and service teams, overseeing quality assurance and adherence to technical standards, identifying systemic weaknesses and ensuring appropriate remediation. Insights from these activities should be used to continuously strengthen technical standards, processes and capabilities across the region.
 The Head L&H Underwriting & Claims Office APAX also leads the regional Underwriting & Claims community, building strong connections across markets, Bangalore and Global Underwriting & Claims. The role is expected to develop technical capabilities and future leaders, foster knowledge sharing and create an environment in which technical expertise can grow and have impact. The location Head Underwriting & Claims across APAC ex China will have a dotted reporting line into this role.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Provide technical leadership for L&H Underwriting & Claims across APAX and translate global philosophy, standards and risk appetite into the regional context

• Ensure consistent and high-quality application of underwriting and claims philosophy, standards, procedures and authorities across APAX

• Drive the evolution of underwriting approaches in APAX, working closely with Underwriting Solutions and other partners to leverage data, technology and new approaches to risk assessment and acceptance
 Own senior regional Underwriting & Claims relationships with key clients, bringing technical expertise and risk insights to strategic client discussions and ensuring strong connectivity between client needs, market teams and the wider UW&C community

• Drive external thought leadership through client forums, industry engagement and public speaking, strengthening Swiss Re's position as a technical expert and knowledge partner

• Represent APAX towards Global Underwriting & Claims and contribute regional perspectives to the development of global philosophy, standards and priorities

• Provide senior technical judgement and guidance on complex, material or emerging underwriting and claims matters, including matters exceeding local authorities where applicable

• Own and continuously strengthen the regional technical governance and quality assurance framework for Underwriting & Claims

• Conduct and oversee targeted technical deep-dives, quality reviews and other first-line assurance activities across market and service teams

• Build and lead strong Underwriting & Claims technical communities across APAX, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing between markets, our service center in Bangalore and global teams

• Develop technical talent and future leaders and contribute to attractive and sustainable career paths for underwriting and claims professionals
 About the Team
 The Centre for Technical and Operational Excellence APAX enables APAX to consistently deliver results by setting technical standards, building strong technical communities and driving disciplined execution.
 The Centre brings together the Actuarial and Underwriting & Claims Offices as well as our Bangalore capabilities, working closely with market teams and global functions. It provides technical leadership across APAX, strengthens governance and operational discipline, and supports the development of strong and connected technical communities across the region.
 The L&H Underwriting & Claims Office is a core part of the Centre, providing technical leadership, governance and quality assurance for Underwriting & Claims across APAX. The team connects expertise across markets, Bangalore and Global Underwriting & Claims and plays an important role in translating global philosophy into the APAX context, evolving underwriting approaches and building technical capabilities across the region.
 About You

• At least 15 years' experience in L&H (re)insurance, with strong technical expertise in underwriting and/or claims and a sound understanding of L&H products and profitability drivers

• Recognised technical leader with the judgement and credibility to provide direction on complex matters and influence senior stakeholders

• Strong understanding of underwriting philosophy, risk assessment and risk appetite, with the ability to translate global principles into the APAX context

• Strong governance and quality mindset, with experience in technical assurance, reviews and driving effective remediation

• Curiosity and openness to evolve underwriting through data, technology and new approaches, while maintaining sound risk principles

• Proven leadership and people-development skills, with the ability to build strong technical communities and develop future leaders

• Strong communication, influencing and relationship-management skills across markets, functions and global teams

• Relevant professional qualification in L&H Underwriting or Claims (e.g. CII, FALU or equivalent) is an advantage
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sei un leader tecnico esperto nella Life & Health (re)assicurazione, pronto a plasmare il futuro della sottoscrizione e delle rivendicazioni in una delle regioni più dinamiche e diverse del mondo? Questa è una rara opportunità per guidare l'eccellenza tecnica, condurre una vivace comunità di esperti, e fare un impatto duraturo attraverso il mercato APAC ex Cina (APAX).
Informazioni sul ruolo
Il Head L&H Underwriting & Claims Office APAX fornisce la leadership tecnica per Underwriting & Claims in APAX, assicurando l'applicazione e l'evoluzione coerente della filosofia di sottoscrizione e rivendicazione di Swiss Re, la forte governance tecnica e la garanzia di qualità, e lo sviluppo continuo delle nostre capacità di sottoscrizione e di rivendicazione.
Il ruolo traduce la sottoscrizione globale di Swiss Re e rivendica la filosofia, gli standard e l'appetito del rischio nel contesto APAX, riflettendo i diversi mercati, modelli di distribuzione e l'evoluzione del paesaggio dei rischi. Fornisce giudizi tecnici senior sui rischi complessi ed emergenti e lavora a stretto contatto con i team di mercato e Global Underwriting & Claims per garantire che le prospettive regionali siano adeguatamente riflesse nell'evoluzione della filosofia e degli standard globali.
Una parte fondamentale del ruolo è quello di guidare l'evoluzione degli approcci di sottoscrizione in APAX. Lavorando a stretto contatto con Underwriting Solutions e altri partner, il ruolo riunisce competenze di sottoscrizione, dati e tecnologia per avanzare come valutiamo e accettiamo i rischi, assicurando al contempo che i nuovi approcci rimangano tecnicamente sani e opportunamente incorporati nella filosofia e nella pratica di sottoscrizione.
Il ruolo è responsabile della governance tecnica e dell'assicurazione della qualità attraverso la sottoscrizione e i reclami in APAX. Ciò include il mantenimento di un efficace quadro di garanzia di prima linea, conducendo approfondimenti tecnici mirati nei team di mercato e di servizio, supervisionando l'assicurazione della qualità e l'aderenza agli standard tecnici, identificando le debolezze sistemiche e garantendo una corretta bonifica. Le informazioni di queste attività dovrebbero essere utilizzate per rafforzare continuamente standard tecnici, processi e funzionalità in tutta la regione.
Il Head L&H Underwriting & Claims Office APAX guida anche la comunità regionale Underwriting & Claims, creando forti connessioni tra mercati, Bangalore e Global Underwriting & Claims. Il ruolo è previsto per sviluppare capacità tecniche e futuri leader, promuovere la condivisione delle conoscenze e creare un ambiente in cui le competenze tecniche possono crescere e avere impatto. La posizione Head Underwriting & Claims in APAC ex Cina avrà una linea di report tratteggiata in questo ruolo.
Responsabilità chiave:

• Fornire leadership tecnica per L&H Underwriting & Claims attraverso APAX e tradurre filosofia globale, standard e appetito di rischio nel contesto regionale

• Assicurare l'applicazione coerente e di alta qualità di sottoscrivere e rivendicare filosofia, standard, procedure e autorità in tutto APAX

• Guidare l'evoluzione degli approcci di sottoscrizione in APAX, lavorando a stretto contatto con Underwriting Solutions e altri partner per sfruttare i dati, la tecnologia e nuovi approcci per la valutazione del rischio e l'accettazione
Possiede relazioni di sottoscrittura e rivendicazione regionali con i clienti chiave, portando competenze tecniche e intuizioni di rischio alle discussioni strategiche dei clienti e garantendo una forte connettività tra le esigenze del cliente, i team di mercato e la più ampia comunità UW&C

• Guidare la leadership del pensiero esterno attraverso forum client, impegno del settore e parlare pubblicamente, rafforzare la posizione di Swiss Re come esperto tecnico e partner di conoscenza

• Rappresentare APAX verso Global Underwriting & Claims e contribuire a prospettive regionali allo sviluppo di filosofia, standard e priorità globali

• Fornire giudizi tecnici senior e indicazioni su questioni complesse, materiali o emergenti di sottoscrizione e reclami, comprese le questioni che superano le autorità locali ove applicabile

• Possedere e rafforzare continuamente il quadro regionale di governance tecnica e di garanzia della qualità per Underwriting & Claims

• Condurre e supervisionare approfondimenti tecnici mirati, recensioni di qualità e altre attività di assicurazione di prima linea nei team di mercato e di servizio

• Costruire e condurre forti comunità tecniche Underwriting & Claims in APAX, promuovendo la collaborazione e la condivisione delle conoscenze tra i mercati, il nostro centro di assistenza a Bangalore e i team globali

• Sviluppare talenti tecnici e futuri leader e contribuire a percorsi di carriera attraenti e sostenibili per i professionisti della sottoscrizione e dei reclami
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il Centro di Eccellenza Tecnica e Operativa APAX consente ad APAX di fornire costantemente risultati stabilendo standard tecnici, costruendo comunità tecniche forti e guidando l'esecuzione disciplinata.
Il Centro riunisce gli uffici Actuarial e Underwriting & Claims e le nostre capacità Bangalore, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di mercato e le funzioni globali. Fornisce la leadership tecnica attraverso APAX, rafforza la governance e la disciplina operativa, e supporta lo sviluppo di comunità tecniche forti e connesse in tutta la regione.
L'ufficio di sottoscrittura e rivendicazione di L&H è una parte fondamentale del Centro, fornendo la leadership tecnica, la governance e la garanzia di qualità per la sottoscrittura e i reclami attraverso APAX. Il team collega le competenze tra mercati, Bangalore e Global Underwriting & Claims e svolge un ruolo importante nella traduzione della filosofia globale nel contesto APAX, nell'evoluzione degli approcci di sottoscrizione e nella costruzione di capacità tecniche in tutta la regione.
A proposito di te

• Almeno 15 anni di esperienza nell'assicurazione L&H (re) con una forte competenza tecnica nel sottoscrivere e/o rivendicazioni e una solida comprensione dei prodotti L&H e dei driver di redditività

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a seasoned technical leader in Life & Health (re)insurance, ready to shape the future of underwriting and claims across one of the world's most dynamic and diverse regions? This is a rare opportunity to drive technical excellence, lead a vibrant community of experts, and make a lasting impact across the APAC ex China (APAX) market.
About the Role
The Head L&H Underwriting & Claims Office APAX provides technical leadership for Underwriting & Claims across APAX, ensuring the consistent application and evolution of Swiss Re's underwriting and claims philosophy, strong technical governance and quality assurance, and continued development of our underwriting and claims capabilities.
The role translates Swiss Re's global underwriting and claims philosophy, standards and risk appetite into the APAX context, reflecting the region's diverse markets, distribution models and evolving risk landscape. It provides senior technical judgement on complex and emerging risks and works closely with market teams and Global Underwriting & Claims to ensure that regional perspectives are appropriately reflected in the evolution of global philosophy and standards.
A key part of the role is to drive the evolution of underwriting approaches in APAX. Working closely with Underwriting Solutions and other partners, the role brings together underwriting expertise, data and technology to advance how we assess and accept risks, while ensuring that new approaches remain technically sound and appropriately embedded into underwriting philosophy and practice.
The role is responsible for technical governance and quality assurance across Underwriting & Claims in APAX. This includes maintaining an effective first-line assurance framework, conducting targeted technical deep-dives into market and service teams, overseeing quality assurance and adherence to technical standards, identifying systemic weaknesses and ensuring appropriate remediation. Insights from these activities should be used to continuously strengthen technical standards, processes and capabilities across the region.
The Head L&H Underwriting & Claims Office APAX also leads the regional Underwriting & Claims community, building strong connections across markets, Bangalore and Global Underwriting & Claims. The role is expected to develop technical capabilities and future leaders, foster knowledge sharing and create an environment in which technical expertise can grow and have impact. The location Head Underwriting & Claims across APAC ex China will have a dotted reporting line into this role.
Key Responsibilities:

• Provide technical leadership for L&H Underwriting & Claims across APAX and translate global philosophy, standards and risk appetite into the regional context

• Ensure consistent and high-quality application of underwriting and claims philosophy, standards, procedures and authorities across APAX

• Drive the evolution of underwriting approaches in APAX, working closely with Underwriting Solutions and other partners to leverage data, technology and new approaches to risk assessment and acceptance
Own senior regional Underwriting & Claims relationships with key clients, bringing technical expertise and risk insights to strategic client discussions and ensuring strong connectivity between client needs, market teams and the wider UW&C community

• Drive external thought leadership through client forums, industry engagement and public speaking, strengthening Swiss Re's position as a technical expert and knowledge partner

• Represent APAX towards Global Underwriting & Claims and contribute regional perspectives to the development of global philosophy, standards and priorities

• Provide senior technical judgement and guidance on complex, material or emerging underwriting and claims matters, including matters exceeding local authorities where applicable

• Own and continuously strengthen the regional technical governance and quality assurance framework for Underwriting & Claims

• Conduct and oversee targeted technical deep-dives, quality reviews and other first-line assurance activities across market and service teams

• Build and lead strong Underwriting & Claims technical communities across APAX, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing between markets, our service center in Bangalore and global teams

• Develop technical talent and future leaders and contribute to attractive and sustainable career paths for underwriting and claims professionals
About the Team
The Centre for Technical and Operational Excellence APAX enables APAX to consistently deliver results by setting technical standards, building strong technical communities and driving disciplined execution.
The Centre brings together the Actuarial and Underwriting & Claims Offices as well as our Bangalore capabilities, working closely with market teams and global functions. It provides technical leadership across APAX, strengthens governance and operational discipline, and supports the development of strong and connected technical communities across the region.
The L&H Underwriting & Claims Office is a core part of the Centre, providing technical leadership, governance and quality assurance for Underwriting & Claims across APAX. The team connects expertise across markets, Bangalore and Global Underwriting & Claims and plays an important role in translating global philosophy into the APAX context, evolving underwriting approaches and building technical capabilities across the region.
About You

• At least 15 years' experience in L&H (re)insurance, with strong technical expertise in underwriting and/or claims and a sound understanding of L&H products and profitability drivers

• Recognised technical leader with the judgement and credibility to provide direction on complex matters and influence senior stakeholders

• Strong understanding of underwriting philosophy, risk assessment and risk appetite, with the ability to translate global principles into the APAX context

• Strong governance and quality mindset, with experience in technical assurance, reviews and driving effective remediation

• Curiosity and openness to evolve underwriting through data, technology and new approaches, while maintaining sound risk principles

• Proven leadership and people-development skills, with the ability to build strong technical communities and develop future leaders

• Strong communication, influencing and relationship-management skills across markets, functions and global teams

• Relevant professional qualification in L&H Underwriting or Claims (e.g. CII, FALU or equivalent) is an advantage
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sind Sie ein erfahrener technischer Marktführer im Bereich Life & Health (Rück-)Versicherung, bereit, die Zukunft des Underwritings und der Schadensfälle in einer der dynamischsten und vielfältigsten Regionen der Welt zu gestalten? Das Head L&H Underwriting & Claims Office APAX stellt die technische Führung für Underwriting & Claims in APAX bereit und gewährleistet die konsequente Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung der Underwriting- und Claim-Philosophie von Swiss Re, eine starke technische Governance und Qualitätssicherung sowie die Weiterentwicklung unserer Underwriting- und Claim-Fähigkeiten.

• Die Entwicklung von Underwriting-Ansätzen in APAX vorantreiben und eng mit Underwriting Solutions und anderen Partnern zusammenarbeiten, um Daten, Technologien und neue Ansätze für die Risikobewertung und -akzeptanz zu nutzen
Eigene regionale Underwriting & Claims-Beziehungen mit wichtigen Kunden, die technische Expertise und Risikoinformationen in strategische Kundengespräche einbringen und eine starke Konnektivität zwischen Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktteams und der breiteren UW & C-Community sicherstellen

• Externe Thought Leadership durch Kundenforen, Branchenengagement und öffentliches Reden fördern und Swiss Re als technischer Experte und Wissenspartner stärken

• Geben Sie ein hochrangiges technisches Urteil und Leitlinien für komplexe, wesentliche oder sich abzeichnende Zeichnungs- und Schadensfragen an, einschließlich Angelegenheiten, die gegebenenfalls über die lokalen Behörden hinausgehen.

• Eigene und kontinuierliche Stärkung des regionalen technischen Governance- und Qualitätssicherungsrahmens für Underwriting & Claims

• Durchführung und Überwachung gezielter technischer Deep-Dives, Qualitätsüberprüfungen und anderer First-Line-Assurance-Aktivitäten in Markt- und Serviceteams

Über das Team
Das Center for Technical and Operational Excellence APAX ermöglicht es APAX, durch die Festlegung technischer Standards, den Aufbau starker technischer Gemeinschaften und die disziplinierte Ausführung konsistent Ergebnisse zu liefern.

• Starke Kommunikations-, Einfluss- und Beziehungsmanagementfähigkeiten über Märkte, Funktionen und globale Teams hinweg

Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Êtes-vous un chef de file technique chevronné en assurance vie et santé (re)prêt à façonner l'avenir de la souscription et des réclamations dans l'une des régions les plus dynamiques et les plus diversifiées du monde? C'est une occasion rare de stimuler l'excellence technique, de diriger une communauté dynamique d'experts et d'avoir un impact durable sur le marché APAC ex Chine (APAX).
À propos du rôle
Le Head L&H Underwriting & Claims Office APAX assure la direction technique de la souscription et des réclamations dans l'ensemble de l'APAX, assure l'application et l'évolution cohérentes de la philosophie de la souscription et des réclamations de Swiss Re, une gouvernance technique solide et l'assurance de la qualité, et le développement continu de nos capacités de souscription et de réclamation.
Ce rôle traduit la philosophie, les normes et l'appétit en risque de Swiss Re dans le contexte de l'APAX, reflétant la diversité des marchés, les modèles de distribution et l'évolution du paysage des risques. Il fournit un jugement technique de haut niveau sur les risques complexes et émergents et travaille en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de marché et Global Underwriting & Revendications pour veiller à ce que les perspectives régionales soient dûment prises en compte dans l'évolution de la philosophie et des normes mondiales.
Un élément clé du rôle consiste à orienter l'évolution des approches de souscription dans l'APAX. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec Solutions de souscription et d'autres partenaires, ce rôle rassemble l'expertise, les données et la technologie de souscription pour faire avancer la façon dont nous évaluons et acceptons les risques, tout en veillant à ce que les nouvelles approches demeurent techniquement saines et intégrées de façon appropriée dans la philosophie et la pratique de souscription.
Le rôle est responsable de la gouvernance technique et de l'assurance de la qualité dans l'ensemble de l'APAX. Cela comprend le maintien d'un cadre d'assurance de première ligne efficace, l'exécution de directives techniques ciblées dans les équipes de marché et de services, la supervision de l'assurance de la qualité et le respect des normes techniques, la détection des faiblesses systémiques et l'assainissement approprié. Les enseignements tirés de ces activités devraient servir à renforcer en permanence les normes, les processus et les capacités techniques dans toute la région.
Le Bureau des assurances et des réclamations de L&H APAX dirige également la communauté régionale des assurances et des réclamations, en établissant des liens solides entre les marchés, Bangalore et Global Underwriting & Revendications. Ce rôle devrait permettre de développer les capacités techniques et les futurs dirigeants, de favoriser le partage des connaissances et de créer un environnement dans lequel les compétences techniques peuvent se développer et avoir un impact. L'emplacement de Head Underwriting & Revendications à travers APAC ex Chine aura une ligne pointillée de rapport dans ce rôle.
Principales responsabilités :

• Fournir un leadership technique pour la souscription et les réclamations de L&H dans l'ensemble de l'APAX et traduire la philosophie, les normes et l'appétit pour les risques dans le contexte régional

• Assurer une application uniforme et de haute qualité de la philosophie, des normes, des procédures et des pouvoirs en matière de souscription et de réclamation dans l'ensemble de l'APAX

• Conduire l'évolution des approches de souscription dans l'APAX, travailler en étroite collaboration avec Insurance Solutions et d'autres partenaires pour tirer parti des données, de la technologie et des nouvelles approches en matière d'évaluation et d'acceptation des risques
Les relations entre les principaux clients de la région en matière de souscription et de revendications, en apportant une expertise technique et des renseignements sur les risques aux discussions stratégiques avec les clients et en assurant une forte connectivité entre les besoins des clients, les équipes du marché et l'ensemble de la communauté UW&C

• Conduire le leadership de la pensée externe à travers des forums clients, l'engagement de l'industrie et l'expression publique, renforcer la position de Swiss Re en tant qu'expert technique et partenaire du savoir

• Représenter l'APAX en faveur de la souscription et des réclamations mondiales et contribuer aux perspectives régionales pour le développement de la philosophie, des normes et des priorités mondiales

• Donner des avis techniques de haut niveau sur les questions complexes, matérielles ou nouvelles de souscription et de réclamation, y compris les questions qui dépassent les autorités locales, le cas échéant

• :: Renforcer en permanence le cadre régional de gouvernance technique et d ' assurance de la qualité pour la souscription et les réclamations

• Mener et superviser des plongées profondes techniques ciblées, des examens de la qualité et d'autres activités d'assurance de première ligne à l'échelle des équipes du marché et des services

• Bâtir et diriger de solides communautés techniques de souscription et de réclamations dans l'ensemble de l'APAX, favorisant la collaboration et le partage des connaissances entre les marchés, notre centre de services à Bangalore et les équipes mondiales

• Développer les talents techniques et les futurs leaders et contribuer à des parcours de carrière attrayants et durables pour les professionnels de la souscription et des réclamations
À propos de l'équipe
Le Centre d'excellence technique et opérationnelle APAX permet à APAX d'obtenir des résultats systématiquement en fixant des normes techniques, en créant des communautés techniques solides et en conduisant une exécution disciplinée.

Il assure le leadership technique à l'échelle de l'APAX, renforce la gouvernance et la discipline opérationnelle et appuie le développement de communautés techniques fortes et connectées dans toute la région.
Le Bureau de la souscription et des réclamations de L&H est un élément central du Centre, qui assure le leadership technique, la gouvernance et l'assurance de la qualité de la souscription et des réclamations dans l'ensemble de l'APAX. L'équipe relie l'expertise à travers les marchés, Bangalore et Global Underwriting & Revendications et joue un rôle important dans la traduction de la philosophie mondiale dans le contexte de l'APAX, l'évolution des approches de souscription et le renforcement des capacités techniques dans toute la région.
À propos de toi

• Au moins 15 ans d'expérience en assurance L&H (ré)assurance, avec une solide expertise technique dans la souscription et/ou les réclamations et une bonne compréhension des produits L&H et des facteurs de rentabilité

• Leader technique reconnu avec le jugement et la crédibilité de fournir des orientations sur des questions complexes et d'influencer les principaux acteurs

• Forte compréhension de la philosophie de souscription, de l'évaluation des risques et de l'appétit pour les risques, avec la capacité de traduire les principes mondiaux dans le contexte de l'APAX

• Une bonne gouvernance et un état d'esprit de qualité, avec de l'expérience dans l'assurance technique, les examens et la conduite d'une réhabilitation efficace

• Curiosité et ouverture à l'évolution de la souscription par le biais de données, de technologies et de nouvelles approches, tout en maintenant des principes de risque sains

• Compétences éprouvées en leadership et en perfectionnement des personnes, avec la capacité de bâtir des communautés techniques solides et de former de futurs dirigeants

• Forte capacité de communication, d'influence et de gestion des relations entre les marchés, les fonctions et les équipes mondiales

• La qualification professionnelle pertinente en L&H ou en réclamations (p. ex. CII, FALU ou équivalent) est un avantage
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Nous couvrons à la fois Propriété & Casualty et Vie & Santé. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. The General Ledger Accounting Services team is responsible for executing group and statutory accounting activities in line with IFRS and local statutory requirements. About the Role

• Support accounting, reporting, and closing activities for assigned real estate entities and portfolios, including monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes
 • Ensure accurate, complete, and timely accounting of real estate transactions in accordance with IFRS and internal accounting policies
 • Perform accounting for real estate investments, including construction projects, asset capitalization, depreciation, accruals, and intercompany transactions
 • Perform reconciliations, analyses, and controls to ensure data quality, completeness, and accuracy of financial information
 • Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, profit and loss analyses, and portfolio reporting, providing explanations for significant movements and variances
 • Coordinate with Asset Management, Carrier Management, Project Managers, external service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting
 • Execute and document key controls and maintain audit-ready supporting documentation in line with internal and external requirements
 • Support statutory reporting, audits, and regulatory requirements as applicable
 • Take ownership of assigned entities and portfolios and provide complete and accurate deliverables in line with reporting timelines
 • Support process improvements, simplification initiatives, automation efforts, and knowledge sharing within and outside of the team
 • Handle ad hoc accounting, reporting, analysis, and project-related tasks as required

About You

• You have at least five years of work experience in accounting, financial reporting, or real estate accounting
 • You have a university degree in Accounting, Audit, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
 • Knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting principles; real estate accounting experience is an advantage
 • Strong understanding of accounting controls, reconciliations, and financial reporting processes
 • Experience with SAP or other financial accounting systems
 • Proven IT skills, including MS Office; experience with data analytics, automation tools, Copilot, or ChatGPT is an advantage
 • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 • Great teammate with strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 • You are proactive, accountable, and motivated to drive continuous improvement
 • Fluent written and spoken English
 This role is a 1-year contract.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,100 and EUR 3,400 per month (for a full-time role).
The specific salary offered considers:

 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits.

We look forward to your application!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sulla squadra

Il team General Ledger Accounting Services è responsabile per l'esecuzione di attività di gruppo e di contabilità legale in linea con IFRS e requisiti legali locali. Il team esegue la chiusura di fine periodo, assicura l'accuratezza e la completezza dei messaggi di registro generale, e fornisce il gruppo tempestivo e la rendicontazione finanziaria locale. Inoltre, il team supporta i bilanci legali, gli audit, i rendiconti normativi e collabora strettamente con i team di finanza locale e le funzioni di gruppo per garantire la conformità, la trasparenza e i forti controlli finanziari. Nell'ambito del team, si identificano attivamente le opportunità per sviluppare ulteriormente, ottimizzare e migliorare i processi contabili e di chiusura, rafforzando la collaborazione con partner interni ed esterni per migliorare la qualità della consegna complessiva.

Informazioni sul ruolo

• Supporta attività di contabilità, reporting e chiusura per enti immobiliari e portafogli assegnati, compresi i processi chiudi mensili, trimestrali e di fine anno
• Assicurare una contabilità accurata, completa e tempestiva delle transazioni immobiliari secondo IFRS e le politiche contabili interne
• Eseguire la contabilità degli investimenti immobiliari, compresi i progetti di costruzione, la capitalizzazione degli asset, l'ammortamento, gli accruamenti e le transazioni intercompany
• Eseguire conciliazioni, analisi e controlli per garantire la qualità dei dati, la completezza e l'accuratezza delle informazioni finanziarie
• Preparare e rivedere le conciliazioni del bilancio, le analisi dei profitti e delle perdite, e la segnalazione del portafoglio, fornendo spiegazioni per movimenti e variazioni significative
• Coordinare con Asset Management, Carrier Management, Project Manager, fornitori di servizi esterni e altri stakeholder per garantire report finanziari tempestivi e accurati
• Eseguire e documentare i controlli chiave e mantenere la documentazione di supporto pronta all'audit in linea con i requisiti interni ed esterni
• Supporta i requisiti normativi di reporting, audit e regolamentazione applicabili
• Assumere la proprietà di entità e portafogli assegnati e fornire consegne complete e accurate in linea con le linee temporali di report
• Miglioramento del processo di supporto, iniziative di semplificazione, sforzi di automazione e condivisione delle conoscenze all'interno e all'esterno del team
• Mantenere i compiti di contabilità, reporting, analisi e relativi al progetto come richiesto

A proposito di te

• Hai almeno cinque anni di esperienza lavorativa in contabilità, rendicontazione finanziaria, o contabilità immobiliare
• Hai una laurea in Contabilità, Audit, Finanza, Economia, Business Administration, o un campo correlato
• Conoscenza degli IFRS e dei principi di reporting finanziario; l'esperienza contabile immobiliare è un vantaggio
• Forte comprensione dei controlli contabili, delle conciliazioni e dei processi di reporting finanziario
• Esperienza con SAP o altri sistemi di contabilità finanziaria
• Competenze IT provate, tra cui MS Office; esperienza con analisi dei dati, strumenti di automazione, Copilota o ChatGPT è un vantaggio
• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con attenzione ai dettagli
• Grande compagno di squadra con forti capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder
• Siete proattivi, responsabili e motivati a guidare il miglioramento continuo
• Fluente scritto e parlato inglese
Questo ruolo è un contratto di 1 anno.
La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana
Per la Slovacchia la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra 2.100 e 3.400 EUR al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno).
Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:
• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,
• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per ulteriori ricompense e benefici.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione!
Forniamo feedback a tutti i candidati via e-mail. Se non avete sentito indietro da noi, si prega di controllare la cartella spam.

Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative a grandi e medie multinazionali dalle nostre circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro un'ulteriore pace della mente.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un posto di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Über das Team

Das General Ledger Accounting Services-Team ist für die Durchführung von Gruppen- und gesetzlichen Rechnungslegungsaktivitäten gemäß IFRS und lokalen gesetzlichen Anforderungen verantwortlich. Das Team führt das Periodenende durch, stellt die Genauigkeit und Vollständigkeit der allgemeinen Ledger-Postings sicher und liefert zeitnahe Gruppen- und lokale Finanzberichte. Darüber hinaus unterstützt das Team gesetzliche Abschlüsse, Audits und regulatorische Berichterstattung und arbeitet eng mit lokalen Finanzteams und Gruppenfunktionen zusammen, um Compliance, Transparenz und strenge Finanzkontrollen zu gewährleisten. Als Teil des Teams identifizieren Sie aktiv Möglichkeiten, Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussprozesse weiterzuentwickeln, zu rationalisieren und zu verbessern, während Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern stärken, um die Lieferqualität insgesamt zu verbessern.

Über die Rolle

• Unterstützung von Buchhaltungs-, Berichts- und Abschlussaktivitäten für zugewiesene Immobilienunternehmen und Portfolios, einschließlich monatlicher, vierteljährlicher und Jahresabschlussprozesse
• Gewährleistung einer korrekten, vollständigen und zeitnahen Bilanzierung von Immobilientransaktionen gemäß IFRS und internen Rechnungslegungsgrundsätzen
• Buchhaltung für Immobilieninvestitionen, einschließlich Bauprojekte, Vermögenskapitalisierung, Abschreibungen, Rückstellungen und Intercompany-Transaktionen
• Durchführung von Abgleichen, Analysen und Kontrollen, um die Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit von Finanzinformationen sicherzustellen
• Erstellung und Überprüfung von Bilanzabstimmungen, Gewinn- und Verlustanalysen und Portfolioberichterstattung mit Erläuterungen zu signifikanten Bewegungen und Varianzen
• Koordination mit Asset Management, Carrier Management, Projektmanagern, externen Dienstleistern und anderen Stakeholdern, um eine zeitnahe und genaue Finanzberichterstattung zu gewährleisten
• Führen und dokumentieren Sie Schlüsselkontrollen und pflegen Sie die revisionsbereite Dokumentation gemäß internen und externen Anforderungen
• Unterstützung der gesetzlichen Berichterstattung, Audits und gegebenenfalls regulatorischen Anforderungen
• Übernahme des Eigentums an zugewiesenen Unternehmen und Portfolios und Bereitstellung vollständiger und genauer Ergebnisse gemäß den Berichtsfristen
• Unterstützung von Prozessverbesserungen, Vereinfachungsinitiativen, Automatisierungsbemühungen und Wissensaustausch innerhalb und außerhalb des Teams
• Bearbeitung von Ad-hoc-Buchhaltungs-, Berichts-, Analyse- und projektbezogenen Aufgaben nach Bedarf

Über dich

• Sie haben mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Finanzberichterstattung oder Immobilienbuchhaltung
• Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss in Buchhaltung, Wirtschaftsprüfung, Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Kenntnis der IFRS und Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze; Erfahrung in der Immobilienbuchhaltung ist von Vorteil
• Starkes Verständnis von Buchhaltungskontrollen, Abstimmungen und Rechnungslegungsprozessen
• Erfahrung mit SAP oder anderen Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen
• Bewährte IT-Kenntnisse, einschließlich MS Office; Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse, Automatisierungstools, Copilot oder ChatGPT ist von Vorteil
• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit Liebe zum Detail
• Toller Teamkollege mit starken Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten
• Sie sind proaktiv, rechenschaftspflichtig und motiviert, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben
• fließend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch
Diese Rolle ist ein 1-Jahres-Vertrag.
Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind
Für die Slowakei liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen 2.100 EUR und 3.400 EUR pro Monat (für eine Vollzeitstelle).
Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:
• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Zuständigkeiten der Rolle,
• das eigene Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.

L'équipe des Services comptables généraux du grand livre est chargée d'exécuter les activités de groupe et de comptabilité légale conformément aux normes IFRS et aux exigences réglementaires locales. L'équipe effectue la clôture en fin de période, s'assure de l'exactitude et de l'exhaustivité des affichages dans le grand livre général et fournit des rapports financiers en temps opportun aux groupes et aux collectivités locales. De plus, l'équipe appuie les états financiers statutaires, les audits, les rapports réglementaires et collabore étroitement avec les équipes financières locales et les fonctions de groupe pour assurer la conformité, la transparence et des contrôles financiers rigoureux. Dans le cadre de l'équipe, vous identifierez activement les occasions de développer, de rationaliser et d'améliorer les processus de comptabilité et de clôture, tout en renforçant la collaboration avec les partenaires internes et externes pour améliorer la qualité globale de la prestation.

À propos du rôle

• Appuyer les activités de comptabilité, d'établissement de rapports et de clôture pour les entités et portefeuilles immobiliers affectés, y compris les processus de clôture mensuels, trimestriels et de fin d'exercice
• Assurer une comptabilité exacte, complète et en temps voulu des opérations immobilières conformément aux IFRS et aux conventions comptables internes
• Comptabiliser les investissements immobiliers, y compris les projets de construction, la capitalisation d'actifs, l'amortissement, les charges à payer et les opérations interentreprises
• Effectuer des rapprochements, des analyses et des contrôles pour assurer la qualité, l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude des données financières
• Préparer et examiner les rapprochements des bilans, les analyses des profits et pertes et les rapports de portefeuille, en expliquant les mouvements et écarts importants

jobs.description:
Are you early in your insurance operations career and interested in working in a global, fast-paced environment? Join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions and support Trade Credit Insurance operations across the transaction lifecycle. As part of a newly established back-end TCI Operations team, you will contribute to accurate processing, reconciliation, and control activities supporting global integration and ongoing operations.
 About the Role
 As TCI Operations Analyst, you will support trade credit insurance operations across key back-end processes, including partner clearance, premium reconciliation, data migration, and cash allocation activities.
 This role reports to the VP, Operations Manager, TCI Integration, and is part of a global Credit & Surety Operations team supporting integration and ongoing operational activities. You will work closely with colleagues across underwriting, finance, and technical accounting to ensure timely and accurate processing in line with applicable Swiss Re Standards.
 Key Responsibilities

• Operational Delivery

• Support trade credit insurance operations across the transaction lifecycle

• Perform partner screening and clearance activities in accordance with established procedures

• Conduct premium reconciliations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency

• Execute data migration and system-related activities as required for integration and project work

• Handle cash allocation and assist in resolving related discrepancies

• Perform four-eyes checks on selected bookings to ensure control compliance

• Investigate and resolve operational queries in coordination with internal stakeholders

• Maintain accurate documentation and process records in line with applicable Swiss Re Standards

• Audit and Reporting

• Support internal and external audit requirements related to technical accounting and partner clearance

• Prepare ad hoc operational reports as required
 About the Team
 The Credit & Surety Operations team supports global business partners in delivering high-quality, well-governed delegated authority and specialty insurance programs. Working across regions, the team collaborates closely with underwriting, finance, legal, and risk functions to ensure strong operational standards and effective oversight of partner relationships.
 As part of this team, you will work in a collaborative, international environment that values structure, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 About You
 You are detail-oriented and take ownership of your day-to-day responsibilities. You are comfortable working with structured processes and understand the importance of accuracy and control in financial and insurance operations.
 You are a collaborative team player who communicates clearly and works effectively with colleagues across functions and regions. You are adaptable and able to manage changing priorities in a dynamic environment. You are proactive, eager to learn, and interested in developing your expertise in trade credit insurance operations.
 Key Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in insurance operations, technical accounting, credit control, or financial services; experience with trade credit insurance or specialty commercial lines ideal but not required

• Basic understanding of insurance operations and accounting processes

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• Good understanding of administrative and financial control processes

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

• Global mindset and ability to work in multinational corporate environments

• Good digital literacy, including Microsoft Office (Excel required)

• University degree in business, finance, accounting, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siete presto nella vostra carriera di operazioni di assicurazione e siete interessati a lavorare in un ambiente globale, veloce? Unisciti a Swiss Re Corporate Solutions e supporta le operazioni di Trade Credit Insurance nel ciclo di vita delle transazioni. Nell'ambito di un nuovo team TCI Operations di back-end, contribuirai ad attività di elaborazione, riconciliazione e controllo accurate che supportano l'integrazione globale e le operazioni in corso.
Informazioni sul ruolo
Come TCI Operations Analyst, supporterete le operazioni di assicurazione del credito commerciale attraverso i processi di back-end chiave, tra cui la clearance del partner, la riconciliazione dei premi, la migrazione dei dati e le attività di allocazione dei contanti.
Questo ruolo riporta al VP, Operations Manager, TCI Integration, e fa parte di un team globale di Credit & Surety Operations che supporta l'integrazione e le attività operative in corso. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i colleghi attraverso la sottoscrizione, la finanza e la contabilità tecnica per garantire l'elaborazione tempestiva e accurata in linea con gli standard svizzeri applicabili.
Principali responsabilità

• Consegna operativa

• Sostegno operazioni di assicurazione sul credito commerciale attraverso il ciclo di vita delle transazioni

• Eseguire le attività di screening e sdoganamento dei partner in conformità alle procedure stabilite

• Condurre conciliazioni premium, garantendo precisione, completezza e coerenza

• Eseguire la migrazione dei dati e le attività relative al sistema come richiesto per l'integrazione e il lavoro di progetto

• Mantenere l'allocazione in contanti e assistere nella risoluzione di discrepanze correlate

• Eseguire i controlli a quattro occhi sulle prenotazioni selezionate per garantire la conformità al controllo

• Indagare e risolvere le domande operative in coordinamento con gli stakeholder interni

• Mantenere documentazione accurata e registri di processo in linea con gli standard svizzeri applicabili

• Audit e Reporting

• Sostenere i requisiti di audit interno ed esterno relativi alla contabilità tecnica e allo sdoganamento dei partner

• Preparare relazioni operative ad hoc come richiesto
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team Credit & Surety Operations supporta i partner commerciali globali nella fornitura di alta qualità, autorità ben governata delegata e programmi di assicurazione speciali. Lavorando in tutte le regioni, il team collabora a stretto contatto con funzioni di sottoscrizione, finanza, legale e di rischio per garantire forti standard operativi e una supervisione efficace delle relazioni con i partner.
Nell'ambito di questo team, lavorerai in un ambiente collaborativo e internazionale che valorizzi la struttura, la responsabilità e il miglioramento continuo.
A proposito di te
Siete orientati al dettaglio e prendete la proprietà delle vostre responsabilità quotidiane. Siete comodi a lavorare con processi strutturati e comprendere l'importanza di accuratezza e controllo nelle operazioni finanziarie e assicurative.
Sei un giocatore di squadra collaborativo che comunica chiaramente e funziona efficacemente con i colleghi attraverso funzioni e regioni. Sei adattabile e in grado di gestire le mutevoli priorità in un ambiente dinamico. Siete proattivi, desiderosi di imparare, e interessati a sviluppare la vostra esperienza nelle operazioni di assicurazione di credito commerciale.
Requisiti chiave

• 3+ anni di esperienza nelle operazioni di assicurazione, contabilità tecnica, controllo del credito o servizi finanziari; esperienza con assicurazione di credito commerciale o linee commerciali speciali ideale ma non richiesto

• Comprensione di base delle operazioni assicurative e dei processi contabili

• Forte capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli

• Buona comprensione dei processi di controllo amministrativo e finanziario

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese

• mentalità globale e capacità di lavorare in ambienti aziendali multinazionali

• Buona alfabetizzazione digitale, tra cui Microsoft Office (Excel richiesto)

• Laurea in economia, finanza, contabilità o campo correlato, o equivalente esperienza professionale
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 14.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Sind Sie früh in Ihrer Versicherungskarriere und daran interessiert, in einem globalen, schnelllebigen Umfeld zu arbeiten? Treten Sie Swiss Re Corporate Solutions bei und unterstützen Sie Trade Credit Insurance Operationen über den gesamten Transaktionslebenszyklus. Als Teil eines neu gegründeten Back-End-Teams von TCI Operations tragen Sie zu genauen Verarbeitungs-, Abgleichs- und Kontrollaktivitäten bei, die die globale Integration und den laufenden Betrieb unterstützen.
Über die Rolle
Als TCI Operations Analyst unterstützen Sie den Handel mit Kreditversicherungen in wichtigen Backend-Prozessen, einschließlich Partnerabfertigung, Premium-Abgleich, Datenmigration und Cash-Allokation.
Diese Rolle berichtet an den VP, Operations Manager, TCI Integration und ist Teil eines globalen Credit & Surety Operations Teams, das die Integration und die laufenden operativen Aktivitäten unterstützt. Sie arbeiten eng mit Kollegen aus den Bereichen Underwriting, Finanzen und technische Buchhaltung zusammen, um eine zeitnahe und genaue Verarbeitung gemäß den geltenden Swiss Re Standards zu gewährleisten.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Operationelle Lieferung

• Unterstützung von Handelskreditversicherungen über den gesamten Transaktionslebenszyklus hinweg

• Durchführung von Partner-Screening- und -Clearing-Aktivitäten in Übereinstimmung mit festgelegten Verfahren

• Führen Sie Premium-Abgleiche durch, um Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz zu gewährleisten

• Durchführung von Datenmigration und systembezogenen Aktivitäten, die für die Integration und Projektarbeit erforderlich sind

• Handhabung der Barzuweisung und Unterstützung bei der Behebung der damit verbundenen Diskrepanzen

• Führen Sie Vier-Augen-Checks für ausgewählte Buchungen durch, um die Einhaltung der Kontrollen sicherzustellen

• Untersuchung und Lösung operativer Anfragen in Abstimmung mit internen Stakeholdern

• Pflegen Sie genaue Dokumentationen und Prozessaufzeichnungen gemäß den geltenden Swiss Re Standards

• Prüfung und Berichterstattung

• Unterstützung interner und externer Auditanforderungen im Zusammenhang mit technischer Buchhaltung und Partnerabfertigung

• Erforderlichenfalls Ad-hoc-Betriebsberichte erstellen
Über das Team
Das Credit & Surety Operations-Team unterstützt globale Geschäftspartner bei der Bereitstellung hochwertiger, gut verwalteter delegierter Behörden- und Spezialversicherungsprogramme. Das Team arbeitet über Regionen hinweg eng mit Underwriting-, Finanz-, Rechts- und Risikofunktionen zusammen, um starke operative Standards und eine effektive Überwachung der Partnerbeziehungen sicherzustellen.
Als Teil dieses Teams arbeiten Sie in einem kollaborativen, internationalen Umfeld, das Struktur, Rechenschaftspflicht und kontinuierliche Verbesserung schätzt.
Über dich
Sie sind detailorientiert und übernehmen Ihre täglichen Aufgaben. Sie arbeiten gerne mit strukturierten Prozessen und verstehen die Bedeutung von Genauigkeit und Kontrolle im Finanz- und Versicherungsbetrieb.
Sie sind ein kollaborativer Teamplayer, der klar kommuniziert und effektiv mit Kollegen über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg arbeitet. Sie sind anpassungsfähig und in der Lage, sich ändernde Prioritäten in einer dynamischen Umgebung zu verwalten. Sie sind proaktiv, lernbegierig und daran interessiert, Ihre Expertise in Handelskreditversicherungen zu entwickeln.
Wichtigste Anforderungen

• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Versicherungsgeschäften, technischer Buchhaltung, Kreditkontrolle oder Finanzdienstleistungen; Erfahrung mit Handelskreditversicherungen oder Spezialgeschäften ideal, aber nicht erforderlich

• Grundlegendes Verständnis von Versicherungsvorgängen und Buchhaltungsprozessen

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail

• Gutes Verständnis der Verwaltungs- und Finanzkontrollprozesse

• Starke schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch

• Globale Denkweise und Fähigkeit, in multinationalen Unternehmen zu arbeiten

• Gute digitale Kompetenz, einschließlich Microsoft Office (Excel erforderlich)

• Universitätsabschluss in Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder verwandten Bereichen oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 14.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Rejoignez Swiss Re Corporate Solutions et soutenez les opérations d'assurance-crédit commercial tout au long du cycle de vie des transactions. En tant qu'analyste des opérations de l'ICT, vous soutiendrez les opérations d'assurance-crédit commercial dans tous les processus clés, y compris l'approbation des partenaires, le rapprochement des primes, la migration des données et les activités d'allocation de fonds.
Ce rôle relève du vice-président, gestionnaire des opérations, Intégration de l'ICT, et fait partie d'une équipe mondiale d'opérations de crédit et de caution qui soutient l'intégration et les activités opérationnelles en cours. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec vos collègues dans les domaines de la souscription, des finances et de la comptabilité technique afin d'assurer un traitement rapide et précis conformément aux normes Swiss Re applicables.
Principales responsabilités

• Exécution opérationnelle

• Gérer la répartition des liquidités et aider à résoudre les écarts connexes

• Effectuer des vérifications à quatre yeux sur les réservations sélectionnées pour assurer la conformité au contrôle

• Enquêter et résoudre les questions opérationnelles en coordination avec les parties prenantes internes

• Maintenir la documentation exacte et les dossiers de traitement conformément aux normes Swiss Re applicables

• Audit et rapports

• Appuyer les besoins en matière de vérification interne et externe en matière de comptabilité technique et d'apurement des partenaires

L'équipe des opérations de crédit et de caution appuie les partenaires commerciaux mondiaux dans la prestation de programmes d'assurance spécialisés et de pouvoirs délégués de haute qualité. En travaillant dans toutes les régions, l'équipe collabore étroitement avec les fonctions de souscription, de financement, de droit et de risque afin d'assurer des normes opérationnelles solides et une surveillance efficace des relations avec les partenaires.
Dans le cadre de cette équipe, vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif et international qui valorise la structure, la responsabilité et l'amélioration continue.
À propos de toi
Vous êtes axé sur les détails et vous êtes propriétaire de vos responsabilités quotidiennes. Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler avec des processus structurés et de comprendre l'importance de la précision et du contrôle dans les opérations financières et d'assurance.
Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe collaborative qui communique clairement et travaille efficacement avec des collègues de toutes les fonctions et régions. Vous êtes adaptable et capable de gérer des priorités changeantes dans un environnement dynamique. Vous êtes proactif, impatient d'apprendre et intéressé à développer votre expertise dans les opérations d'assurance-crédit commercial.

Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Agriculture Underwriter – Latin America
 About the Role
 Are you ready to take the next step in your agricultural reinsurance career?
 As an Agriculture Underwriter for Latin America, you will contribute to the profitable growth and management of Swiss Re's agriculture reinsurance portfolio across the region. You will combine technical underwriting expertise with strong market engagement, supporting both treaty and facultative business while helping to develop innovative risk transfer solutions for agricultural clients.
 This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of underwriting, portfolio management, analytics, and product development. You will collaborate closely with clients, brokers, and internal experts to deliver data-driven insights, strengthen client relationships, and support Swiss Re's leadership position in agricultural reinsurance across Latin America.
 As part of a geographically distributed team, this role requires a high degree of ownership, initiative, and self-direction. You will be empowered to manage your responsibilities independently, drive projects forward, and proactively identify opportunities to improve portfolio performance, client outcomes, and business growth.

About the Team
 You will join the Agriculture Americas team, a collaborative and highly specialized group within Swiss Re's reinsurance business. The team is responsible for delivering underwriting excellence, portfolio performance, and innovative agricultural risk solutions across diverse markets in the region.
 Working closely with Client Management, Agriculture Product Center and Center of Excellence for Parametric, and other cross-functional teams, you will contribute to sustainable portfolio growth, technical innovation, and the development of tailored solutions for both private and public sector clients.
 As part of Swiss Re's global agriculture community, you will have access to a network of agriculture specialists across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, gaining exposure to advanced modelling capabilities, remote sensing applications, climate analytics, and emerging agricultural technologies.
 Key Responsibilities
 Underwriting & Portfolio Management

• Underwrite and manage a portfolio of Agriculture treaty and facultative business, ensuring sustainable profitability and adherence to Swiss Re underwriting guidelines and best practices

• Evaluate, structure, and price reinsurance solutions through quantitative analysis, portfolio assessment, and sound underwriting judgment

• Support portfolio steering activities, including accumulation management, diversification analysis, structure optimization, and performance monitoring

• Generate portfolio insights and analytics to support underwriting decisions and strategic portfolio management

• Contribute to portfolio reviews, business planning, and performance assessments across the Latin American agriculture portfolio

Client & Market Development

• Build and strengthen relationships with clients, brokers, and key market stakeholders across Mexico and Latin America

• Support business origination efforts by identifying opportunities for profitable growth and differentiated solutions

• Collaborate with Client Managers and underwriting colleagues to deepen client engagement and strengthen Swiss Re's market position

• Support client discussions through technical insights, portfolio analyses, and market intelligence

• Contribute to thought leadership initiatives and promote Swiss Re's agricultural expertise in the market

Innovation & Technical Development

• Support the development of new agricultural insurance and reinsurance solutions, including parametric and data-driven products

• Collaborate with Agriculture R&D and technical experts on modelling initiatives, product design, and solution development

• Apply analytical tools and technologies to improve risk assessment, portfolio monitoring, and product calibration

• Contribute to projects involving remote sensing, geospatial analytics, climate data, and emerging technologies relevant to agricultural risk management

• Help translate technical analyses into practical insights that create value for clients and support business decisions

About You
 You are a well-rounded agricultural insurance or reinsurance professional who combines strong technical capabilities with commercial awareness and relationship-building skills.
 You are naturally curious, highly self-motivated, and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy. You enjoy solving complex problems, working with data, engaging with clients, and taking ownership of initiatives from concept through execution. You thrive in a collaborative international environment and can effectively prioritize, make decisions, and deliver results with limited day-to-day supervision.

Experience & Background

• Bachelor's degree in Agronomy, Agricultural Economics, Actuarial Science, Natural Sciences, Engineering, Insurance, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred)

• Relevant experience in agricultural insurance or reinsurance underwriting, product development, portfolio analytics, or related technical roles

• Good understanding of agricultural insurance and reinsurance markets within Latin America

• Experience working with agricultural production systems, crop insurance, livestock insurance, or related risk management solutions

• Experience interacting with clients, brokers, or other external stakeholders is an advantage
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
